699cd518.title: DevOps Architect (AWS & Python)
699cd518.description:
**Job Title:**
AWS DevOps Architect

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**Interview Type:**
Only Video

**Duration:**
Long Term

**Work Preference:**
Onsite

**Work Location:**
Pune/Gondia, MH/ Noida/Dehradun

**Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced AWS DevOps Architect to design and implement scalable, secure, highly automated DevOps solutions on AWS. This role will define cloud infrastructure architecture, CI/CD standards, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container platforms, security controls, observability, and operational best practices.

The ideal candidate combines strong AWS architecture expertise with hands-on DevOps engineering experience and can provide technical leadership across application, integration, data, and cloud modernization initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Define enterprise AWS DevOps architecture, standards, reusable patterns, and reference architectures.

• Design and implement highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient AWS environments.

• Architect CI/CD pipelines for applications, APIs, integrations, data workloads, and infrastructure.

• Establish Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK/CDKTF, and CloudFormation.

• Design containerized platforms using Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Amazon ECR.

• Define deployment strategies including Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling, and automated rollback.

• Automate provisioning and configuration of AWS infrastructure across development, test, staging, and production environments.

• Implement DevSecOps practices including SAST/DAST, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, IAM controls, and policy enforcement.

• Design AWS networking patterns involving VPCs, subnets, security groups, Route 53, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink/VPC endpoints, load balancers, and hybrid connectivity.

• Establish centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational dashboards.

• Implement observability using Amazon CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS X-Ray, OpenSearch, Prometheus, and Grafana.

• Design IAM and security models following least-privilege and Zero Trust principles.

• Implement secrets and encryption management using AWS Secrets Manager, Systems Manager Parameter Store, and AWS KMS.

• Design solutions for high availability, disaster recovery, backup, auto-scaling, and business continuity.

• Build reusable Terraform/CDK modules, pipeline templates, and automation accelerators.

• Support migration and modernization of legacy applications and integration workloads onto AWS.

• Establish governance across multiple AWS accounts using AWS Organizations, Control Tower, IAM, SCPs, tagging standards, and centralized logging.

• Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Development, Integration, Data Engineering, and Operations teams.

• Mentor DevOps engineers and provide architectural guidance and technical leadership.

Required Experience

• 10+ years of overall IT experience with 5+ years of AWS/DevOps experience.

• 3+ years in a DevOps Architect, Cloud Architect, Platform Architect, or Lead DevOps Engineer role.

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS services including:

• EC2, S3, IAM, VPC

• Lambda

• ECS/EKS

• ECR

• API Gateway

• Route 53

• ALB/NLB

• CloudWatch and CloudTrail

• Secrets Manager and KMS

• EventBridge, SNS and SQS

• Step Functions

• Strong expertise in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.

• Experience with AWS CDK/CDKTF and CloudFormation.

• Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes/EKS.

• Experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline and CodeBuild.

• Strong scripting skills using Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell.

• Strong understanding of AWS networking, security, IAM, encryption, certificates, and private connectivity.

• Experience implementing enterprise DevSecOps and security automation.

• Experience designing monitoring and observability solutions.

• Strong understanding of Git workflows, artifact management, release management, and environment promotion.

Integration Modernization Experience – Preferred

Experience supporting AWS-based enterprise integration platforms involving:

• Amazon API Gateway for API management and exposure.

• AWS Lambda for serverless processing and integration.

• Amazon EventBridge, SNS and SQS for event-driven integration.

• AWS Step Functions for workflow orchestration.

• AWS Transfer Family for SFTP/AS2-based file and B2B integration.

• AWS B2B Data Interchange for EDI transformation and processing.

• Amazon S3 for enterprise file and message storage.

• AWS Batch for large-scale batch processing.

• Amazon MWAA / Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration.

• Private endpoints and secure connectivity between AWS and enterprise/on-premise systems.

DevSecOps Responsibilities

The architect should establish automated controls for:

• SAST/DAST and dependency scanning

• Container image scanning

• Infrastructure vulnerability scanning

• Terraform/IaC security validation

• Secrets detection

• IAM and policy validation

• Automated compliance checks

• Artifact and container security

• Audit logging and traceability

Role Expectations

The AWS DevOps Architect will own the end-to-end DevOps and cloud automation architecture, ensuring that AWS workloads can be provisioned, built, tested, secured, deployed, monitored, scaled, recovered, and operated through standardized and highly automated processes.

This is an architecture plus hands-on technical leadership role, not simply a CI/CD administration position.

1b7a87f7.title: Lead SW Developer, IoT Cloud Platform
1b7a87f7.description:
KONE Technology and Innovation (KTI) is where the magic happens at KONE. It's where we combine the physical world – escalators and elevators – with smart and connected digital systems. We are changing and improving the way billions of people move within buildings every day. We are on a mission to expand and develop new digital solutions that are based on emerging technologies.

  

KONE’s vision is to create the Best People Flow® experience by providing ease, effectiveness and experiences to our customers and users. In line with our strategy, Sustainable Success with Customers, we will focus on increasing the value we create for customers with new intelligent solutions and embed sustainability even deeper across all our operations. By closer collaboration with customers and partners, KONE will increase the speed of bringing new services and solutions to the market.

  

KDT unit within KTI is responsible for developing Digital Services products such as KONE 24/7 Connected Services, Residential Flow and Partnership Ecosystem

**We are now looking for Senior Developer – IoT Cloud Platform**

  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Developer to design, develop and operate production-grade IoT and cloud platform capabilities. The role requires strong hands-on engineering expertise across device connectivity, zero-touch provisioning, PKI/device security, fleet management, OTA, cloud-native services and containerized platforms. The candidate should have experience taking IoT solutions beyond POCs into secure, scalable, highly available production environments.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop scalable platform capabilities for device onboarding, zero-touch
* provisioning, secure connectivity, telemetry/data, remote configuration, OTA updates and fleet lifecycle management.
* Implement and operate PKI-based device identity and security, including X.509 certificates, mTLS, certificate provisioning, renewal, rotation and revocation.
* Build production-grade IoT solutions using AWS IoT Core, Azure IoT Hub or equivalent technologies, including MQTT-based device communication.
* Design and develop cloud-native microservices, REST APIs, messaging and event-driven architectures.
* Build and operate containerized applications and platform services using Docker and Kubernetes, including APIs, databases and messaging components.
* Engineer for scalability, high availability, security, observability, automated recovery and minimal manual intervention.
* Own engineering delivery end-to-end, including design, implementation, automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting and production support.
* Apply AI-assisted engineering tools such as Kiro, GitHub Copilot or equivalent for coding, testing, debugging, refactoring, documentation and engineering productivity.
* Participating in knowledge sharing and demos.
* Open to learn new cutting edge technologies as per the requirement going forward.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 10+ years of hands-on software design and development experience, including 4+ years working with production-grade cloud/IoT platforms.
* Strong experience in IoT, MQTT, PKI/X.509, mTLS, device identity, zero-touch provisioning and fleet/device lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience with AWS/Azure cloud services and IoT platforms.
* Strong expertise in Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, REST APIs, databases, messaging/event-driven systems and distributed architectures.
* Experience with OTA/software lifecycle management, telemetry/data processing, monitoring and large-scale device fleets.
* Strong knowledge of CI/CD, automated testing, observability, security and production troubleshooting.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted software engineering to improve development speed, quality, automation and maintainability.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to design, build, deploy and operate production services rather than focusing only on implementation.

**Core profile:** Hands-on production IoT engineer who can own the journey from device identity zero-touch provisioning secure connectivity telemetry/data OTA/configuration fleet operations lifecycle management at scale.

**Education & Experience:**

* Engineer graduate with any background or equivalent degree
* Minimum 10+ years of working experience in s/w development

  

*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*

  

*At KONE, we believe in fair and competitive pay that recognizes performance and supports employee engagement. Our approach covers a comprehensive total rewards package, including both financial and non-financial benefits. We are committed to fostering a culture of fairness, respect, equity, diversity, and inclusion.*

Read more on *https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html*

a251147a.title: Senior Engagement Manager – Data & AI
a251147a.description:
About Ganit

We believe data is not just an asset, it is a strategic resource that drives both top-line and bottom-line growth. Our mission, “to maximize decision velocity and minimize decision risk,” is central to how we deliver impact for our clients.

At Ganit, we design and deploy purpose-built AI/ML and analytics solutions across industries, with a strong focus on consumption before technique—delivering actionable insights, not just data or models.

Our productized analytics and AI solutions address critical business challenges such as demand forecasting, route optimization, sentiment analysis and new store location planning. We collaborate with leading cloud and technology ecosystems, including AWS and Adobe Experience Cloud, to deliver scalable and impactful solutions globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Engagement Manager to lead strategic client engagements, drive delivery excellence and strengthen long-term client relationships across Ganit’s Data, Analytics and AI portfolio.

This is a dual-responsibility role combining direct ownership of strategic client engagements with leadership of a team of Engagement Managers.

The individual will be responsible for ensuring successful project delivery, developing client relationships, identifying account growth opportunities and driving commercial outcomes, while mentoring Engagement Managers and strengthening engagement management practices across the organization.

The ideal candidate will combine strong consulting and business acumen with experience in managing complex client engagements, leading cross-functional teams and translating business challenges into actionable, data-driven solutions.

They should be comfortable engaging with senior client stakeholders, navigating ambiguity and balancing client expectations, delivery quality, team effectiveness and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Account Growth & Commercial Management

Identify and pursue opportunities to expand existing client relationships through cross-selling, upselling and new analytics or AI solution opportunities.

Understand client business priorities and develop solution recommendations that address emerging business needs.

Work closely with sales and leadership teams to shape proposals, define engagement scope, develop commercial estimates and support client presentations.

Drive account profitability through effective scope management, resource planning, utilization and delivery-cost oversight.

Monitor engagement financials and operational metrics, proactively addressing margin risks, scope creep and delivery inefficiencies.

Build account growth plans in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders and contribute to the expansion of strategic client relationships.

Support client retention by consistently demonstrating business value and identifying opportunities for long-term partnerships.

Strategic Client & Engagement Management

Lead, mentor and develop a team of Engagement Managers responsible for managing individual client engagements.

Provide oversight across assigned engagements, ensuring delivery discipline, client satisfaction, risk management and adherence to agreed timelines and quality standards.

Coach Engagement Managers on stakeholder management, problem-solving, project governance, commercial awareness and executive communication.

Review engagement health, delivery performance, resource utilization, risks and client feedback; intervene where required to resolve escalations.

Establish consistent engagement management practices, review mechanisms, reporting standards and performance expectations across the team.

Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and ownership of client outcomes.

Support the professional development and career progression of Engagement Managers through regular feedback, coaching and knowledge sharing.

Delivery Governance & Operational Excellence

Establish robust governance across assigned engagements, including delivery reviews, project health reporting, risk tracking and escalation management.

Monitor key delivery metrics such as milestone adherence, utilization, project profitability, client satisfaction and realization of business outcomes.

Drive continuous improvement in engagement management processes, delivery frameworks and execution standards.

Promote reuse of methodologies, best practices, analytical frameworks and lessons learned across client engagements.

Partner with data science, engineering, sales and business teams to improve coordination, resource deployment and delivery predictability.

Contribute to organizational thought leadership, knowledge-sharing initiatives and the development of scalable engagement management practices.

Qualifications & Experience

Minimum 5+ years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, analytics consulting, client engagement, program/project delivery or related client-facing roles.

An MBA or equivalent postgraduate management qualification from a Tier-1 business school is strongly preferred. Institutes such as IIMs, ISB, XLRI, FMS, SP Jain, MDI or equivalent are desirable.

Demonstrated experience managing client engagements end-to-end, with accountability for delivery, stakeholder relationships and business outcomes.

Prior experience leading, mentoring or managing Engagement Managers, project managers or cross-functional delivery teams is strongly preferred.

Strong understanding of data analytics, AI/ML, business intelligence or data-driven business solutions, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to business value.

Experience managing multiple projects or engagements simultaneously, including prioritization, resource planning, risk management and delivery governance.

Exposure to account management, solution consulting, commercial proposals, cross-selling or account expansion.

Strong analytical, problem-solving and structured thinking capabilities.

Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and senior stakeholder management skills.

Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced consulting environment, manage ambiguity and influence stakeholders across functions and organizational levels.

Preferred Skills & Experience

Experience working with clients in Retail, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), BFSI, Pharma, Manufacturing or other data-intensive industries.

Exposure to global clients, distributed delivery teams and offshore delivery models.

Familiarity with cloud ecosystems such as AWS or Azure and modern analytics platforms.

Understanding of project management methodologies, delivery governance and financial management of client engagements.

Experience working in data, analytics, AI or digital transformation consulting environments.

Benefits

What You’ll Get

Opportunity to lead high-impact Data & AI engagements for leading enterprises.

An opportunity to lead and develop Engagement Managers while retaining ownership of strategic client engagements.

A collaborative, innovation-driven environment at a fast-scaling Data & AI company.

Opportunities to influence delivery practices, account growth and organizational capabilities.

Competitive compensation and performance-driven rewards.

Requirements

Own and manage end-to-end delivery of strategic client engagements across analytics, AI/ML and data-driven business solutions.

Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, stakeholders, understanding their business priorities and translating them into actionable problem statements and solution approaches.

Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders and decision-makers, ensuring alignment on objectives, scope, timelines and expected business outcomes.

Drive client satisfaction by ensuring high-quality delivery, measurable business impact and proactive resolution of issues.

Identify engagement risks, dependencies and delivery challenges early, and drive appropriate mitigation plans.

Lead project planning, resource allocation, work breakdown structures, milestone tracking and governance reviews.

Coordinate effectively with data science, data engineering, technology and business teams to ensure seamless execution across engagements.

Ensure that solutions deliver tangible business value rather than merely technical outputs.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

5e973ef5.title: Program Manager-Immunization
5e973ef5.description:
Overview:

Jhpiego is an international, non-profit health organisation and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high-quality, low-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems. Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on-the-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunisation, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).

Jhpiego will work closely with State Governments across eight identified states to strengthen immunization systems for children and adolescents from birth to 16 years of age. Key focus areas include supporting age-appropriate and timely vaccination, strengthening service delivery, facilitating data-driven planning and monitoring, and supporting capacity development and community engagement to ensure every child and adolescent is protected against vaccine-preventable diseases.

Jhpiego is hiring for the position of Program Manager Officer based at Delhi. The position will work closely with the governments, Jhpiego India country office and state teams for implementation of the project activities. The projects focus on to strengthen immunization system across the birth-to-16-years age group. The position will report to Senior Program Manager, Immunization.

Responsibilities:

* Planning, coordination and implementation of project activities across the eight identified states, ensuring alignment with project objectives and approved workplans.
* Provide strategic and technical leadership to strengthen routine immunization systems and improve age-appropriate vaccination across the birth-to-16-years age group.
* Development and implementation of strategies to identify, track and reach left-out and dropout children and adolescents, with a focus on improving immunization coverage, timeliness and completeness.
* Coordinate closely with the Ministry, State Health Departments and other key stakeholders to facilitate effective program implementation and address systemic challenges.
* Provide technical guidance and oversight to state-level project teams to ensure quality implementation, timely delivery of activities and achievement of program targets.
* Lead stakeholder engagement and facilitate national and state-level consultations, review meetings, technical workshops and capacity-building initiatives with government officials and development partners.
* Undertake periodic field visits to project states to review implementation progress, provide strategic guidance and support resolution of program bottlenecks.
* Work closely with the MERL team to review program performance, monitor key indicators, analyze data and facilitate evidence-based decision-making and course correction.
* Oversee program documentation, including good practices, innovations, implementation experiences, success stories and lessons learned.
* Lead the preparation and timely submission of donor reports, program updates, technical presentations, workplans and other project deliverables.
* Coordinate with internal teams, including Finance, HR, Operations and MERL, to ensure effective resource utilization, compliance and smooth program implementation.
* Contribute to resource mobilization and proposal development by identifying emerging opportunities and providing technical inputs for new immunization initiatives.
* Undertake other responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor in support of program objectives.

Required Qualifications:

* Master’s degree in public health (MPH), Health Management, Community Medicine, Epidemiology or Social Sciences. Candidates with a medical background (MBBS/BDS/BAMS/BHMS) along with a relevant postgraduate qualification will be preferred.
* 8-10 years of relevant experience in public health, immunization or health systems strengthening programs.
* Demonstrated experience in planning, implementation and monitoring of immunization programs preferably at state and district levels.
* Experience working closely with government health systems, particularly MoHFW and development partners.
* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder coordination, community engagement and working with frontline health workers and community platforms.

  
Preferred Qualifications:  

* Strong program planning, implementation, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to analyze program data, identify performance gaps and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with government officials, development partners and community stakeholders.
* Good documentation, report writing, presentation and knowledge-management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and analyzing data of immunization program.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team.

Willingness to undertake frequent field visits and travel to project states and districts as required

**Responsibilities**
MaxLinear's Analog & Mixed Signal (AMS) Business Unit is seeking an experienced Project Manager / Program Manager to lead strategic semiconductor product development programs from concept through production release. This role requires a strong blend of program leadership, technical depth, business acumen, and stakeholder management to successfully execute complex analog and mixed-signal silicon development programs.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have 8-10 years of experience in semiconductor product development and program management, with a solid understanding of the end-to-end IC development lifecycle. The role demands close collaboration with IC design, engineering, systems, operations, marketing, quality, manufacturing, and applications teams across global locations to ensure successful delivery of products that meet technical, schedule, quality, and business objectives.
  
  

* programs from product conception to volume production.
* Define project scope, schedules, milestones, resource requirements, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Establish program governance mechanisms and lead phase-gate reviews throughout the product lifecycle.
* Drive execution excellence across multiple concurrent projects while balancing technical, schedule, and business priorities.
* Lead collaboration across systems, architecture, design, verification, validation, product engineering, quality, operations, manufacturing, supply chain, packaging, and marketing teams across global locations.
* Ensure alignment of cross-functional stakeholders toward program objectives and key deliverables.
* Facilitate technical and management reviews, decision-making forums, and escalation processes.
* Develop and maintain integrated program schedules and critical path tracking.
* Identify technical, operational, and business risks proactively and drive mitigation plans.
* Monitor program health through key performance indicators, milestone tracking, and status reviews.
* Resolve cross-functional issues and remove execution roadblocks to maintain project momentum.
* Serve as a primary program interface for internal customers, business leaders, and executive stakeholders.
* Communicate program status, risks, mitigation plans, and key decisions to key stakeholders.
* Manage stakeholder expectations while ensuring alignment between customer requirements and internal execution plans.
* Support customer reviews, project updates, and major program milestones.
* Partner with engineering and operations teams to drive successful silicon bring-up, qualification, and manufacturing readiness.
* Support transition from development through validation, qualification, production ramp, and sustaining phases.
* Ensure readiness across supply chain, test, quality, and manufacturing functions for product launches.
* Collaborate with Business Unit leadership and Product Management teams on strategic planning and execution.
* Track program budgets, resource utilization, and operational metrics.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance program execution, predictability, and organizational efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* 8-10 years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, or Technical Program Management within the semiconductor industry.
* Proven track record leading complex semiconductor product development programs from concept to production.
* Experience working with Analog, Mixed-Signal, Power Management, Connectivity, ASIC, or SoC-based products.
* Strong understanding of the semiconductor product development lifecycle, including:
* Ability to engage effectively with engineering teams and understand technical trade-offs, risks, and development challenges.
* Strong proficiency in project planning, scheduling, risk management, dependency management, and stakeholder communication.
* Expertise in program management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Excel & MS Office
* Experience managing geographically distributed teams across multiple time zones – India, Asia Pacific and US.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and lead cross-functional teams toward common objectives.
* Excellent executive-level presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and conflict-resolution abilities.
* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electronics Engineering or Electrical Engineering or VLSI or related equivalent technical discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in Analog/Mixed-Signal IC design, Product Engineering, Validation, or Applications Engineering.
* Experience managing customer-specific or custom silicon development programs.
* Familiarity with AMS products such as power management ICs, Bridge ICs, serial transceiver ICs, SoC, data converters, interface products, or connectivity solutions.
* Exposure to semiconductor manufacturing, qualification, reliability, and supply chain processes.
* PMP, PgMP, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent project management certifications.

**Company Overview**
MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system-on-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi-market applications.
  
  
We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner.
  
  
MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end-to-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs.
  
  
Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore.
  
  
We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside-the-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

2d88a2c7.title: Digital Solution Engineering
2d88a2c7.description:
**Overview**

**Digital Solution Engineer (DSE) | AI Business Process (AIBP) | Customer Experience**

We are seeking a passionate, customer-focused and technically accomplished Digital Solution Engineer (DSE) to accelerate AI-led Customer Experience transformation through Microsoft's AI Business Process (AIBP) solutions.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor and transformation catalyst, helping customers reimagine their Sales, Customer Service, Contact Center and Customer Engagement processes by leveraging Dynamics 365, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform and Agentic AI.

You will partner closely with sales teams, customers, partners and business decision-makers to identify high-impact business challenges, architect innovative AI-powered solutions, and demonstrate measurable business value through compelling technical storytelling, hands-on demonstrations, proof of concepts and solution workshops.

The role requires a unique combination of deep technical expertise, business process understanding, consultative selling and the ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into tangible customer outcomes.

Beyond traditional solution demonstrations, you will champion a "Show, Build and Prove Value" approach, helping customers transition from conventional CRM applications to intelligent, autonomous and agent-driven business processes.

You will play a pivotal role in influencing technical decisions, accelerating competitive wins, driving Copilot and Agent adoption, and establishing Microsoft as the strategic platform for next-generation Customer Experience transformation.

The ideal candidate is a technology enthusiast, an AI innovator, a compelling storyteller and a customer-obsessed solution engineer who thrives at the intersection of business transformation and emerging technology.

  
**Responsibilities**  

### **Build Strategy**

Monitors and analyzes action plans to promote customer usage of key/prioritized Microsoft solutions/products that support customer’s business outcomes. Identifies opportunities to promote usage. Defines success metrics and basic telemetry requirements during solution design/proof of concept (POC) so adoption teams can measure usage post-handoff.

Captures core customer compete knowledge across solution areas and delivers back to product and engineering teams to enhance team capabilities and develop compete strategies.

Provides strategic, technical, and partner input based on Microsoft capability to contribute to strategy development, leveraging partner and competitor knowledge.

Works with account teams to shape strategic customer win strategy and tailor unique Microsoft value messaging to audience.

Acts as the voice of the customer (VOC) by driving new feedback, blockers, insights, and resources (e.g., unified action tracker [UAT], technical feedback platform) across territories so they can be added and prioritized. Represents the customer to product teams (e.g., Engineering) to shape products and services by providing insights across the territory. Maintains Microsoft Sales Experience (MSX) hygiene for customer engagements (accurate activity capture and attribution) so feedback and blockers are actionable.

### **Scale Customer Engagements**

Uses knowledge of customer context, cross-solution, or portfolio expertise, and technical and market/industry knowledge to build credibility with customers individually or at scale.

Helps ensure consistency and quality of engagements through adherence of standards and best practices (e.g., managed service provider [MSP], managed certified professional [MCP]). Utilizes common sales and delivery methodology for the Microsoft sales organization to identify and engage customers in new opportunities. Actively seeks and incorporates feedback on customer impact to increase capabilities.

Proactively helps to maximize impact of customer engagements by executing on solutions to blockers.

Leads and ensures customer needs are met by showcasing suitable Microsoft solutions anchored in insights and business value, and influences customer technical buy-in. Utilizes rules of engagement (e.g., role boundaries, handoff strategies), and leverages knowledge of processes (e.g., Managed Service Provider [MSP], co-sell partners), tools, and programs (e.g., FastTrack). Searches for customer references to use in engagements. Participates in agentic solution co-creation with customers where applicable, aligning requirements, success criteria, and technical proof points.

Leverages knowledge of programs and investments (e.g., Innovation Hub, exec briefing center, partner workshops) and proactively engages with engineering, product, and support teams to remediate blockers.

Engages with customer technical and business decision makers, and identifying customer needs and issues proactively through technical discovery.

### **Scale Through Partners**

Engages in partner sell-with scenarios by acting as liaison between the partner and team and shares visibility on partner resources and processes. Supports the development and maintenance of relationships with pre-sale team and partners. Self-identifies and selects top 5 to 10 go-to partners on proactive and early engagement in opportunities.

### **Solution Design and Proof**

Applies and customizes existing demonstration assets. Demonstrates and oversees demonstrations (e.g., custom demos, architectural design sessions [ADS], proof of concept [POC] sessions with partners) of solutions based on multiple Microsoft products through early stage engagements. Leverages partner/customer teams as needed to prove capabilities and integration into customer environment. Reviews partner demonstrations and provides feedback to ensure alignment with Microsoft standards..

Presents, applies, and customizes architecture patterns to partners or customers or businesses and drives cross-workload support for Microsoft Solutions.

### **Technical Leadership**

Conducts group training or one-to-many events (e.g., workshops, Webinars) or leverages existing scale enablement programs to present and educate customers and colleagues on the capabilities and benefits across Microsoft solutions/products.

Monitors and responds to internal and external tech community posts, attends community calls, sessions, hackathon, etc., and acts as a mentor for their technology area. Contributes and participates in Customer Executive Briefing Center sessions. Shares best practices internally on community calls and drives recognition of Microsoft cloud solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences. Demonstrates territory-level community contribution by sharing repeatable intellectual property (IP) and mentoring others through best practices and reusable learnings.

Grows domain knowledge and practices expertise by communicating with customers, partners, and senior colleagues to expand knowledge of architecture. Builds their own readiness plan and proactively identifies learning gaps. Leads deep, hands-on technical solutioning in the primary workload for complex architecture and design decisions on AI and agentic solutions.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

**About the position:**

Design and oversee the implementation of custom-built and commercial-off-the-shelf technology solutions using Microsoft Azure and associated enterprise platforms. The Senior Solution Architect works with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate options, establish architecture direction, manage technical risk, and guide delivery teams toward scalable, secure, reliable, and cost-effective solutions

**Key responsibilities :**

**Architectural leadership**

  

* Set direction for Azure and enterprise solution architecture, aligned with organizational strategy and applicable energy-industry standards.
* Create target-state architectures, architecture decision records, reference patterns, guardrails, and technology standards for solution teams.
* Provide architectural governance across custom applications, COTS/SaaS products, integrations, data solutions, and cloud infrastructure.

**Technology roadmap and solution design**

  

* Build and maintain technology roadmaps aligned with long-term business goals, modernization priorities, and platform strategy.
* Evaluate new Azure services and emerging technologies, recommending adoption based on business value, security, scalability, operability, and total cost of ownership.
* Lead the design of complex solutions across IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, applications, integrations, data, identity, security, and operations.
* Define non-functional requirements for performance, availability, resiliency, recoverability, cybersecurity, compliance, and cost optimization.

**Stakeholder engagement and delivery guidance**

  

* Partner with business leaders, engineering functions, product teams, security, infrastructure, and operations to translate requirements into feasible architecture.
* Communicate technical strategies, trade-offs, risks, and investment options to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor architects, technical leads, and engineering squads; conduct design reviews and support complex delivery decisions.
* Promote innovation, architecture reuse, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.

**Compliance, risk, and vendor management**

  

* Ensure solutions meet Chevron requirements and applicable safety, environmental, operational, privacy, cybersecurity, and regulatory obligations.
* Identify architectural and technology risks early, develop mitigation plans, and track risks through design, delivery, and production readiness.
* Evaluate vendor products and third-party services for technical fit, interoperability, security, commercial viability, and alignment with target architecture.
* Monitor energy-industry technology trends and recommend practical adoption opportunities in cloud, data, IoT, automation, analytics, and AI.

**Required qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Overall 10-15+ years of technology experience, with significant experience in solution architecture or senior software engineering roles.
* Deep understanding of Azure architecture and IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS services; experience designing secure, scalable, reliable cloud solutions.
* Experience with cloud adoption, application modernization, migration strategy, integration architecture, and enterprise security.
* Strong analytical ability, root-cause analysis, and long-term technical problem resolution.
* Ability to develop strategic technology plans aligned with business objectives and delivery constraints.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to provide technical direction, make architecture decisions, and mentor architects and engineers.

**Job Description:**  
Job Summary
  
We are looking for a BI solutions architect to design, build, and maintain platform level BI solutions while owning the governance, security, and administration of the Microsoft Fabric environment and other similar BI tools.
  
  
This role combines hands-on BI development (data modeling, DAX, reports/dashboards) with platform administration responsibilities — capacity management, workspace governance, security policies, data lineage, and compliance across the Fabric ecosystem (Power BI, Data Factory, Lakehouse/Warehouse, OneLake).

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Administer a large enterprise Microsoft Fabric tenant including capacities, workspaces, domains, and licensing.
* Define, implement, and enforce platform best practices, naming conventions, workspace structure, environment promotion (Dev/Test/Prod), automated processes and lifecycle management.

* Build and optimize data models using DAX, Power Query (M), and best practices for star-schema design.
* Collaborate with technical stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable BI solutions.
* Implement Row-Level Security (RLS) and Object-Level Security (OLS) as needed.
* Establish and maintain data lineage, cataloging, and metadata management practices.
* Define and enforce certification/endorsement processes for datasets and reports (Certified/Promoted content).
* Ensure compliance with data privacy and security regulations (e.g., LGPD, GDPR) as applicable.

Required Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 3 years of hands-on experience developing solutions in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, Power Query).
* Experience administering Microsoft Fabric (or Power BI Premium/Power BI admin portal) — capacities, workspaces, tenant settings.
* Solid understanding of data governance principles: security, access control, data lineage, cataloging, and compliance.
* Experience with Row-Level Security (RLS), sensitivity labels, and Microsoft Purview (or similar data governance tools).
* Experience working with Fabric/Synapse Notebooks and PySpark for data transformation, exploration, and pipeline development within Lakehouses.
* Experience with Python, Pyspark, SQL, REST APIs for automation and administration tasks.
* Strong communication skills, able to translate technical governance requirements into practical guidelines for business users.

Key Skills
  
  

* Power BI (Desktop, Service, Report Builder)
* DAX Power Query (M)
* Microsoft Fabric Administration (Capacities, Tenant Settings, Domains)

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact by architecting solutions that transform tax operations for one of the world's most innovative companies. You'll work at the intersection of tax domain expertise and modern cloud technologies, creating elegant technical solutions that directly improve how Amazon's tax team operates at a global scale.

Design and implement scalable tax technology solutions using Python, generative AI, and modern development practices to solve complex tax processing challenges

Your day blends creative problem-solving with hands-on technical work. The Direct Tax Technology team sits within Amazon's Tax organization and is dedicated to supporting tax professionals in the Tax Reporting and Compliance group with innovative technology solutions and streamlined processes. Our team tackles the unique and complex challenges that come with operating at Amazon's scale, building systems that enhance processing efficiency and empower our internal customers.
  
  
We foster a culture of innovation and collaboration where technical excellence meets business impact. Our mission is to continuously evolve tax technology capabilities, ensuring our tax professionals have the tools they need to succeed. Join a team where your work directly influences how Amazon manages tax compliance and reporting, and where you'll have opportunities to explore emerging technologies like generative AI while growing your skills alongside talented engineers and architects.

1a6e264e.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Job Profile Summary**
The Senior AI Solutions Architect is an advanced subject matter expert responsible for shaping, validating and assuring complex artificial intelligence solutions during the opportunity-to-order lifecycle.
  
  
The role operates as the primary technical and delivery interlock between regional go-to-market teams and the Global AI Delivery Unit. It enables sellers and regional solution teams to access AI delivery expertise without requiring core delivery resources to become extensively engaged in routine pre-sales activity.
  
  
The Senior AI Solutions Architect works with clients, sales teams, solution teams, commercial management, delivery leaders and specialist technical teams to translate business needs into secure, scalable, commercially viable and delivery-ready AI solutions.
  
  
The role contributes to, or leads, the development of solution architectures, prototypes and proofs of concept where required. It validates solution feasibility, delivery scope, resource requirements, effort estimates, commercial assumptions, delivery risks and contractual commitments before NTT DATA enters into a client agreement.
  
  
As part of the Global AI Delivery Unit, the role helps protect delivery outcomes and the AI Delivery P&L by ensuring that proposed solutions have an appropriate delivery structure, cost-recovery model, risk position and transition plan before customer signature.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Deal intake and GTM interlock**

* Act as the primary technical and delivery interlock for assigned AI opportunities from qualified intake through solution approval, contracting and handover to delivery.
* Engage with regional GTM, sales and solution teams early in the opportunity lifecycle to understand the client’s business problem, intended outcomes, technical environment, data landscape and commercial requirements.
* Assess whether the opportunity is sufficiently qualified for Global AI Delivery engagement and identify any additional information, discovery or customer validation required.
* Review use-case descriptions and business requirements to assess whether the proposed use of AI is appropriate, feasible and aligned with measurable client outcomes.
* Support structured discovery sessions with clients and internal stakeholders, translating business requirements into actionable technical and delivery requirements.
* Identify the specialist capabilities required to support the pursuit and coordinate targeted engagement from Global AI Delivery Unit, security, legal, commercial and regional delivery teams.
* Manage the involvement of delivery specialists carefully, ensuring that delivery expertise is used for material design decisions and specialist validation without drawing delivery teams unnecessarily into general pre-sales activity.
* Maintain clear communication with opportunity owners regarding solution status, outstanding decisions, risks, dependencies and readiness for assurance.

**AI solution architecture and design**

* Shape or own the end-to-end architecture of AI solutions across application, model, data, integration, infrastructure and security domains.
* Evaluate architecture options and select appropriate AI models, cloud services, orchestration frameworks and third-party technologies, balancing cost, performance, scalability, security and delivery complexity.
* Define secure integration, functional and non-functional requirements, data governance and responsible AI requirements for the proposed solution.
* Align solutions with NTT DATA reference architectures, reusable assets, delivery patterns and approved technology standards.

**Prototyping and feasibility validation**

* Develop, lead or coordinate prototypes and proofs of concept where required to validate feasibility, reduce delivery risk or demonstrate the proposed solution.
* Test material assumptions relating to model performance, data, integration, security, scalability, latency and consumption cost, with clear success and exit criteria.
* Translate prototype findings into the production architecture, estimate, assumptions and risk position, engaging specialist engineering support where required.

**Delivery planning and resource model**

* Translate the solution into a realistic delivery approach covering workstreams, deliverables, milestones, dependencies and mobilisation.
* Define or validate the resource model, effort estimates, skills, location strategy and use of global delivery centres, partners or subcontractors.
* Assess delivery timelines and define appropriate governance, roles, responsibilities, escalation and change control.
* Identify requirements for managed services, production support, model monitoring, platform operations or continuous optimisation where applicable.

**Commercial solution development**

* Work with commercial, finance, sales and delivery stakeholders to develop a commercial construct aligned to the architecture and delivery model.
* Validate estimates, rate-card assumptions, third-party costs, consumption charges and contingency, ensuring all material delivery costs are represented.
* Ensure the resource model, delivery estimate, pricing, contribution and margin assumptions remain internally consistent, with uncertainty managed through appropriate commercial mechanisms.
* Support pricing and approval processes and challenge commercial constructs that create unmanageable technical or delivery risk for NTT DATA.

**Scope and statement-of-work development**

* Support the drafting and review of proposals and statements of work, defining scope, deliverables, milestones, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, client responsibilities and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure contractual artefacts accurately reflect the approved architecture, delivery approach, resource plan and commercial model, without ambiguous or unbounded commitments.
* Coordinate legal, security, data protection and responsible AI input and support negotiation of technical and delivery-related contractual terms.

**Deal assurance and governance**

* Assess the completeness and quality of the proposed solution across architecture, technical feasibility, delivery readiness, resource requirements, commercial consistency and risk treatment.
* Identify material technical, data, security, privacy, legal, commercial and delivery risks and ensure appropriate owners and mitigations are in place.
* Prepare and present assigned opportunities for relevant assurance and approval gates, coordinating required stakeholder review and sign-off.
* Provide a clear, evidence-based assurance recommendation: proceed, proceed subject to conditions, return for rework or do not proceed in the proposed form.
* Track assurance conditions, escalate material concerns and maintain appropriate decision records; ensure independent review where the architect has materially developed the solution.

**Transition and handover to delivery**

* Maintain a controlled solution baseline through contracting and mobilisation, ensuring material changes are reflected consistently across deal artefacts.
* Lead the transition to delivery, providing the approved architecture, scope, commercial baseline, resource plan, assumptions, dependencies, risks and client commitments.
* Support early mobilisation, resolve gaps between what was sold and what is being delivered, and capture feedback to improve future solutioning and estimates.

**Reuse and capability development**

* Contribute reusable AI architectures, delivery patterns, prototypes, estimation models, proposal assets and commercial assumptions informed by pursuit and delivery experience.
* Share knowledge, coach regional teams and continuously improve the methods, templates and governance controls used by the AI Deal Intake, Assurance & Governance function.

**Knowledge and Attributes**

* Advanced enterprise solution architecture knowledge across application, integration, data, infrastructure, cloud and security domains.
* Strong understanding of AI, generative AI and agentic AI solution patterns, including model selection and evaluation, RAG, prompting, grounding, data pipelines, APIs and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of major cloud platforms and their AI, data, integration and security capabilities, with working knowledge of software engineering, DevOps, MLOps and LLMOps.
* Ability to develop or lead prototypes and assess the path from proof of concept to a secure, scalable and supportable production solution.
* Strong understanding of security, privacy, compliance, data governance and responsible AI considerations.
* Commercial acumen across estimates, rate cards, pricing models, third-party costs, contribution, margin, contingency and cost recovery.
* Understanding of statements of work, contractual assumptions, acceptance criteria, client dependencies, change control and delivery transition.
* Strong client-facing consulting, communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical, commercial, delivery and executive audiences.
* Ability to exercise constructive challenge, make evidence-based decisions and manage multiple complex opportunities under demanding pursuit timelines.
* Strong analytical capability and attention to detail when reviewing solution, commercial and contractual artefacts.

**Academic Qualifications And Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, engineering, data science, information systems, business or a related field.
* Relevant cloud or AI certification from Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform is preferred.
* Enterprise or solution architecture certification such as TOGAF is advantageous; additional AI, security, privacy, agile, project or service-management certifications are beneficial.

**Ideal / Desired Experience**

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as a trusted technical partner to customers, acting as the primary point of contact for technical guidance, system optimization, and issue coordination after implementation. **COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. **ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.
  
  
If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
  
  
**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
  
  
For more information, visit https://legion.co

* Strong third-party management experience, especially as part of a complex delivery programme, including the effective management of risk.
* Ability to convert complex plans to a clear, update for senior stakeholders.
* Made decisions in ambiguous situations using incomplete information or differing opinions (eg divided team loyalties or unclear deliverables).

BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
  
  
BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
  
  
Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
  
  
We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

0eb58e8b.title: Lead Technical Program Manager, Network Delivery
0eb58e8b.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.
* 5 years of experience in leadership role with/without direct reports.
* Experience in technical program management.
* Experience in a people management or team leadership role.
* Experience in technical program management for network infrastructure delivery.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 8 years of experience managing cross-functional/team projects.
* Experience with network certifications such as PMP, Agile project management, BICSI RCDD, BICSI RTPM, CCDE, CCNP, or CCIE.
* Experience designing and facilitating the implementation of networking data centers or colocation facilities.
* Experience managing technical vendors and leading quarterly business reviews.
* Experience working in integrated teams composed of both technical and non-technical members.

**About the job**
Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in product development with engineers.
  
  
Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage various Engineering-specific programs and teams.
  
  
As a Technical Program Manager focused on Enterprise Network Delivery, you'll work on the Google Enterprise Network team to ensure the security, reliability, scalability, and automation of one of the largest enterprise networks in the world. You will define priorities based on our Objectives and Key Results (OKR's) to drive network product development and life-cycle decisions. You will be working with Network Engineers, Software Engineers, and Operations teams to ensure new solutions meet Operational needs and drive out technical debt and design/deployment snowflakes. Technical Program Manager in Generative AI (GEN) solves testing problems relating to efficient scaling, security and high availability as Google continues to push the boundaries for innovative new technologies.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage and drive the development and delivery of enterprise network engineering products while leveraging automation and software programs by coordinating with global delivery teams across the company to facilitate efficient network services to customers.
* Partner with Network Engineers, Software Engineers, and Project Managers to deliver large technical networking projects.
* Develop reports to track scope, schedule, budget, risks, and overall project status; coordinate with stakeholders to manage, track, and control project issues to ensure timely delivery.
* Work with management to design and launch new processes, institute process improvements, and ensure the efficient/reliable achievement of process objectives.
* Manage third-party vendors responsible for the monitoring and troubleshooting of network services, including facilitating any escalations requiring engineering assistance.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

dea61405.title: Senior Client Solutions Manager - X (Twitter) Ads
dea61405.description:
**Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?**
At
**Aleph**
, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
  
  
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
  
  
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.
  
  
As Senior Client Solutions Manager for X in India, you will be the day-to-day link between our advertisers, their agencies and the teams that run their campaigns. You will own client relationships end to end, from planning and launch through to optimisation and review. This is not a coordination-only role. You will step in on campaigns and help with set-up and troubleshooting where it matters or when your judgement says it will move results faster. You are expected to understand how campaigns are built and optimised, explain it clearly to clients, and push back when a request will not deliver the result they want.
  
  
**Location: Gurgaon (office-based, 3 days a week in office)**
**What you will do :-**

* Own and grow relationships with advertisers and agencies on X, acting as their primary point of contact
* Understand client business goals and turn them into campaign plans, media plans and proposals
* Guide campaign set-up, targeting, creative and budget decisions. Step in hands-on where needed to setup, launch and optimize campaigns
* Monitor performance, spot issues early and recommend optimisations that improve results
* Prepare and present campaign reports, post-campaign analyses and quarterly business reviews
* Handle client and agency queries, objections and escalations calmly and professionally
* Work closely with X's partner and product teams to raise requests, access new features and resolve blockers
* Support billing, approvals and collections follow-ups with clients and agencies
* Bring market and category insights back to the team and help build a stronger book of business in North India

**What you bring :-**
**Must have :-**

* 4 to 8 years of experience in client servicing, account management or client solutions within digital advertising, a media agency, an ad platform or a performance marketing team
* Hands-on experience running or optimising paid performance campaigns (for example X, Meta, Google or programmatic)
* Strong command of performance metrics such as CPM, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS and conversion tracking
* Confident communicator who can hold a client conversation, handle objections and manage demanding agency stakeholders
* Strong presentation and reporting skills, including building clear decks and campaign summaries
* Comfortable working across clients, agencies and internal teams at the same time

**Good to have :-**

* Experience on X Ads or other social and video platforms
* Exposure to sectors such as auto, BFSI, gaming, tech or e-commerce
* Existing relationships with agencies or advertisers in North India

**Where You Will Work :-**
Our office is in Gurgaon, and this role requires 3 days a week in the office. Candidates based in Delhi, Noida or nearby are welcome to apply, provided they are comfortable commuting to Gurgaon.
  
  
**Why Aleph :-**
You will work with leading advertisers and agencies on one of the world's most influential media platforms, as part of a team that values ownership, clear thinking and straight talk. You will have room to grow with the India business as it scales.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.
  
  
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.
  
  
#ALEPH
  
  
We use Lever, our recruitment management platform, which includes AI-powered features that may assist our hiring team in reviewing applications, analyzing CVs, and identifying relevant qualifications. These tools support - but do not replace - human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by people. For more information about how your personal data is processed, including your rights in relation to AI-assisted processing, please see our Candidate Privacy Policy.
