ce94f836.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Finance Operations (FinOps) is seeking an L5 Program Manager to lead AI Governance Enablement across FinOps Service Centers (SCs). This role will design and operationalize governance frameworks that ensure AI solutions built by employees move from prototype to production responsibly — meeting security, compliance, and data privacy standards without slowing innovation. This role requires someone who can build structure where none exists, translate complex regulatory requirements into actionable guidance, and serve as the bridge between builders and governance teams.  
  
You will own the governance enablement pipeline — tracking solutions from ideation through formal sign-off, building self-service toolkits that help builders get it right the first time, and partnering with FinOps Risk Governance (FORGE) and Controllership teams to ensure every solution meets the bar before deployment. Success is measured not by how many solutions you block, but by how many you help clear — faster, with fewer iterations, and with full compliance intact.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and maintain governance enablement frameworks that guide employees from prototype to production-ready solutions, reducing rework and accelerating time-to-clearance
* Build self-service toolkits, checklists, and playbooks that help builders understand what "good" looks like before they submit for formal review
* Create role-specific governance guidance for different solution types (automation, agentic AI, data-driven tools) across regulatory environments

  
Partnership with Amazon Responsible AI / FORGE / Controllership
  

* Serve as the operational bridge between builders and FORGE — ensuring solutions arrive at review well-prepared and complete
* Maintain regular cadence with Amazon Responsible AI and FORGE teams to stay current on evolving standards, policy updates, and compliance requirements
* Identify patterns in review feedback and work with FORGE to create scalable solutions that address recurring gaps

  
Risk Visibility & Monitoring  

* Own the AI solution risk register — tracking all active prototypes, their governance status, risk classification, and deployment readiness
* Build and maintain governance dashboards that provide leadership with real-time visibility into pipeline health, clearance rates, and compliance posture
* Conduct periodic risk assessments across deployed solutions and flag emerging concerns before they become incidents

  
Governance Awareness & Culture  

* Drive governance awareness programs that help employees understand why governance exists and how to work with it — not around it
* Support AI Prototyping Camps with on-the-ground governance guidance, helping builders embed compliance from day one

a47d7670.description:
**Lyzr, in a minute**
=====================

Lyzr is an enterprise software company that helps large organisations put AI agents — software that handles real tasks on its own — to work in their everyday operations. Most companies’ AI projects never move past the pilot stage; Lyzr provides the platform that takes them into dependable, day-to-day use. Today, 500+ enterprises build on Lyzr, more than 1,000 agents run live in production, and 85% of Lyzr projects reach production against an industry average of roughly 30%. Customers include Accenture, WTW, Hitachi, and Verifone, and the company recently raised $100M at a $500M valuation.

Our Presales team is where enterprise leaders decide that AI agents are worth serious investment. This

**The role**
============

This is a sales role, not a delivery one. You join an opportunity when it reaches solution validation and are its technical owner for the rest of the sales cycle, as part of the team that works the deal: the Account Executive, who owns the deal and orchestrates it; the Reimaginer Consultants, who build the client's baseline and the business case; the prototyping teams, who build and demo the proof; the Sales Engineer, who owns the functional requirements; and the Bid Manager, who runs RFP responses.

**What you will own**

* The IT discussion during solution validation: how Lyzr fits the client's architecture, systems and data, how it is deployed, and how it integrates.

* Security: answering security questionnaires and InfoSec reviews with the Sales Engineer, and taking the client's security and risk teams through how the platform handles their data.

* The client's sandbox or environment, set up with the Sales Engineer so the client can try Lyzr on its own ground.

* The technical answers inside RFP, RFX and RFI responses, written for the Bid Manager, who runs the response end to end.

* The technical side of the business case, as it goes through the client's IT, security and risk reviews.

* Knowing when a question needs platform engineering, and keeping the deal team informed of where the technical conversation stands.

**What will make you win this role**
====================================

* 8 years or more in solutions architecture, pre-sales engineering or technical consulting for enterprise software, with time spent on the selling side of complex deals.

* Hands-on depth in at least one of AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and in enterprise integration: APIs, identity and single sign-on, data platforms and networking.

* A working understanding of large language models, retrieval, and how AI agents are built, orchestrated and governed in production.

* Fluency in enterprise security and compliance - SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA - and experience answering security questionnaires and leading InfoSec reviews.

* Experience with SaaS, private cloud and on-premises deployment, and the trade-offs a client weighs between them.

* The ability to draw an architecture and explain it to a CIO, a CISO and an engineer in the same meeting, and to write a clear technical answer to a deadline.

Good to have

* A cloud architecture certification from AWS, Microsoft or Google.

* Experience selling into regulated industries - banking, insurance, healthcare.

**Life at Lyzr**
================

* Benefits. Zomato meal allowance, an extensive PTO policy, and company-paid subscriptions to leading AI tools — you work with the same tooling our customers rely on.
* Hybrid structure. Office days for collaboration and team problem-solving; remote days for deep, uninterrupted work.
* An exceptional team. You will work alongside genuinely strong engineers and operators — the kind of colleagues who raise the level of everyone around them.
* Autonomy and ownership. We hire people who think like founders. You are given a problem and the space to drive your own outcomes — and with them, your own growth.
* Everybody is a visionary. Ideas are evaluated on merit, not seniority. You lead projects, make decisions, and shape what Lyzr becomes.

60b714ae.title: Manager - Pre Sales & Solution Consulting
60b714ae.description:
**About AbleCredit**
AbleCredit helps banks, NBFCs, and housing finance companies make faster, better-informed lending decisions through technology-enabled field verification, income estimation, borrower verification, and post disbursement portfolio monitoring. Our solutions enable financial institutions to improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, and accelerate lending decisions.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for a Manager – Pre-Sales & Solution Consulting to bridge the gap between customer requirements and our product capabilities.
  
  
As part of the Sales team, you will engage with prospective clients to understand their business processes, lending workflows, and operational challenges. You will evaluate solution feasibility, define the scope of Proof of Concepts (POCs), and work closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to design solutions that align with customer requirements.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving business problems, collaborating across teams, and translating customer needs into practical product solutions. While you will work closely with the Sales team, your primary responsibility is to ensure technical and business feasibility before a commercial commitment is made.
  
  
**What You'll Do?**

* Understand prospective clients' lending workflows, operational processes, and business challenges through discovery sessions.
* Gather, analyse, and document business requirements to determine how AbleCredit's platform can address customer needs.
* Conduct feasibility assessments for new client use cases and identify any product or implementation gaps.
* Define the scope, objectives, success criteria, assumptions, and timelines for client POCs.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Sales teams to design practical and scalable solutions.
* Recommend configuration approaches or process improvements based on customer requirements.
* Identify implementation risks, dependencies, and constraints early in the sales cycle.
* Support customer meetings by presenting solution workflows, product capabilities, and proposed approaches.
* Coordinate internal stakeholders to ensure POCs are well planned and executed as designed.
* Create clear solution documentation, requirement specifications, process flows, and implementation notes.
* Provide structured customer feedback to Product teams to support future product enhancements.
* Ensure a seamless handover of validated opportunities to the implementation or Customer Success teams once commercial discussions begin.

**What We're Looking For?**

* 2–4 years of experience in Pre-Sales, Solution Consulting, Solution Engineering, Business Analysis, Product Consulting, Implementation Consulting, or a similar customer-facing role within a B2B SaaS, FinTech, or enterprise technology environment.
* Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into solution designs.
* Ability to understand business processes and evaluate solution feasibility.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage business and operational teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
* Experience coordinating with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, Operations, and Sales.
* Ability to manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable preparing documentation such as business requirements, solution proposals, process flows, and POC plans.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working with banks, NBFCs, lending platforms, or other BFSI organisations.
* Understanding of lending operations, credit workflows, field verification, or loan origination processes.
* Experience supporting enterprise software implementations or Proof of Concepts.
* Familiarity with APIs, system integrations, or workflow automation concepts.
* Experience using CRM and project management tools.

**What Success Looks Like?**

* Customer requirements are accurately understood and translated into well-defined solution plans.
* Feasibility assessments are completed with minimal rework during implementation.
* POCs are scoped clearly with realistic timelines and measurable success criteria.
* Strong collaboration between Sales, Product, and Engineering throughout the pre-sales lifecycle.
* Smooth transition of qualified opportunities to implementation teams with complete documentation and minimal knowledge gaps.

Skills:- enterprise account management, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Stakeholder management, customer engagement, client communication, proof of concept, pilot management, trial management, solution demonstration and Solution selling

792bc887.title: Professional Services Solution Consultant
792bc887.description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
Role summary:
  
  
The Solution Consultant is a trusted advisor and hands-on solution partner within Professional Services. The role combines solution consulting, business and product analysis, technical understanding, stakeholder management, project management, and disciplined delivery thinking.
  
  
Working across agency and client teams, Product, Engineering, Growth, Enablement, Training, Support and delivery colleagues, the consultant discovers needs, shapes requirements, designs and demonstrates solutions, supports scoping and implementation, and feeds learning back into reusable patterns and product improvements.
  
  
Success means clients and WPP teams understand what is possible, requirements are clear before delivery starts, proven capabilities are configured appropriately, hand-offs are clean, and repeatable solutions can be deployed with less friction and faster time to value.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  
Discovery & requirements:
  
  

* Lead structured discovery with agency, client and internal stakeholders to understand objectives, users, workflows, data, constraints and expected outcomes.
* Analyse current-state processes, usage and needs, separating problems to solve from requested features.
* Translate needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, solution specifications and, where required, scope inputs for statements of work.
* Identify dependencies, assumptions, risks and gaps early, and ensure the right Product, Engineering, Enterprise Solutions or Professional Services owners are engaged.

Solution design & consulting:
  
  

* Map business needs to proven, ready-to-deploy WPP Open capabilities and recommend an appropriate foundation or configured solution.
* Design and present solution options that explain the value, trade-offs, dependencies and delivery implications in language suited to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Create and deliver demonstrations that show how selected WPP Open capabilities address the defined use case.
* Support business-case and value-realisation thinking by linking the proposed solution to measurable client or operational outcomes.

Technical & platform expertise:
  
  

* Build and maintain strong knowledge of WPP Open architecture, capabilities, agents, configuration options, data and integration touchpoints.
* Stay current on platform releases, capabilities and deployment guidance, and distinguish proven, scalable capabilities from functionality still in development or testing.

Delivery partnership & quality:
  
  

* Partner with Project Managers, Product Analysts, Deployment Specialists, Configuration Admins and implementation teams from scope through go-live and handover.
* Ensure solution intent, requirements and acceptance criteria remain traceable through configuration, testing and delivery.
* Support UAT, solution validation and issue resolution, escalating material scope, quality or dependency risks through the appropriate delivery route.
* Contribute to clear handovers into Enablement, Training or Support where those teams own the next stage of adoption.

Project management & delivery coordination:
  
  

* Develop and maintain clear delivery plans that define milestones, dependencies, ownership, decision points and critical path activities for assigned engagements.
* Coordinate day-to-day project activity across stakeholders, ensuring actions are tracked, blockers are surfaced early and progress remains visible to the right delivery and leadership audiences.
* Maintain disciplined RAID management, including proactive identification of risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, with clear mitigation plans and escalation routes.
* Support governance routines such as status reporting, checkpoint reviews, decision logs and delivery readiness assessments, ensuring stakeholders have confidence in progress and next steps.
* Balance speed, scope and quality by making delivery trade-offs explicit, aligning expectations early and ensuring changes are assessed for impact before commitments are made.
* Drive clean closure by confirming acceptance criteria, documenting outcomes, capturing lessons learned and ensuring handover routes are agreed before the engagement is considered complete.

Scale, product feedback & continuous improvement:
  
  

* Convert lessons from engagements into reusable solution patterns, templates, playbooks and configuration standards.
* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on recurring client needs, friction, feature gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Help standardise intake and scoping so requests arrive with the information needed to route and estimate work accurately.
* Use delivery and usage evidence to identify opportunities to improve solution quality, reduce avoidable effort and accelerate time to value.

Stakeholder relationships:
  
  

* Act as a credible, pragmatic bridge between business, product and technology stakeholders.
* Build trust through transparent recommendations, clear documentation, realistic commitments and proactive communication.
* Work collaboratively across WPP, maintaining client-team ownership of client relationships while providing the expertise needed to make good solution decisions.

Skills & experience:
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in solutions consulting, business analysis, product analysis, implementation consulting or a comparable role, ideally within marketing technology or professional services.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with experience turning ambiguous business needs into structured, actionable requirements and solution options.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation and facilitation skills, including the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience working across product, engineering, delivery and commercial stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery and backlog practices, including user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritisation.
* Ability to manage and coordinate the intake of features and change requests, clarifying need, priority, impact and ownership so requests can be translated into actionable outcomes.
* Understanding of digital marketing technology and related cloud, data, integration and workflow concepts.
* Experience with platform implementation, configuration, adoption or service design is advantageous.
* Experience with WPP Open, agent deployment, API integration, data modelling, Jira/Confluence or process-mapping tools
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, make sound trade-offs and maintain high-quality documentation and stakeholder communication.

Working principles:
  
  

* Client value first: recommend capability because it improves an outcome, not simply because it exists.
* Deliver what is available: favour proven, ready-to-deploy capabilities and be explicit about anything that is not yet scaled.
* Enable the enablers: design solutions and handovers so administrators, champions and enablement teams can sustain adoption.
* Client teams stay in control: provide expertise behind the scenes while respecting ownership of client conversations and ongoing relationships.

The person:
  
  
You are curious, structured and commercially aware, with enough technical depth to be credible with engineers and enough empathy and communication skill to make complexity understandable. You are comfortable challenging unclear requirements, bringing the right people together and turning a good bespoke answer into a better repeatable pattern. Above all, you focus on outcomes: dependable delivery that builds trust, scalable ways of working and faster realisation of value from WPP Open.
  
  
**Who you are:**
**You're open
*:***
we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
  
  
**You're optimistic
*:***
we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
  
  
**You're extraordinary:**
We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
  
  
**What we'll give you:**
**Passionate, inspired people**
– we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work
  
  
**Scale and opportunity**
– we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
  
  
**Challenging and stimulating work**
– unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.
  
  
**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**
**WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.**
**Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.**

5b733870.title: Solutions Consultant
5b733870.description:
**About YABX**

Yabx is a global FinTech venture of Mahindra Comviva aimed at simplifying financial access to the 2 Bn+ under-banked people in the emerging markets of Africa, Asia, and Latin America. We use technology and analytics to reduce the cost of delivering financial services. In doing so, we partner with leading Telecom Operators, Banks, MFI's, Credit Bureaus, Mobile Financial Providers & handset vendors. Yabx’s mission is to create world-class innovative products to improve the lives of these people.

Yabx was incubated by Mahindra Comviva and operates between The Hague, New Delhi, and Nairobi. We are a team of industry experts and entrepreneurs with global experience.

**Work Location-**
Gurgaon

**Total Experience-**
6-8 years

**Qualification-**
MBA / MCA / M.Tech /B.Sc/B. Tech

**Position-**
Solution Consultant

**Reports To**
-VP – Solution Consulting

**Objective of the role**

We work in the Digital-lending space offering various credit products to the unbanked population. This role will primary be responsible for building and delivering embedded solutions to our partners on our Core platform

**Roles and Responsibilities – Solution Consultant**

**1. Product Solutioning & Design**

* Understand partner requirements, business objectives, customer segments, and market dynamics to design digital lending solutions.
* Develop end-to-end product constructs for Term Loans, Overdrafts, BNPL, Merchant Lending, Device Financing, and other embedded credit products.
* Define product features, eligibility criteria, customer journeys, pricing structures, repayment mechanisms, and operational workflows.
* Translate business requirements into solution concepts aligned with YABX's platform capabilities and partner infrastructure.

**2. Presales & Partner Engagement**

* Work closely with the Sales and Business Development teams to support new banking and strategic partnership opportunities.
* Prepare compelling product propositions, solution presentations, concept notes, and proposals tailored to partner requirements.
* Participate in partner workshops, product discovery sessions, solution demonstrations, and technical discussions.
* Support RFP/RFI responses, bid documentation, solution architecture discussions, and commercial proposals.

**3. Business Case Development & Commercial Solutioning**

* Develop business cases and financial models for proposed digital lending programs, including portfolio projections, revenue potential, pricing, and unit economics.
* Conduct market research, competitive benchmarking, and product feasibility assessments across geographies.
* Support the evaluation of commercial structures, including implementation fees, revenue-sharing arrangements, and partnership economics.
* Use data-driven insights to recommend product enhancements and identify opportunities for portfolio expansion.

**4. Business Requirements & Technical Solution Alignment**

* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), process flows, user journeys, and product specifications.
* Work with internal Product, Engineering, Credit Risk, Data Science, and Delivery teams to translate partner requirements into implementable solutions.
* Understand and document integration requirements covering APIs, core banking systems, loan management systems, payment channels, and third-party services.
* Identify functional dependencies, integration requirements, solution gaps, and potential implementation risks.

**5. Product Implementation & Go-Live Support**

* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure solutions are delivered in line with agreed business requirements and partner expectations.
* Support product configuration, business validation, UAT planning, test-case preparation, and issue resolution.
* Participate in implementation reviews, track functional dependencies, and support timely resolution of delivery blockers.
* Assist with pilot execution, go-live readiness, product launches, and post-launch stabilization.

**6. Product Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor key product performance indicators, including customer adoption, loan disbursements, utilization, repayment behavior, and portfolio performance.
* Analyze product performance and partner feedback to identify opportunities for optimization and enhancement.
* Recommend improvements to customer journeys, credit product features, operational efficiency, and platform capabilities.
* Maintain awareness of emerging digital lending trends, regulatory developments, and competitive propositions across relevant markets.

**7. Stakeholder Management & Execution Ownership**

* Act as a functional point of contact for assigned partner engagements, ensuring clear communication and timely closure of solutioning activities.
* Drive assigned opportunities from initial discovery through solution finalization and implementation handover.
* Maintain structured trackers for partner requirements, deliverables, action items, dependencies, and outstanding decisions.
* Demonstrate ownership, analytical thinking, structured problem-solving, and the ability to manage multiple partner engagements simultaneously.

6f76e062.title: Cloud Technical Solutions Engineer, Data Analytics
6f76e062.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
* 9 years of experience with two or more of the following: Web Technologies, Big Data, Apache Spark, Systems Administration, or Machine Learning.
* Experience reading or debugging code using Java, C, C++, .NET, Python, Shell, Perl, or JavaScript.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with Linux/Unix or other operating systems (Kernel to Shell, file systems, client-server protocols).
* Knowledge in Web application development/deployment, HTTP/RESTful API troubleshooting, or database design/troubleshooting.
* Understanding of Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, Routing, VPNs).
* Ability to consistently demonstrate a well-developed systematic, logical troubleshooting methodology for each customer issue.
* Ability to quickly assess customer issues to determine impact, scope, and to create next steps for troubleshooting.

**About the job**
-----------------

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

In this role, you will be part of a global team that provides support to help customers seamlessly make the switch to Google Cloud. When customers cannot resolve issues themselves, your job is to ensure that we have the necessary tools and processes to resolve the issue. You will troubleshoot technical problems for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, updating documentation, and when needed, coding/scripting. You will make our products easier to adopt and to use by making improvements to the product, tools, processes, and documentation. You will help drive the success and business growth of Google Cloud by understanding and advocating for our customers’ issues.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage customer problems through effective diagnosis, resolution or implementation of investigation tools to increase productivity for customer issues on Google Cloud Platform products.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of Google Cloud Data Analytics products (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Composer) and underlying architectures by troubleshooting, reproducing, and determining the root cause for customer-reported issues, building tools for faster diagnosis.
* Act as consultant and subject matter expert for internal stakeholders in engineering, sales, and customer organizations to resolve technical deployment obstacles and improve Google Cloud.
* Work as part of a team of engineers/consultants that globally ensure 24-hour customer support, including working non-standard work hours/shifts, and may include weekend work.
* Advocate customer issues and their needs with cross-functional teams, including product and engineering teams to find ways to improve the product and drive quality production.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

debf9cce.title: Solutions Engineer (EMEA Shift)
debf9cce.description:
**About Glean**
Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.
  
  
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
  
  
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
  
  
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Solution Engineer role sits within the GTM organisation in India, making you a trusted technical advisor to the local sales team, our partners, and our customers. In this role, you will support the EMEA region, working closely with EMEA Account Executives, partners, and customers. You will work on exciting projects with some of the most forward-thinking organisations, helping guide the start of their Generative AI journeys. This role has a strong technical skill set and is not a classic SE profile. At Glean, our Solution Engineers work with our customers to help them connect Glean to their most important decision-making platforms. These platforms include Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Zendesk, and everything in between! As an SE, you will work closely with our Account Executives (AEs) and will be responsible for the technical success and delivery of our sales opportunities.
  
  
**You Will**

* Perform interactive demonstrations of the Glean platform to prospective customers.
* Educate the technical teams of our prospective customers on the architecture of the Glean platform, specifically articulating the "how" of how our solution works in the context of the customer landscape.
* Scope and execute sponsored pilot and Proof of Value (PoV) exercises to ensure the technical requirements and business objectives that the Glean solution provides are validated.
* Educate and train our customers and partners on our product to ensure that they are set up for success.
* Present at company-sponsored events such as Google Cloud Next and AWS re:Invent.
* Liaise with Glean product managers and engineers to investigate issues, raise feature requests, and understand our future roadmap.

**About You**

* You have a bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* You have at least 4+ years of experience in enterprise software pre-sales and have used value-based discovery frameworks.
* You possess excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to handle complex technical challenges.
* You are able to explain complex technical concepts in layman's terms to help educate and train our customers, prospects, and partners.
* You are comfortable presenting, both virtually and in person.
* You are familiar with cloud infrastructure (IaaS) platforms such as GCP, AWS, and Azure.
* You are familiar with identity services and Single Sign-On (SSO) providers such as Azure/Entra ID, Okta, and protocols such as SAML, SCIM, and OIDC.
* You are familiar with APIs, including sending and receiving data from API endpoints, and how to troubleshoot issues.
* You are familiar with security concepts and tools, e.g. Firewalls, VPNs, SSL/TLS, DLP, WAFs, and proxies.

**Location:**

* This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office).
* This role supports the EMEA region, with working hours of 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM IST.

**Compensation & Benefits**
Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:**
Forward Deployed Solution Engineer - CONNECT Data Services
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full time, regular, hybrid work arrangement
  
  
**The job**
The Forward Deployed Solution Engineer owns a defined technical workstream within an FDE engagement. Working within agreed architecture and standards, the role applies customer domain context to configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, validate, document, and hand over AVEVA solutions using real customer data, systems, and constraints. The role is accountable for quality, timelines, reusable technical outputs, and timely risk escalation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own a defined FDE technical workstream from implementation through validation and handover.
* Build, configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, and adapt AVEVA solutions in real customer environments.
* Apply established architecture, standards, methods, and governance to deliver reliable outcomes.
* Clarify requirements, dependencies, risks, feasibility, and implementation needs for the workstream.
* Implement creative and out of the box solutioning strategies against identified product feature gaps
* Resolve non-routine technical issues across APIs, integrations, data flows, configuration, performance, security, and deployment.
* Support demonstrations, acceptance testing, performance checks, validation, and production-readiness activities.
* Create reusable configurations, connectors, templates, AI patterns, implementation notes, and troubleshooting guidance.
* Coordinate with peers and adjacent teams, guide less-experienced contributors where appropriate, and escalate material risks early.

**Essential Skills**

* Typically, 5-8 years of relevant experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability in industrial technology implementation and technical project delivery.
* Hands-on capability in AVEVA solution configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, validation, and handover.
* Working knowledge of AVEVA products, customer domain workflows, industrial data, customer systems, APIs, cloud/edge, security, performance, and deployment constraints.
* Practical domain awareness of the customer’s operating model, workflows, KPIs, and value drivers, so the solution solves the right industrial problem.
* Ability to work within agreed architecture, standards, methodologies, governance, and engagement priorities.
* Sound judgment in resolving non-routine technical issues and escalating risks early.
* Clear customer-facing and cross-team communication skills.
* Developing AI Agents, Skills, Tools, Plugins etc. using any one of the agentic framework preferably MAF
* AI tools for SDLC like Copilot & practical awareness of AI/ML and Generative AI use cases within agreed technical, safety, and governance guidance.
* Accountability for quality, schedule, documentation, testing evidence, reusable outputs, and reliable handover.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Defined FDE technical workstreams are delivered reliably, on time, and in line with agreed architecture, standards, and customer success criteria.
* AVEVA solutions are configured, integrated, tested, validated, documented, and handed over with clear evidence of quality and operational readiness.
* Non-routine technical issues are resolved using sound judgment, with material risks, dependencies, and trade-offs escalated early.
* Reusable configurations, templates, troubleshooting notes, implementation guidance, and AI or integration patterns improve delivery quality for future FDE engagements.
* Peers, Architects, Leads, and customer-facing stakeholders view the role as a dependable technical contributor who builds confidence through practical execution, clear communication, and reliable handover.

**Services at AVEVA**
Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.
  
  
You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our
awards and recognition
.
  
  
Find out more:
https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
  
  
**Hybrid working**
We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process
  
  
**About AVEVA**
AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
  
  
AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

a4501452.description:
**Overview**

Overview

At Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team, one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry's most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation. SME&C is more than a sales organization, it's a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity.

Here, you'll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do. If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business.

Do you thrive in the room where business strategy meets technology, equally at home challenging a CxO on their AI transformation ambition, going broad with an architect, or getting deep with an engineer on what needs to be built?

As a Digital Cloud Solution Architect (DCSA), you will help customers build, migrate, and secure their foundations on Microsoft Azure, turning business priorities into secure, scalable, and resilient cloud outcomes that are ready for AI, while accelerating adoption, consumption, and measurable business value. You will be the technical partner for a portfolio of Microsoft customers, designing landing zones, hybrid connectivity, and security controls, and leading migrations that move workloads to Azure with confidence. With the support of best-in-class sales processes, techniques, and technologies, you will influence customer technical decision makers, shape solution design, and orchestrate Microsoft and partner resources to remove blockers and land outcomes. You will be accountable for driving durable cloud consumption growth, identifying expansion opportunities, and building trusted customer relationships. While the role is India based, you will collaborate across Asia and worldwide, contributing to repeatable practice beyond your own territory.

This role is flexible in that you can work up to 50% from home / 50% from a designated Microsoft office.

 **Responsibilities**

Responsibilities

* You will be a hands-on technical authority on Azure infrastructure, networking, and security, designing secure landing zones, hybrid connectivity, identity, and resilient workloads that customers can scale with confidence, with application development skills also welcome and AI experience on top of this foundation highly valued.

* You will lead migration and modernization engagements, from assessment and architecture through deployment, moving Windows and Linux workloads, data platforms, and applications from on-premises and other cloud platforms to Azure.

* You will design and validate Azure networking and security architectures, including hub-and-spoke or Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute and VPN, Azure Firewall, Private Link, and Application Gateway / WAF, aligned to Zero Trust principles.

* You will apply the Cloud Adoption and Well-Architected Frameworks to governance, identity (Entra ID), Defender for Cloud, resiliency, and BCDR, using infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform, Bicep) and DevOps practices to accelerate time to value.

* You will lead customer technical engagements across your portfolio, owning solution design, customer success outcomes, and repeatable achievement of net new revenue and consumption targets.

* You will analyze usage, business priorities, technical blockers, and competitive dynamics to identify growth opportunities, drive optimization, and accelerate cloud consumption.

* You will orchestrate across DCSAs, sales specialists, customer success teams, engineering, and partners to remove blo

 **Qualifications**

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8-10+ years experience in technical architect, technical consulting, design and implementation, and/or technical sales; OR

* Relevant certifications from Microsoft or competitive platforms AND 8+ years experience in technical architect, technical consulting, design and implementation, and/or technical sales OR 8+ years experience in technical architect, technical consulting, design and implementation, and/or technical sales; OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

d56b0782.title: ServiceNow Architect
d56b0782.description:
Location: Kochi

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: 25 Nov 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1759380

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Title – ServiceNow Architect**

**EY Technology:**

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 400,000+ people in more than 170 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

  

**The opportunity**

EY Technology is expanding the team which manages and maintains our growing internal ServiceNow platforms. This is an opportunity in a fast-paced environment working and consulting on technical projects, architecture and best practices with our world class developers, support and platform engineering staff. As a ServiceNow Architect you will become one of the go-to staff who provide strategic direction, ensures project implementation and leverages a deep understanding of the platform to ensure critical business needs are met. The goals of the ServiceNow architect are to evaluate and manage migration of new products, Support all new demands in ServiceNow across instances, Align right product in the right instance, adoption of new features including upgrades and patches. Also, answers to technical queries, provide technical guidance and act as a central resource for all things ServiceNow. This position requires you to challenge yourself to create and innovate while ensuring current and future continuity and extensibility of the platform.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

In this key role you will be responsible for working with multiple teams and internal clients to assist with the following duties:

* Acting as a technical Point of Contact for all areas of the platform
* Evaluate and manage migration of new products to ServiceNow
* Supports all new demand onboarding across products
* Instance alignment
* Adoption of new features from ServiceNow
* AI Adoption with ServiceNow
* Upgrades and security patches
* Providing Guidance on best practices
* Consulting/Advising on Solutions and providing strategic solutions
* Attempting to minimize customization
* Advising where a requirement is not feasible or advisable and highlighting risks.
* Assisting with road map development and prototyping
* Assisting with Incident resolution when needed
* Mentoring of other team members
* Ability to see (big picture) impacts of configurations or customizations beyond the current scope of work
* Ability to learn emerging or currently not in use features the tool very quickly

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

The skills you bring to our growing team will be instrumental in the success of future projects and the transformation of our platform into a more user centric experience while ensuring current and future continuity and extensibility. Your expertise will bring knowledge which can be shared with fellow staff members to present them with educational opportunities to enrich their career growth while teaching best practices. A candidate must be able to quickly adapt and learn our environment and constraints to add value to our team.

  

**To qualify for the role you must have**

* At least 6 years of design, development & administration experience of the ServiceNow platform
* Extensive experience with SOAP and REST integrations and associated security protocols
* Experience configuring, deploying and supporting HRSD, ITBM, ITOM and ITSM applications
* Experience configuring, deploying and supporting Now Assist functionalities of ServiceNow
* Experience configuring, deploying and supporting Discovery and Service Mapping
* Understand Infrastructure (equipment, OIDs, PowerShell, SSH Commands)
* Proven track record of technical leadership roles delivering complex requirements using creative and innovative methods
* Proven track record of building relationships with multiple diverse stakeholder groups to complete complex initiatives
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator
* Exceptional communication skills which allow effective communication with all ranks of stakeholders who may be technical or non-technical stakeholders
* Ability to drive initiatives with minimal supervision

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* ITIL v3 or v4 Foundations Certification
* Experience with Agile Development Methodology
* Orchestration experience
* Schedule Flexibility (we have global stakeholders)

  

**What we look for**

Our team values self-starters who demonstrate leadership skills and value the contributions of individual team members and leverage their strengths. Demonstrated technical leadership coupled with the ability to see the big picture to avoid causing technical debt or cross platform issues is a necessity. Having a ‘can do’ attitude and being able to work with and mesh well with multiple people from diverse backgrounds and negotiating diverse personalities while effectively communicating is key to this position.

**What working at EY offers**

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

3cd1db9d.title: Senior Solution Architect, Digital Products
3cd1db9d.description:
**Description**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

**D&I in USP** is looking for an accomplished, deeply technical **End-to-End Solution Architect** to join our organization as a high-impact **Individual Contributor** . Rather than focusing on a single domain such as data or full-stack development, you will own the comprehensive technical blueprint across our entire digital product ecosystem.

This is a senior, hands-on architectural position designed for a practitioner who actively writes production-grade code, builds prototypes, and conducts deep system analyses to validate architectural concepts. Your primary mandate will be to drive technical unity across the organization. You will design resilient, cross-functional strategies and guide multiple engineering teams—spanning Full-Stack, Data, DevOps, and Security—to adopt your architectural decisions through technical authority, collaborative governance, and mentorship.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

**Who is USP Looking For?**

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the below competencies and experience

**Drive E2E Digital Product Architecture:** As a Solution Architect with expertise in software integrations, data architecture and modeling, and scalable deployments, you will lead the design and development of digital products within D&I.

* **Define, Govern, & Lead by Example:** Define and govern end-to-end solution architecture, technical standards, high- and low-level designs, technology choices, and reusable frameworks by leading as an example and driving the required POCs. This is a technically hands-on role that requires the capability to spin up production-grade code, rather than being limited to just POCs.
* **Modernise & Translate Business Needs:** Translate business needs into components/microservices, and lead legacy application modernization efforts across the ecosystem.
* **Cultivate Platform Thinking:** Adopt platform thinking wherever applicable in the realm of digital products to ensure scalability and reuse.
* **Collaborate with Global Stakeholders:** Partner closely with global stakeholders, business teams, and Infrastructure teams to advocate for applicable governance strategies and solution-oriented thinking as appropriate.
* **Design Cloud-Native Deployments:** Design resilient cloud-native application deployments including containerization, networking, ingress, and service discovery.
* **Architect Seamless Integrations:** Architect reliable, secure integrations with digital channels and third-party services.
* **Engineer for Scale & Production Readiness:** Engineer systems for high performance, resilience, high availability, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, business continuity, and production readiness.
* **Guide Alignment & Technical Governance:** Drive architecture reviews, proof-of-concepts, design decisions, technical governance, and issue resolution, ensuring engineering teams are naturally adhering to architecturally governed principles.

**Professional Experience:**

* Minimum of 12 years of professional technology experience, including at least 7 years in end-to-end full-stack engineering roles and at least 4 years of hands-on data engineering and data modeling experience.
* Deep expertise in Java / Spring Boot (or an equivalent enterprise-grade backend stack), distributed systems, microservices, domain-driven design (DDD), event-driven patterns, and robust API architectures (including REST and GraphQL).
* Comprehensive knowledge of Kubernetes / OpenShift, Docker/OCI containers, Helm, service mesh concepts, CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, advanced Git workflows, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Broad experience across public, private, and hybrid cloud architectures, focusing on scalable, secure, and resilient platform deployment patterns.
* Proven ability to execute creative data architecture solutions, advanced designs, and technical troubleshooting by thinking beyond conventional approaches.
* Demonstrated capability to recommend the absolute best technology stack needed to solve complex business problems at scale.
* Direct exposure to solving complex data models and highly interconnected data structures using Knowledge Graphs.
* High proficiency in designing and building ETL pipelines, utilizing enterprise reporting tools, and enabling advanced analytics via cloud technology and MLOps.
* Solid foundational understanding of modern AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning applications.
* Strong track record in data governance, including implementing data policies, metric/KPI-level governance, data quality, data security rules, and ensuring strict regulatory compliance.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex data and technical insights into actionable product and business strategies.
* Strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and inspire engineering teams to adopt modern architectural principles.
* Highly effective collaborator who can bridge the gap between global business and IT stakeholders by translating complex technical concepts into clear, practical solutions.

**Additional Desired Preferences**

 Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to communicate difficult concepts and influence stakeholders to adopt different perspectives

 Proactive mindset to identify opportunities to enhance value, improve existing solutions, manage technical debt, and influence teams in identifying innovative solutions

 Strong capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for multiple solutions, including conducting vendor assessments.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

None

**Benefits**

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

**Experience:** 3–6 Years

**Preferred Location:** Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon

**Project Type:** Domestic SAP S/4HANA Implementation & Transformation Projects

  
  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

  
  

We are looking for skilled SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Consultants to work on SAP analytics, reporting, and planning implementation projects. The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in SAP Analytics Cloud, including dashboard development, data modelling, reporting, and integration with SAP and non-SAP data sources.

The ideal candidate should be capable of translating business requirements into interactive analytical solutions, developing meaningful dashboards and reports, and working closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver effective data-driven insights.

Candidates with prior experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, and enterprise analytics implementation projects will be preferred.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. SAP Analytics Cloud – Reporting & Dashboard Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and analytical stories using SAP Analytics Cloud.
* Develop visualizations, charts, tables, KPIs, and management dashboards based on business requirements.
* Work on SAP Analytics Cloud Stories and Optimized Story Experience.
* Configure filters, prompts, input controls, drill-downs, and interactive reporting features.
* Develop calculated measures, dimensions, restricted measures, and custom calculations.
* Ensure dashboard usability, performance, and alignment with business reporting requirements.
  

  

### **2. Data Modelling & Data Connectivity**

* Develop and maintain analytical models in SAP Analytics Cloud.
* Work with dimensions, measures, hierarchies, and other modelling components.
* Configure and manage live and import data connections.
* Integrate SAP Analytics Cloud with SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP HANA, SAP Datasphere, and other data sources.
* Understand data structures and ensure data consistency, accuracy, and reliability.
* Troubleshoot data connectivity, modelling, and synchronization issues.
* Optimize data models and reporting performance.
  

  

### **3. SAP Analytics Cloud Planning**

* Work on planning models, versions, and dimensions within SAP Analytics Cloud.
* Develop planning solutions to support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes.
* Configure data actions, multi-actions, and advanced formulas.
* Work on allocation processes, planning workflows, and data entry functionality.
* Support financial planning and analysis (FP&A) requirements.
* Collaborate with finance and business teams to translate planning requirements into scalable SAC solutions.
  

  

### **4. Business Requirements & Solution Delivery**

* Gather and analyze business requirements for reporting, analytics, and planning solutions.
* Translate business requirements into technical and functional specifications.
* Conduct requirement-gathering sessions and collaborate with business stakeholders.
* Develop proof of concepts and demonstrate analytical solutions to clients.
* Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Prepare technical documentation, solution design documents, and user guides.
* Support deployment and post-go-live activities across DEV, QAS, and PROD environments.
  

  

### **5. Project & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Work closely with SAP functional consultants, data engineers, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
* Participate in solution design discussions and client workshops.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
* Troubleshoot and resolve reporting, analytics, and data-related issues.
* Ensure adherence to project delivery standards, documentation requirements, and quality guidelines.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement of analytics solutions.
  

  

**Mandatory Skills & Experience**
---------------------------------

* 3–6 years of experience in SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) implementation and development.
* Strong hands-on experience in developing SAC Stories, dashboards, reports, and visualizations.
* Experience in SAC data modelling, including dimensions, measures, hierarchies, and calculations.
* Good understanding of live and import data connections.
* Experience integrating SAC with SAP data sources such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW, SAP BW/4HANA, or SAP HANA.
* Strong understanding of reporting requirements and translating business needs into analytical solutions.
* Experience in data validation, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and report testing.
* Ability to prepare functional/technical documentation and work with cross-functional teams.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
  

  

**Additional Preferred Skills – Advantage**
-------------------------------------------

* **SAP Analytics Cloud Planning:** Experience in planning models, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning solutions.
* **Data Actions & Advanced Formulas:** Experience in developing data actions, multi-actions, and advanced formulas.
* **SAP Datasphere:** Exposure to data modelling, data integration, and connectivity using SAP Datasphere.
* **SAP BW/4HANA:** Experience working with SAP BW queries, InfoProviders, and analytical data sources.
* **SAP S/4HANA Integration:** Understanding of integrating SAC with SAP S/4HANA reporting and analytical scenarios.
* **SAP BTP:** Exposure to SAP BTP services and cloud-based analytics solutions.
* **Financial Analytics:** Experience in developing financial dashboards, management reporting, and planning solutions.
* Knowledge of SAP security, roles, authorizations, and access control within SAC.
* Prior experience in Big 4 consulting firms or large IT consulting organizations will be highly preferred.
  

  

**Desired Candidate Profile**
-----------------------------

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with an understanding of business reporting requirements.
* Ability to independently develop dashboards and analytical solutions.
* Good communication and presentation skills, with the ability to interact with business stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and focus on data accuracy and reporting quality.
* Ability to work effectively with functional, technical, and business teams.
* Experience working in SAP implementation, analytics transformation, and support engagements.
* Willingness to travel to client locations within India as per project requirements.

Sales Operations & Performance

You will collaborate with clients to deliver successful projects, leveraging your proficiency in cloud implementation methodologies like the garage method.

Master's Degree

* Software Architecture Fundamentals: Exposure to software architecture fundamentals, including design patterns and principles, to lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement.
* Cloud Implementation Methodologies: Proficiency in using the garage method for cloud implementation, with experience working with cloud native development principles, containers, and serverless computing fundamentals.
* API and Microservices Architecture: Experience working with API and Microservices-based architecture implementation, with proficiency in at least one of the following technologies: Node.js, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or Netflix OSS.
* AWS Services Mapping: Experience with AWS, including the ability to map existing components/functionalities to AWS-specific services, with a solid understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of related AWS Services.
* Cloud Development Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript, CSS, and familiarity with Angular.js, with the ability to apply this knowledge to develop cloud solutions.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Familiarity with Scripting Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript and CSS is beneficial for developing cloud solutions. Knowledge of these technologies can be applied to create tailored solutions for clients.
* Knowledge of Angular.js: Familiarity with Angular.js is advantageous for developing cloud solutions, allowing for more versatile and effective solutions to be delivered to clients.

This role requires strong technical proficiency across Azure compute, networking, storage, identity, security, and governance services, as well as the ability to partner with engineering, operations, and security teams to ensure a resilient, secure, and cost-effective cloud platform. The Azure Engineer plays a critical role in enabling cloud adoption, supporting infrastructure modernization initiatives, and maintaining the overall health and stability of the organization's Azure ecosystem.**

  

**Experience: 5-9 years**

**Location: Hyderabad**

  

**Role & responsibilities:**

  

* Ensure the health and stability of cloud services through proactive monitoring, Terraform-based infrastructure management, Azure platform administration, and the successful delivery of cloud infrastructure solutions that enable business and application teams to operate securely and efficiently.
* Provide essential operational support for Azure-hosted services, ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of key business platforms. With dedicated ownership of these responsibilities, operational incidents would experience increased resolution times, elevated service risk, and a greater likelihood of business disruption.
* Responsible for driving the identification, prioritization, and remediation of security findings across the Azure environment, directly reducing organizational risk and ensuring compliance with security and regulatory requirements.
* Enables critical project delivery, supports enterprise initiatives, and ensures Azure services remain secure, optimized, and aligned with business objectives.

  

**If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!**

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

* 3+ years Azure cloud experience
* Experience in Azure technologies including but not limited to backup and restore, ASR, Network, NSG, troubleshooting and operational logging
* Experience in azure network design including NSG, Gateway, Firewalls, Subnets, Vnets. Knowledge of azure security constructs
* Demonstrated experience supporting production Azure deployments
* Demonstrated experience with Azure coding technologies CLI, Powershell, ARM
* Experience with Terraform deployments using Azure DevOps, GitHub or GitLab
* Experience working with teams to deliver complete azure solutions (security, operations, engineering, application team)
* Azure Administrator Certified

  

**Additional Requirements**

  

* Understanding of container technology and container orchestration platforms, Dockers, Kubernetes
* Knowledge of best practices and market trends pertaining to Cloud and overall industry to provide thought leadership (seminars, whitepapers etc.,) and mentor team to build necessary competency
* Advise the customer executives on their cloud strategy roadmap, improvements, alignment and further improvements.
