These jobs focus on technical selling to customers/partners. May be aligned to specific accounts based on business priority.
  
  
**Management Level Definition**
Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**What you’ll do:**

* Demonstrates in-depth knowledge in one or more solution domains, company products, services, and solutions as well as the customer’s technical and business environment.
* Develops compelling customer proposals and critically reviews them, manages the expectations of internal stakeholders and customers, ensuring the meeting of customer’s business and technical requirements are met.
* Quantifies the impact of the business problem(s), positions business value, identifies the strengths and weaknesses of the overall proposed solution to achieve long-term business objectives.
* Provides input to all global business units to address IT trends, requirements, gaps, or unmet needs.
* Translates outcome-based solutions into a functional solution design that aligns to the customers business needs, and then translates that functional design into a technical design and architecture that can be scaled to accommodate growth.
* Communicates how the solution value propositions addresses customer business needs.
* Tracks leading-edge and emerging technologies.
* Contributes to industry development for one or more domains through conferences (content support/presentations, demos, booth support) and industry events, while also monitoring social media.
* Incorporates an understanding of technology trends within the IT industry, as well as the customer’s industry.
* Actively gathers and applies competitive intelligence as a critical component of account support.
* Drives the Account Business Planning process, leveraging knowledge of industry trends and the customer’s technical environment.
* Participates in deep-dive discussions and partners with the account team to build customer relationships at all levels by advocating and presenting technical strategies for a customer's transformation.
* Produces in-depth comparative analysis of alternative approaches to meet solution requirements.
* Develops, configures, and right sizes an optimal workload solution, balancing cost, scope, scale, boundaries, and benefits to deliver superior value and increase the win rate.
* Leverages deep knowledge of partner products and services and adjusts strategies to leverage the relationship between the service provider/partner and the customer.
* Successfully transfers knowledge to external partners to deliver effective solutions to customers.
* Proactively builds the pipeline by identifying opportunities (e.g., enhancements, unmet or unrecognized needs, up-selling, and cross-selling opportunities) within the account.
* Monitors the account pipeline and nurtures active deals from the opportunity to close.
* Uses pipeline insights to help prioritize activities in a way that ensures time, and resources are invested wisely in pursuit of deals with the highest potential.
* Actively participates in sales forecast meetings and provides feedback to accelerate the sales lifecycle.
* Documents ongoing work (activities, tasks) throughout the sales cycle using specific tools and resources and sharing best practices with peers and partners to collaborate more effectively.
* Builds strong professional relationships with customer key executives across the business and industry.
* Proactively shares knowledge with peers and helps develop more junior team members.

**What You Need To Bring**
***Education and Experience:***

* First-level university technical degree or equivalent technical qualifications. Advanced degree in technology preferred.
* 8–12 years of technical experience in IT with a focus on technical consulting and solution selling
* Knowledge-based as well as 1+ experienced-based relevant industry certifications very strongly preferred.
* Enterprise architecture frameworks and project management methodologies and certifications are helpful, but not required.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Advanced experience participating in and leading solution configurations and the creation of demos and proofs-of-concept (POC) to meet customer requirements.
* Advanced understanding of the company portfolio of products, software, services, solution domain specialization, adjacent solution domain(s), and how they can be combined to address customer needs.
* Advanced ability to translate aaS and complete ecosystem, differentiated value, solutions, and workloads and ability to prioritize aaS offerings and consumption models that will achieve the customer’s outcomes and greatest return.
* Advanced understanding of aaS business model variations.
* Advanced ability to collaborate cross-functionally to ensure consistency of output and meet aaS strategic goals.
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including active listening and storytelling, and the ability to communicate in English and applicable local languages as needed to perform job requirements.
* Demonstrates advanced discussion and persuasion skills used to support company point-of-view, while respectfully questioning and challenging proposed solutions.
* Advanced business and financial acumen—sales cycle, pipeline growth, reporting, ability to influence, business strategy linkage— with an understanding of functional responsibilities of various customer business roles, including typical KPIs important to, CxOs and line-of-business (LOB) executives; knowledgeable about TCO/ROI concepts and calculations, financial models, and understand how customers generate revenue.
* Advanced consultative/value selling skills, including, whiteboarding, objection handling, and closing skills to proactively help customers make business decisions.
* Advanced company business knowledge, technical tools, and standard customer relationship management (CRM) systems and tools.

5480843a.title: Presales Director
5480843a.description:
The Impact You'll Drive
  
  
At Vegapay, a bank's idea for a new credit card or credit line on UPI shouldn't take months to reach customers. We build the configurable infrastructure behind next-generation credit and payment programs for banks, NBFCs and fintechs. We're looking for a Director, Presales to lead the function that turns a first conversation with a bank into a signed program: the person who can walk into a CXO room, understand the business problem and show how Vegapay solves it.
  
  
This isn't a pure sales role, and it isn't a pure solutioning role. You'll own the technical and commercial story of every strategic deal, from discovery and demos to RFP responses, proofs of concept and the handover to delivery.
  
  
As Director, Presales, you'll sit between our banking and fintech prospects, sales leadership, product and engineering. You'll shape how Vegapay is positioned across credit cards, credit line on UPI (CLOU), embedded lending, BRE, rewards, ledgering and reconciliation, and you'll build the team and playbooks that make every pursuit faster and sharper than the last.
  
  
You'll work directly with senior stakeholders at banks and NBFCs (heads of cards, lending, risk, technology and compliance) to understand how they operate, find the problems that matter most and define clear success criteria. Then you'll win them over with a solution they can see working. Success in this role takes deep fintech domain knowledge, credibility with technical and business leaders, and the ability to turn an ambiguous requirement into a clear, winning proposal.
  
  
The Hats You Will Wear
  
  

* Own the presales strategy and function end to end: set the operating model, targets and quality bar across discovery, solutioning, demos, RFPs and proofs of concept.
* Lead discovery with bank, NBFC and fintech prospects to map their current stack, workflows and regulatory constraints, identify the real bottleneck and define measurable success criteria.
* Partner with the CEO and sales leadership on strategic pursuits: qualify opportunities, build the win strategy and join CXO-level meetings as the solution and domain voice for Vegapay.
* Design tailored solutions across credit cards, credit line on UPI, embedded lending, BRE, rewards, forex, ledgering and reconciliation, with clear architecture, integration approach and timelines.
* Own RFP/RFI responses and commercial proposals, working with product, engineering, legal and finance on scope, pricing, SLAs and risk.
* Run high-impact demos and proofs of concept that show the configurable platform working on the prospect's own use cases, including sandbox and demo environments that stay current.
* Build, mentor and scale a team of solution architects, presales consultants and solution engineers, with clear career paths and performance standards.
* Create the presales playbook: reusable solution blueprints, battlecards, competitive positioning, objection handling, ROI and business-case models, and a library of RFP answers.
* Act as the voice of the market inside Vegapay: feed prospect needs, competitive gaps and regulatory shifts (RBI, NPCI) back to product and engineering to shape the roadmap.
* Hand over won deals cleanly to implementation and customer delivery, so what was promised in the pursuit is what gets built.
* Track and report presales metrics: pipeline coverage, win rate, sales-cycle length, POC conversion and RFP turnaround time.

The Perfect Fit
  
  

* 10 - 12 years of experience in presales, solution consulting or solution architecture at a fintech, payments or core-banking/card-processing vendor, with at least 5 years leading a presales or solutions team.
* Proven record of winning large, multi-stakeholder deals with banks, NBFCs or large fintechs, from first discovery to signed contract.
* Deep domain knowledge of at least one of credit cards, lending (BNPL, credit lines, personal loans), UPI or payments processing, including how card programs and lending products work end to end.
* Strong technical grounding: APIs, microservices, integrations, cloud deployment, security and data-privacy norms, enough to lead architecture conversations with a bank's CTO and CISO.
* Working knowledge of the Indian regulatory landscape: RBI guidelines on digital lending and credit cards, NPCI's UPI ecosystem, PCI-DSS and data localisation.
* Strong executive presence and storytelling: comfortable presenting to CXOs and boards, and equally comfortable in a whiteboard session with architects.
* Experience building and mentoring high-performing presales teams, with clear ownership and a culture of accountability.
* Skilled at RFP/RFI responses, commercial proposals, ROI and business-case modelling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across sales, product, engineering and legal in a fast-moving startup.
* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or Engineering; an MBA is a plus.

Your Edge Over the Rest
  
  

* Hands-on experience with card management systems, credit line over UPI, loan management systems, ledger and reconciliation flows, or card network integrations (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay).
* An existing network among senior leaders at Indian banks, NBFCs and fintechs.
* AI-native: you use AI tools in your own work, and you can show prospects how AI-led workflows improve underwriting, servicing and operations.
* You've built a presales function from scratch, or scaled one through a sharp growth phase.
* Full ownership: a deal is yours until the program is live, not just until the contract is signed.
* Highest standards: you won't promise a bank what the platform can't deliver, and you care about getting the solution right the first time.

The Problem We're Solving
  
  
Financial institutions today are held back by legacy systems that are slow, rigid, and expensive to scale. Launching or evolving credit, lending, and UPI products often takes months, requires heavy engineering effort, and limits the ability to create personalized customer experiences.
  
  
At the same time, customer expectations have changed - speed, flexibility, and tailored financial products are no longer optional. Banks and fintechs need infrastructure that allows them to innovate quickly, adapt continuously, and scale without friction.
  
  
This is where we come in. At Vegapay, we are building modern, configurable fintech infrastructure that enables banks, NBFCs, and enterprises to design, launch, and manage credit and payment programs with ease. Our platform brings together flexibility, speed, and control - helping our partners unlock new growth opportunities and deliver personalized banking experiences at scale.
  
  
The Opportunity Ahead
  
  

* Shape and lead the presales function of a fast-growing B2B fintech from an early stage, with a direct line to the founders.
* Work with top banks and cutting-edge credit infrastructure on high-visibility, high-value deals.
* Own the story behind products that run for millions of end users.
* Fast-paced, high-learning environment with strong growth opportunities.

3b7ae81d.title: Pre sales real estate
3b7ae81d.description:
**Company Description**
M J REALTY is a real estate organization focused on providing residential and commercial property solutions in Bengaluru and surrounding regions. The company aims to deliver reliable, transparent, and customer-centric services to buyers and investors. M J REALTY works closely with clients to understand their requirements and guide them through each stage of the property selection and purchase process. The team emphasizes professional conduct, ethical business practices, and long-term relationships with customers and partners.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Pre Sales real estate role based in Bengaluru. The Pre Sales professional will engage with potential customers, respond to inquiries, and provide detailed information about available projects, pricing, and payment plans. Day-to-day responsibilities include qualifying leads, conducting property presentations and site visits, maintaining accurate records of client interactions, and coordinating with the sales team to move prospects through the sales pipeline. The role also involves explaining project features, addressing customer concerns, and following up with prospects via calls, messages, and meetings to support conversion. The Pre Sales professional will collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely sharing of marketing materials, training updates, and project-related information.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong Communication and Customer Service skills, with the ability to interact confidently and professionally with diverse clients.
* Sales and Sales Management skills to handle lead qualification, follow-ups, and support the closure of deals.
* Training-related abilities to quickly learn project details, policies, and processes, and apply them effectively in client interactions.
* Basic understanding of real estate market dynamics and property documentation is beneficial.
* Proficiency in using CRM tools, spreadsheets, and communication platforms for tracking and reporting.
* Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru, manage multiple leads, and maintain a customer-focused approach.
* Prior experience in real estate or customer-facing roles is an advantage.
* Relevant educational background in Business, Marketing, Real Estate, or a related field is preferred.

e5f1dee4.title: Sales Specialist - Hybrid Cloud Solutions
e5f1dee4.description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Global Sales**
at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector & small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
  
  
**Job Family Definition**
Sales Specialists & Consultants are product, services, software or solution specialists that are responsible for leading pursuit in their assigned focus areas. Collaborates with and supports Account Managers and provides specialist expertise within the sales team. Drives proactive campaigns to build the pipeline, uses specialized knowledge and skills to prospect, qualify, negotiate and close opportunities. May have named accounts allocated, cover a designated geography, or may be allocated to one high-potential, competitive attack account.
  
  
**Management Level Definition**
Applies developed subject matter knowledge to solve common and complex business issues and recommends appropriate alternatives. Works on problems of diverse complexity and scope. May act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process. Exercises independent judgment to identify and select a solution. Ability to handle most unique situations. May seek advice in order to make decisions on complex business issues.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
***Responsibilities:***

* Drive direct sales of HPE Hybrid Cloud solutions, identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing customer relationships across assigned accounts.
* Develop and execute sales strategies to position HPE GreenLake solutions, Hybrid Cloud offerings, and consumption-based IT services to enterprise customers.
* Identify, qualify, and develop opportunities for HPE GreenLake, Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Private Cloud, and Storage as a Service (STaaS) solutions.
* Build and manage a strong sales pipeline for Hybrid Cloud and as-a-Service offerings, ensuring alignment with Account Managers and business objectives.
* Work closely with Account Managers to identify customer requirements, develop account-specific sales strategies, and drive revenue growth through specialized Hybrid Cloud solutions.
* Engage directly with customers, including CXOs, IT leaders, infrastructure heads, and decision-makers, to understand their business challenges and present relevant Hybrid Cloud solutions.
* Drive consultative selling by understanding customers' existing IT infrastructure, cloud adoption strategies, data management requirements, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
* Position HPE GreenLake's consumption-based model and flexible IT solutions as alternatives to traditional infrastructure procurement and ownership models.
* Drive sales of Storage as a Service, Hybrid Cloud Storage, data management, and infrastructure modernization solutions, aligning offerings with customer requirements.
* Identify opportunities for cloud transformation, workload modernization, hybrid IT infrastructure, and migration from traditional on-premises environments to hybrid cloud models.
* Develop customer-specific proposals, solution value propositions, commercial models, and business cases in collaboration with technical specialists and solution architects.
* Lead customer discussions, negotiations, commercial presentations, and deal closures for Hybrid Cloud and GreenLake opportunities.
* Collaborate with Presales, Solution Architects, Product Teams, and delivery teams to develop comprehensive solutions that address customer business and technical requirements.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, channel partners, and strategic technology partners to accelerate Hybrid Cloud business growth.
* Analyze competitor offerings across Hybrid Cloud, cloud infrastructure, storage, and as-a-Service solutions to strengthen HPE's competitive positioning.
* Drive strategic account penetration by identifying cross-selling and upselling opportunities across HPE's Hybrid Cloud and GreenLake portfolio.
* Support Account Managers in developing pursuit strategies, forecasting opportunities, managing deal progression, and achieving assigned sales quotas.
* Maintain accurate opportunity management, sales forecasting, and pipeline updates through CRM tools such as Salesforce/Siebel.
* Stay updated on emerging Hybrid Cloud technologies, cloud consumption models, infrastructure-as-a-Service, Storage as a Service, and industry trends to strengthen customer engagement and sales effectiveness.

**What You Need To Bring**
***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related discipline preferred.
* Typically 5–8 years of experience in enterprise technology sales, preferably in Hybrid Cloud, Cloud Infrastructure, Storage, or IT Infrastructure solutions.
* Proven experience in direct sales, consultative selling, account management, and business development within enterprise or commercial accounts.
* Demonstrated success in achieving sales quotas, developing new business opportunities, and closing complex technology deals.
* Experience selling HPE GreenLake, Hybrid Cloud solutions, Storage as a Service, Infrastructure as a Service, or similar consumption-based IT solutions is preferred.
* Strong understanding of enterprise customer environments, IT infrastructure, and cloud transformation requirements.

**Knowledge And Skills**

03714310.title: Data Architect
03714310.description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

The Data Architect will define and lead the enterprise data architecture for Cordance Commerce, with primary responsibility for unifying reporting platforms, data models, and analytics capabilities across Solutions, Secure Retail, Upright, and Pearl Dive. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who can turn fragmented operational data and customer-specific reporting into a scalable, governed, and reliable data platform.

The role partners closely with Database Administrators, Business Intelligence professionals, Engineering, Product, Finance, Customer Success, and business leaders. The Data Architect will establish a practical migration strategy that separates analytical workloads from transactional systems, protects product performance, preserves critical customer reporting, and enables a trusted source of data across the portfolio.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the target-state data architecture and roadmap for a unified reporting and analytics platform across Cordance Commerce products.
* Assess current transactional databases, data pipelines, reporting tools, standard BI reports, and customer-specific reports; document dependencies, duplication, performance risks, and migration constraints.
* Define a shared enterprise data model, canonical business definitions, master-data strategy, and system-of-record ownership for core entities such as customer, item, store, employee, transaction, inventory, donation, processing, and e-commerce activity.
* Design the separation of transactional and analytical workloads using fit-for-purpose patterns such as a cloud data warehouse or lakehouse; evaluate platforms including Snowflake and recommend the appropriate solution based on scale, security, cost, operability, and business needs.
* Create the phased migration strategy for consolidating reporting from Solutions, Secure Retail, Upright, and Pearl Dive while maintaining business continuity and customer commitments.
* Develop patterns and standards for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, semantic models, APIs, data quality, lineage, metadata, retention, archival, and observability.
* Partner with BI professionals to rationalize the Solutions standard report catalog and reduce the support burden created by hundreds of Secure Retail customer-specific reports through reusable datasets, governed self-service analytics, and configurable reporting patterns.
* Guide DBAs and engineering teams on database architecture, PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL modernization, replication or change-data-capture patterns, performance isolation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness.
* Establish data governance practices covering data ownership, access controls, privacy, security, auditability, quality thresholds, and change management.
* Lead technical discovery, architecture reviews, proofs of concept, and vendor evaluations; translate findings into actionable designs, sequencing, estimates, risks, and investment recommendations.
* Provide hands-on technical guidance to delivery teams, review implementation designs, and ensure new product capabilities align with the target architecture instead of creating additional data silos.
* Enable trusted enterprise dashboards and cross-product reporting that support operational, customer, financial, and executive decision-making.

**Competencies:**

* Enterprise Data Architecture: Converts complex, fragmented data estates into pragmatic target-state architectures and phased roadmaps.
* Technical Depth: Designs modern warehouses or lakehouses, dimensional and relational models, pipelines, semantic layers, and reporting platforms.
* Business Translation: Connects architecture decisions to customer value, product performance, operational efficiency, and measurable business outcomes.
* Data Governance: Establishes clear ownership, definitions, lineage, quality, security, and lifecycle controls without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Migration Leadership: Plans incremental transitions that protect customer reporting and production stability while retiring duplication and technical debt.
* Influence and Collaboration: Builds alignment across DBAs, BI, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders.
* Ownership: Drives decisions through implementation, manages ambiguity, and remains accountable for platform adoption and results.
* AI and Analytics Readiness: Designs governed, reusable data foundations suitable for advanced analytics and AI-enabled workflows.

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, database architecture, analytics engineering, or business intelligence, including 3+ years in a data architecture or senior technical leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience designing enterprise data warehouses, lakehouses, or analytical platforms and migrating data from multiple operational systems.
* Strong data-modeling expertise across conceptual, logical, and physical models, including dimensional modeling and normalized transactional designs.
* Hands-on proficiency with SQL, relational databases, ETL/ELT patterns, orchestration, data quality, metadata, lineage, and BI semantic models.
* Experience separating reporting workloads from high-volume transactional systems and designing for performance, resilience, scalability, and cost control.
* Experience with cloud data platforms and modern data integration patterns, including APIs, replication, and change data capture.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present architecture decisions and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Snowflake and at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL, including modernization or migration initiatives.
* Experience consolidating reporting platforms following acquisitions or across a multi-product SaaS portfolio.
* Experience rationalizing large libraries of standard and customer-specific reports and enabling governed self-service analytics.
* Familiarity with retail, point-of-sale, inventory, e-commerce, donation, or thrift/resale data domains.
* Knowledge of data privacy, security, role-based access, audit, retention, and compliance practices.
* Experience enabling machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI use cases through governed enterprise data products.
* Relevant cloud, Snowflake, data-management, or architecture certification is a plus.

**What We Offer**

* Work with a mission-driven team building impactful software solutions for the thrift and resale industry.
* Opportunity to shape shared technology capabilities across a growing portfolio of commerce products.
* Collaborative culture that values innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and transparency.
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for career growth.

**Success Measurements**

**Architecture & Roadmap**

* Completes an agreed current-state assessment and target-state architecture covering all Commerce reporting platforms and critical data domains.
* Delivers an approved, sequenced migration roadmap with clear dependencies, costs, risks, and ownership.

**Unified Data & Reporting**

* Establishes common business definitions and governed data models that are adopted by reporting and product teams.
* Reduces duplicated datasets and one-off reporting solutions while preserving priority customer capabilities.
* Enables reliable cross-product operational and executive reporting from trusted data sources.

**Performance, Reliability & Quality**

* Moves resource-intensive analytics away from transactional systems where appropriate and measurably reduces reporting-related production impact.
* Implements measurable data-quality, freshness, lineage, observability, and recovery standards for critical data products.

**Migration & Adoption**

* Achieves agreed migration milestones without material disruption to customer reporting or operational workflows.
* Builds strong adoption among DBAs, BI professionals, engineers, business users, and product stakeholders.

**Governance & Cost Effectiveness**

* Establishes accountable data ownership and access controls for priority domains.
* Provides transparent platform usage and cost metrics and demonstrates progress toward a scalable, supportable reporting model.

*Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.*

### **Why Join Us?**

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

* **Health and Wellness:**
  + Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
* **Retirement Savings:**
  + 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
  + RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
* **Paid Time Off:**
  + Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
* **Parental Leave:**
  + 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
* **Remote Work Support:**
  + Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
* **Holidays:**
  + Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

52fc597b.title: Course5i - Solutions Architect - Data Platform
52fc597b.description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Data Solutions Architect with 10+ years of experience in designing and delivering enterprise data solutions.
  
  
The candidate should combine strong technical architecture expertise with hands-on solution building and client consulting skills.
  
  
This role will lead business discovery, define solution architectures, develop proofs of concept, and guide implementation teams to deliver scalable data platforms and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Architecture & Building**

* Design end-to-end data solutions covering ingestion, integration, storage, processing, governance, and analytics.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs, solution blueprints, and delivery roadmaps.
* Build prototypes and proofs of concept to validate feasibility and demonstrate business value.
* Guide engineering teams through implementation, architecture reviews, and technical problem-solving.
* Ensure solutions meet scalability, performance, reliability, security, and cost requirements.
* Develop reusable frameworks, reference architectures, and solution accelerators.

**Consulting & Client Engagement**

* Lead discovery workshops to understand client objectives, data challenges, and existing technology landscapes.
* Assess data maturity and recommend modernization strategies and implementation plans.
* Advise clients on technology selection, architecture trade-offs, and build-versus-buy decisions.
* Present solution recommendations to business leaders and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales activities, including proposals, demonstrations, effort estimation, and statements of work.
* Define business success measures and connect technical solutions to expected outcomes.
* Collaborate with sales and delivery teams to establish scope, dependencies, and timelines.

**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Provide architecture oversight from discovery through production deployment.
* Work with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders.
* Establish standards for data quality, governance, metadata, lineage, and access control.
* Identify technical risks and recommend mitigation measures.
* Mentor team members and strengthen architecture and engineering practices.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of overall experience in data engineering, enterprise data solutions, or related roles, including experience in architecture and client-facing consulting.
* Proven ability to deliver solutions from requirements gathering and architecture design through implementation and production rollout.
* Strong hands-on expertise in SQL, Python, data modeling, and ETL/ELT development.
* Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Stack, Azure.
* Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, BigQuery, or Redshift.
* Knowledge of distributed processing, pipeline orchestration, batch and streaming architectures, and API integration.
* Understanding of data governance, security, privacy, and performance optimization.
* Experience preparing architecture documentation, technical proposals, estimates, and implementation roadmaps.
* Strong communication, presentation, consulting, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance business priorities with technical feasibility and delivery constraints.

**Preferred Skills**

* Enterprise data modernization and cloud migration experience.
* Exposure to data solutions supporting AI/ML, GenAI, and advanced analytics.
* Familiarity with DataOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and automated testing.
* Experience building reusable or industry-specific solution accelerators.
* Relevant cloud or data architecture certifications.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

2dcf9771.title: Senior Technical Architect -Consumer Goods Cloud / Manufacturing Cloud
2dcf9771.description:
**Description**
About the Team
  
  
The India Professional Services team at Salesforce delivers top-notch solutions and expert guidance that help clients get the most from their Salesforce investment. We're a tight-knit group of high performers with expertise across multiple domains, multi-cloud ecosystems and industry clouds. We're an AI-enabled team across both product and delivery. We value flexibility, shared ownership and real collaboration. You'll learn something new every day, whether it's technology, innovation or process.
  
  
The Role
  
  
As a Senior Technical Architect, you will lead strategic customer engagements. You'll own end-to-end technical implementations and guide advisory initiatives, working closely with our partner and customer ecosystem. You'll design scalable, long-term solutions that hold up at high volumes and at critical moments.
  
  
Customers move fast and keep pushing boundaries. Success here takes judgment about when to zoom out and think strategically and when to dive in and execute.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Take consultative, end-to-end ownership of technical delivery. This covers custom development, integrations and data migration.
* Work with client stakeholders to define requirements and deliverables and to manage expectations.
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions on the Salesforce platform.
* Lead technical design sessions. Document solutions aligned to client objectives and identify gaps between current and desired end states.
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects.
* Define and follow coding standards, and lead code reviews.
* Run technical assessments for customers across quality, security, data, design, architecture and scalability.
* Use AI tools both strategically and tactically in design and delivery.
* Take part in pre-sales activities such as discovery, technical deep dives and POCs.
* Work with internal teams (security, product, customer success), partners and Salesforce product teams.
* Maintain the target billable utilization for the role.
* Travel to client sites as customer needs require.

**Required Qualifications**

* A degree or equivalent relevant experience. We evaluate experience against the role's core competencies, including leadership, volunteer, military and work experience.
* 14–20 years of overall experience, with at least 8 years on the Salesforce platform.
* Hands-on, active experience in the last few years with Consumer Goods Cloud and/or Manufacturing Cloud. This should include architecture, design and leading implementations.
* A strong technical background that combines hands-on development with consulting.
* Expert knowledge of the Salesforce suite, including Data Cloud, Industry Clouds, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud and Marketing Cloud.
* Systems architecture skills, including scalable, performance-driven design, large data volume (LDV) best practices and data sharing and visibility.
* Platform authentication knowledge (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and security (TLS, SSL).
* Integration experience with ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting and other business systems.
* Strong grasp of environment management, release management, versioning and deployment.
* Experience defining system architecture landscapes and delivering end-to-end solutions.
* Active Salesforce certifications, or the ability to earn the relevant ones after hire.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Automotive Cloud and automotive domain experience.
* Agentforce experience.
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA), Application Architect or System Architect.
* Other AI/ML or cloud architect certifications.
* Experience at Salesforce partners or consultancies, for example Cloud Odyssey, CRMLanding, Plus91 or Appstrail.

7d8d8e02.title: Senior System Architect
7d8d8e02.description:
**Meet Our Team**
Our team lives and breathes the Pega delivery vision: quickly building high-quality, outcome-driven applications that evolve with the changing needs of business. As a key member of the Pega Consulting team, you will work with a passionate and driven project team, delivering new and innovative business and technical solutions using Pega technology.
  
  
**Picture Yourself At Pega**
Pega is changing the way the world builds software. In this role, you’ll help us design, develop, implement and test the next generation customer centric solutions. This is your chance to get your hands-on leading technology that figures out what people really care about.
  
  
At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.
  
  
We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.
  
  
**What You'll Do At Pega**

* Partner with our world leading clients to deliver high quality technical solutions across all phases of the software development lifecycle
* Utilize your outstanding technical consulting skills to demonstrate new and innovative ways to implement software solutions
* Mentor and train our clients in Pega technology
* Leveraging your Thought Leadership skills, you’ll engage, educate and enable your clients’ resources on Industry and Pega Best Practices.
* Collaborating with a high performing Pega delivery team you will ensure the solution meets or exceeds your client’s expectations.

**Who You Are**

* You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
* You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

You are a highly technical hands on individual who is passionate about exploring and applying Pega technology to help solve business problems.
  
  

* Minimum 6 years of Pega experience and CSSA certification and experience in building and implementing model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions.
* Excellent time management and organization skills, with the capability to manage multiple competing priorities
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate, partner and collaborate
* Willingness to go the extra mile
* Dedication to achieving outstanding customer results with a team-oriented drive and a demonstrated ability to lead by example
* Aptitude to pick up new concepts and technology rapidly; ability to explain it to both business & IT stakeholders
* Capacity to work in teams as well as alone
* Capacity to lead technical team
* Ability to match technology solutions to customer needs

**What You've Accomplished**

* You’ve built and implemented model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions and applications.
* You’ve been exposed to a variety of technologies including Application Servers, programming languages, relational and non-relational data bases and integration techniques.
* You’ve demonstrated knowledge of and applicability of Object-Oriented techniques and principles.
* You’ve delivered solutions in Agile and Scrum methodologies.

**Pega Offers You**

* Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products
* Continuous learning and development opportunities
* An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment
* Competitive global benefits program inclusive ofpay + bonus incentive, employee equity in the company
* An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices.

9e44dd86.title: Agentic Full-Stack AI Architect
9e44dd86.description:
**About R Systems**
R Systems is a global digital product engineering company that helps enterprises design, build, and run AI-native, data-driven, and cloud-native products and platforms. Our AI, Data & Intelligent Engineering teams partner with U.S. enterprise clients to move AI beyond isolated pilots toward governed, production-grade "Enterprise Digital Brains" — unified platforms that combine modern data engineering, semantic ontologies, knowledge graphs, and multi-agent orchestration to deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As a Principal Full-Stack Agentic AI at R Systems, you will lead high-impact strategic advisory and forward-deployed architecture engagements for U.S. enterprise clients — guiding organizations beyond isolated AI pilots toward unified, continuous cognitive architectures ("Enterprise Digital Brains").
  
  
Acting as a trusted technical advisor to C-suite executives (CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CAIOs) and R Systems delivery leadership, you will solve complex architectural bottlenecks, lock target-state blueprints, and establish measurable business baselines that bridge strategic vision with production-grade, outcome-based execution.
  
  
This is a hands-on principal role. We are looking for an architect who has personally built and shipped across every layer of the modern stack — modern frontend frameworks, distributed backend services, API and enterprise integration, real-time event streaming, cloud-native data platforms, semantic/ontology layers, and governed multi-agent AI — and who can review code, challenge designs, and unblock engineering teams at any layer.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Enterprise Architecture Validation & Problem Solving: Audit and validate existing client enterprise architectures, proactively resolving structural bottlenecks across data security, privacy, regulatory compliance (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GLBA, CCPA/CPRA), legacy systems of record, and cross-platform integration.
* End-to-End Cognitive Architecture Design: Architect unified, full-stack target states spanning enterprise data ingestion (Snowflake, Databricks), medallion-layered data products, domain intelligence layers, semantic ontologies, temporal knowledge graphs, and governed multi-agent orchestration that executes deterministic business workflows.
* Full-Stack Product & Experience Architecture: Define frontend architecture standards (Angular, React/Next.js, micro-frontends, design systems, SSR/SSG, accessibility to WCAG 2.2, Core Web Vitals performance budgets) and backend service architecture (NestJS, FastAPI, Java/Spring Boot, Go) using domain-driven design, event-driven, and CQRS patterns.
* API & Enterprise Integration Architecture: Establish API-first strategy and contracts (REST/OpenAPI 3.1, GraphQL Federation, gRPC, AsyncAPI, webhooks), API gateway and management patterns (Kong, Apigee, AWS API Gateway, Azure API Management), and integration with core systems of record (SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, Oracle) via iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato) or event-driven connectors.
* Real-Time & Event Streaming Architecture: Design low-latency, event-driven backbones using Apache Kafka/Confluent, Amazon Kinesis/MSK, Apache Pulsar, Apache Flink, and Spark Structured Streaming; CDC with Debezium; and streaming delivery into Snowflake (Snowpipe Streaming) and Databricks — plus real-time agent and UI experiences over WebSockets and Server-Sent Events.
* Ontology & Knowledge Graph Strategy: Define rigorous methodologies for identifying, curating, governing, and continuously enriching business concepts, entities, and semantic relationships so the knowledge graph acts as a living, hallucination-resistant foundation for AI agents.
* Multi-Agent Orchestration & Governance: Design deterministic, human-in-the-loop agentic systems using modern frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A) boundaries, enforcing strict tenancy, RBAC/ABAC, prompt governance, evaluation gates, and end-to-end auditability.
* Executive Outcome Baselining: Partner directly with client business and technology stakeholders to define and baseline objective, quantifiable KPIs (operational efficiency, EBITDA impact, cycle-time reduction, cost-to-serve) that anchor follow-on outcome-based delivery phases.
* Execution Roadmapping & Risk Governance: Translate strategic blueprints into phased, dependency-mapped execution roadmaps and actionable work orders — explicitly documenting open architectural decisions (ADRs), technical trade-offs, and assumptions without premature lock-in.
* Thought Leadership & Practice Building: Shape R Systems reference architectures, accelerators, and reusable assets; support pre-sales solutioning and proposals; and represent R Systems in client executive briefings and industry forums.

Core Blueprinting Deliverables
  
  
In advisory and discovery phases, you will own the authoring, executive validation, and formal sign-off of the following foundational artifacts:
  
  

* Enterprise AI Solution Strategy: A comprehensive strategic framework defining guiding architectural principles, Digital Brain sequencing, and alignment with business objectives.
* Target-State Architecture Blueprint: Detailed technical documentation covering full-stack component boundaries (UI, API, services, streaming, data, AI), data flows, security/tenancy models, and enterprise system integration patterns.
* Domain Intelligence, Ontology & Knowledge Graph Blueprint: Technical and governance specifications for entity extraction, semantic modeling, progressive graph enrichment, and continuous knowledge lifecycle management.
* Integration & Event Architecture Specification: API catalog and contracts, event taxonomy and schemas, streaming topologies, and system-of-record integration patterns.
* Baselined Business Outcomes Charter: A codified, measurable set of target KPIs and baseline metrics governing downstream outcome-based delivery accountability.
* Phased Implementation Roadmap: Sequenced milestones, critical-path dependencies, and target release gates (e.g., Alpha, Beta, and Production launch readiness).
* Follow-On Delivery Execution Plan: Complete technical scope, workstreams, deliverables, and dependency matrices enabling client authorization of subsequent implementation phases.

Engagement Scope Boundaries (Advisory vs. Execution Phase)
  
  
**Role**
To maintain clear governance during strategic blueprinting engagements, this architectural leadership role focuses on design, validation, and readiness rather than direct operational execution of:
  
  

* Building or operating production Snowflake/Databricks data pipelines or ingesting live production datasets.
* Authoring full-scale production ontologies or deploying production agent/graph clusters.
* Provisioning live client beta/production environments, mobilizing full delivery squads, or managing end-user training, cutover, and hypercare.

Reference implementations, proofs of concept, and architecture spikes built to validate the blueprint are in scope and expected.
  
  
Required Technical Depth & Architecture Stack
  
  
The ideal candidate combines C-suite architectural vision with genuine, hands-on full-stack engineering fluency — capable of reviewing code, validating reference implementations, and guiding engineering teams across every layer of the modern AI stack. Deep expertise in the core client stack is expected; breadth across the alternatives listed demonstrates the range we need.
  
  
Frontend Frameworks & Experience Engineering
  
  

* Core: Angular (standalone components, signals, RxJS, NgRx), TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS (custom design tokens).
* Breadth: React, Next.js (App Router, SSR/RSC), Vue/Nuxt; micro-frontends (Module Federation); component libraries and design systems (Storybook); WCAG 2.2 accessibility; Core Web Vitals performance engineering.
* Data & Graph Visualization: ECharts (analytics/result studios), AntV G6 / d3-force / Cytoscape.js (interactive knowledge graph exploration), and streaming conversational/agent UX (token streaming, tool-call traces, human-approval flows).

Backend Services, APIs & Integration
  
  

* Services: NestJS (Node.js/Express), Python (FastAPI, Uvicorn, Celery), Java/Spring Boot, and Go; microservices, domain-driven design, event sourcing, CQRS, saga/outbox patterns.
* API Design: REST/OpenAPI 3.1, GraphQL (Apollo Federation), gRPC/Protobuf, AsyncAPI, webhooks; versioning, idempotency, rate limiting, and contract testing (Pact).
* API Management & Integration: Kong, Apigee, AWS API Gateway, Azure API Management; API gateway/proxy routing with injected user context; iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato); SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Oracle integration patterns.
* Identity & Auth: OAuth 2.1/OIDC, SAML SSO (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Amazon Cognito), JWT, magic links/OTPs via Amazon SES, Redis session revocation, fine-grained authorization (OPA, Cedar, OpenFGA).

Real-Time Streaming & Event-Driven Architecture
  
  

* Streaming Platforms: Apache Kafka / Confluent (Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, ksqlDB), Amazon MSK and Kinesis, Apache Pulsar, Azure Event Hubs, Google Pub/Sub.
* Stream Processing: Apache Flink, Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka Streams; exactly-once semantics, windowing, late-arriving data, and back-pressure.
* CDC & Eventing: Debezium, AWS DMS, EventBridge, SNS/SQS; Snowpipe Streaming and Databricks streaming tables; WebSockets/SSE for live UIs and agent event streams.

Agentic AI, Orchestration & NLP Pipelines
  
  

* Core Agentic Frameworks: PydanticAI (multi-agent planner, analyst, insights, and governed action patterns), LangGraph, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with signed scope headers for governed data access.
* Breadth: LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen/AG2, Microsoft Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, Amazon Bedrock Agents/AgentCore; Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol for cross-agent interoperability.
* Agent Design Patterns: planner/executor and supervisor hierarchies, tool use, reflection, short- and long-term agent memory, durable workflows (Temporal), deterministic guard paths, and human-in-the-loop approval checkpoints.
* Evaluation & LLMOps: offline/online evals and regression gates (Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo), tracing (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix), red-teaming, and prompt/version registries.
* Knowledge Curation & Parsing: Graphiti (temporal knowledge graphs), Argilla, distilabel; tree-sitter, spaCy, and GLiNER for localized Named Entity Recognition (NER); document parsing (Unstructured, Docling, Amazon Textract).

AI Models & Enterprise Gateway Governance
  
  

* Models: Multi-model orchestration via Amazon Bedrock (Anthropic Claude, Amazon Nova, Titan v2 embeddings), Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI/Gemini, and open-weight models (Llama, Mistral) served via vLLM or SageMaker; local embeddings (FastEmbed / BGE); speech services (Amazon Transcribe, Polly).
* AI Gateway: Centralized policy enforcement, token quotas/budgets, fallback and cost/latency-aware routing, prompt registries, semantic caching, metering, and Bedrock Guardrails (LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway or equivalent).
* Model Adaptation: Retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT), structured outputs, and prompt caching for cost/performance optimization.

Ontology, Semantic & Knowledge Graph Architecture
  
  

* Semantic Web Standards: OWL 2, RDF/RDFS, SHACL, SKOS, SPARQL; ontology engineering tools (Protégé, TopBraid); triple stores (Stardog, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune).
* Property Graphs: Neo4j (Cypher, APOC, Graph Data Science, multi-tenant semantic modeling, audit metadata); Amazon Neptune; graph data modeling and query optimization.
* Semantic Architecture: Business glossaries, taxonomies, and domain ontologies; upper/industry ontologies (FIBO, schema.org, HL7 FHIR); entity resolution and master data; semantic layers (dbt Semantic Layer, Snowflake semantic views, Cube, AtScale); ontology-driven application patterns (e.g., Palantir Foundry-style object models).
* GraphRAG: Graph-grounded retrieval (Microsoft GraphRAG, LightRAG, Neo4j GraphRAG) combined with hybrid search to minimize hallucinations and provide explainable, cited answers.

Search, Vector & Enterprise Data Persistence
  
  

* Search & Audit: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch (BM25 + vector hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, hash-chained AI audit trails, activity telemetry).
* Vector Stores: pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or native Snowflake/Databricks vector search.
* Operational Stores: Redis (state/session management, job queues), PostgreSQL (Amazon RDS/Aurora), and NoSQL (DynamoDB, MongoDB).
* Enterprise Data Platforms: Snowflake (Cortex AI, Horizon governance, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe Streaming) and Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Mosaic AI); medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) lakehouse design; Apache Iceberg; record-level enterprise connector integration patterns.

Cloud Infrastructure, Security & Observability
  
  

* AWS & IaC: AWS CDK (TypeScript) provisioning ECS Fargate, EKS, EC2, Lambda, RDS, ElastiCache, EFS, ALB, S3 + CloudFront, Route 53, Cloud Map, and KMS/Secrets Manager; Terraform; working fluency in Azure and GCP equivalents.
* Security: Zero-trust design, fine-grained RBAC/ABAC, hash-chained audit logs, nginx-unprivileged hardening, secrets management, and OWASP Top 10 for Web, API, and LLM Applications.
* Observability & DevSecOps: OpenTelemetry (OTLP) tracing (Jaeger, CloudWatch, AWS X-Ray, Datadog, Grafana), SLOs/error budgets, and automated CI/CD security scanning (GitHub Actions, Docker, Trivy, gitleaks, SAST/DAST, SBOM).
* Responsible AI & Compliance: NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging U.S. state AI regulations; model risk management for regulated industries.

**Qualifications & CompetenciesMust-Have**

* Experience: 12+ years of progressive technical leadership in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, or Principal Full-Stack Engineering, with a proven track record delivering production AI, data platforms, and knowledge-centric systems for U.S. enterprises.

* First-Principles Problem Solver: Ability to dissect ambiguous, complex enterprise challenges — bridging legacy infrastructure constraints with cutting-edge agentic patterns without over-engineering.
* Ontology & Knowledge Systems Mastery: Deep theoretical and practical command of semantic modeling, taxonomy/ontology design, entity resolution, and graph-grounded RAG (GraphRAG) to minimize LLM hallucinations.
* Snowflake, Databricks & Enterprise Data Fluency: Strong architectural grasp of the lakehouse and medallion architecture as the enterprise ingestion, governance, and analytical backbone feeding downstream intelligence layers.
* Executive Gravitas & Technical Writing: Exceptional ability to command executive rooms, facilitate stakeholder alignment on measurable business outcomes, and author crisp, self-contained architectural blueprints that engineering teams can execute without ambiguity.

Nice-to-Have
  
  

* Domain Experience: Consulting or forward-deployed delivery in BFSI, healthcare/life sciences, manufacturing, retail/CPG, or telecom.
* Industry Presence: Open-source contributions, patents, publications, or conference talks on agentic AI, knowledge graphs, or large-scale platforms.

Relevant Certifications (Highly Valued)
  
  
Current certifications in the following areas are a strong plus and will be weighted in evaluation:
  
  

* Cloud Architecture: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional; Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert; Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect.
