35c77b04.title: SAP SD Solution Architect
35c77b04.description:
Early joiners preferred, 15 to 30 days.

  

Job description

Your role

Help strengthen sales and order-to-cash capabilities across the Group. Based in Pune, you will work with business process owners, global IT colleagues and implementation partners to translate business needs into reliable SAP solutions. Your focus combines hands-on functional delivery, process harmonisation, S/4HANA change initiatives and knowledge transfer.

This is a functional delivery leadership role, not a purely advisory or people-management position. You will guide implementation within approved architecture standards and help business users operate processes effectively. Business process owners retain responsibility for business policy, data ownership and business acceptance.

Key responsibilities

Lead requirements analysis and SD configuration across sales orders, pricing, deliveries, billing, returns, credit and intercompany processes. Facilitate fit-to-standard workshops and document agreed process and solution designs.

Coordinate SD integration with FI, MM, PP and logistics specialists. Investigate customer and material master data, availability checks, inventory and production dependencies to resolve end-to-end fulfilment issues.

Prepare functional specifications and work with developers and integration specialists on enhancements and interfaces. Coordinate integration testing and support business-owned user acceptance testing, data migration, cutover and hypercare.

Resolve complex incidents, improve recurring problem areas and maintain practical documentation. Train key users and transfer SAP and process knowledge to colleagues in India.

Provide functional guidance to consultants and implementation partners. Track delivery dependencies and risks, escalating cross-functional design decisions to the Solution Architect and business decisions to the relevant process owners.

Essential experience and skills

TypicallyTypically, 8+ years of relevant SAP SD experience, including hands-on configuration and functional workstream leadership. Equivalent depth of relevant experience is welcome; years alone are not a selection criterion.

At least two end-to-end implementations or major rollouts, including an S/4HANA implementation, conversion or rollout. Evidence of personal responsibility from design and configuration through testing and go-live is essential.

Strong core SD expertise and practical integration knowledge across FI, MM and PP. Experience with manufacturing or industrial order fulfilment, master data and root-cause analysis beyond an isolated SD ticket queue.

Experience working in an international team is preferred.

Experience leading workshops, coordinating testing, documenting functional requirements and training business users. Professional English for international collaboration; a relevant degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred experience

Variant configuration, configurable products, make-to-order processes, intercompany flows and CRM/CPQ integration. Exposure to Indian GST and electronic invoicing integration, in partnership with Finance and tax specialists, is useful. German language skills and SAP certification are advantages, not mandatory.

Why consider this role?

Combine hands-on solution delivery with long-term process improvement and knowledge transfer. Work at the intersection of global standards and local business execution, with a clear opportunity to strengthen end-to-end operational capability.

  

**Must-Haves :**

SAP SD Configuration (8+ years), S/4HANA Implementation (2+ implementations), SAP FI/MM/PP Integration (8+ years), Order-to-Cash Process Leadership (8+ years).

56c020f0.title: Cloud Engineering Specialist
56c020f0.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-plus-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, advisory, and consulting groups as well as our enabling services functions. That’s why we continually invest in innovation, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

As a Cloud Engineer, your primary responsibility will be to design, deploy, and maintain cloud-based solutions primarily on the Microsoft Azure platform. The ideal candidate will also have a solid understanding of ETL processes and technologies, as well as experience with a variety of data sources. You will work closely with our clients, development teams, infrastructure teams, data & analytics team, and other stakeholders to ensure the successful implementation and operation of cloud services. Your role will involve designing and implementing scalable, secure, and highly available cloud architectures, as well as troubleshooting and resolving any issues that arise.

Additionally, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience, helping our clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution.

**Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to**:

* The shift timings for this role is 5:00PM - 2:00AM IST (7:30AM - 4:30PM ET)
* Identify & map source data in various commercial and custom systems
* Design, develop, test and maintain ETL pipelines
* Extract, transform, and load data from a variety of data sources
* Work with data engineers and other stakeholders to define data requirements
* Troubleshoot and debug ETL pipelines
* Stay up-to-date on ETL technologies and best practices
* Formulate development estimates (task, effort, dependencies, etc.)
* Develop test cases and demonstrate results for assigned deliverables.
* Maintain and present daily/weekly status
* Articulate project deliverable details and activities to client and project team members
* Adapt to various industries and quickly learn the client’s context, language, and jargon to clearly document and translate business requirements to development plans
* Maintain a professional presence and be ready to interact with the client at all times
* Azure Solution Design: Collaborate with development teams and architects to design cloud-based solutions on the Azure platform. Evaluate requirements, propose design options, and recommend best practices for scalability, performance, security, and cost optimization.
* Azure Networking: Designing, implementing, and maintaining network infrastructure solutions based on Azure services i.e Configuring and managing virtual networks, subnets, routing tables, network security groups, and load balancers within the Azure environment, Configuring the IP-Sec VPN tunnels and troubleshooting network-related issues and providing timely resolution to minimize downtime.
* Azure Infrastructure Deployment: Deploy and configure Azure infrastructure components, such as virtual machines, storage accounts, virtual networks, load balancers and other azure services. Implement automation and infrastructure-as-code (IaaC) practices using tools like Terraform, Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, PowerShell, or Azure CLI.
* Azure Service Provisioning: Provision and manage Azure services, including but not limited to Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, Azure Virtual Machines, Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure SQL Database, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure Active Directory (AAD).
* Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Set up monitoring and alerting mechanisms to ensure the health and performance of Azure resources. Investigate and resolve issues related to application availability, performance, and security. Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures.
* Security and Compliance: Implement and enforce security measures to protect Azure resources and data. Follow industry best practices and compliance standards. Conduct security assessments and vulnerability scans and implement necessary remediation actions.
* Backup and Disaster Recovery: Design and implement backup and disaster recovery strategies for Azure-based applications and data. Configure and manage Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, and other relevant services.
* Collaboration and Documentation: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, provide technical guidance, and support project delivery. Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures, and deployment guides.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay up to date with the latest Azure features, services, and industry trends. Continuously explore and propose new solutions, tools, and methodologies to optimize cloud infrastructure, enhance security, and streamline operations.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* Strong experience in designing, implementing, and managing cloud solutions on the Azure platform (AWS and GCP is a plus)
* Previous consulting experience or experience working with external clients
* Strong understanding of ETL processes and technologies
* Experience with a variety of data sources, including relational databases, flat files, and web APIs
* Experience with Python, Java, or another programming language
* Experience with data warehouse technologies, such as Azure, AWS, and Snowflake
* Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills
* Strong communication and teamwork skills
* Solid understanding of software development life cycle models as well as expert knowledge of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices and the ability to blend them together in the right proportions to fit a project and business environment
* Technical background, with understanding or hands-on experience in enterprise solutions for different industries
* High-level knowledge of BI architecture or data warehousing
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Effectively managing multiple deliverables, clients and projects in a fast-paced environment
* Proficiency in Azure services, including compute, storage, networking, and identity and access management (IAM).
* Proven experience in designing and implementing network infrastructure solutions in Microsoft Azure.
* Strong knowledge of Azure networking services, including virtual networks, VPN gateways, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, and Azure Load Balancer.
* Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards related to cloud environments.
* Solid understanding of cloud architecture patterns, scalability, high availability, and disaster recovery.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code (IaaC) tools like ARM templates, PowerShell, or Azure CLI.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in Azure cloud environments ((AWS and GCP is a plus).
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with teams and stakeholders.

**Key Stakeholders This Role Interacts With:**

**Internal**

* Senior BI Analyst
* Data Product Manager
* BI Architect / Senior Architect
* Data Engineers
* Analytics Developers (Power BI, Tableau)

**External**

* Clients Operations Leads and Mid-Level Managers
* Data Owners, Data Stewards
* Enterprise Information Management and Data Governance Team
* IT Staff – Architects, DBAs, Developers, etc

What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe: Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes. In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development. Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  
  
**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  
  
**More about Crowe:**

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

4bc6de7d.title: IT Solutions Consultant
4bc6de7d.description:
**Technical Consultant – API Management Platform Resiliency**
With a global team of 5600+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company in the world. Our offices have earned #GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.
  
  
**No AI Without API. Digitalization. Simply delivered.**
Join us at DHL Group Digital Platforms department, where innovation thrives and technology evolves. With a presence across three countries and two continents, we are building a One Stop Shop for all DHL Group APIs and AI-enabled services. Our startup spirit within a stable enterprise environment enables us to deliver secure, scalable, and modern platforms powered by Agile and DevSecOps practices.
  
  
**About The Role**
Join the API Management Platform (AMP) Resiliency team and strengthen the availability, recoverability, scalability and operational resilience of enterprise API services. The role assesses platform risks, defines resilience standards and recovery requirements, and drives improvement initiatives across cloud and on-premises environments.
  
  
The position requires knowledge of both Apigee X, Apigee Hybrid or another enterprise API gateway to support the resilience of our API management platforms. You will work across DevOps, network, cloud, security and infrastructure teams to improve disaster recovery, business continuity, service readiness and operational controls.
  
  
**#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace #digitalplatforms #APIPlatform #Resiliency #Cloud**
**Grow together**
**Your role as Technical Consultant - AMP Resiliency:**

* Coordinate platform resilience assessments, technical risk reviews and improvement roadmaps.
* Assess platform architecture for single points of failure, capacity constraints, service-dependency risks and recovery limitations.
* Define platform resilience, disaster recovery, business continuity and operational-readiness requirements.
* Identify critical service dependencies and support the definition and validation of recovery objectives.
* Plan, coordinate and govern disaster recovery, failover and recovery-readiness exercises; validate evidence, document outcomes, identify gaps and drive corrective actions to closure.
* Define and maintain resilience standards, runbooks, support procedures and service-readiness documentation.
* Establish minimum resilience and operational-readiness criteria for platform services.
* Work with DevOps, network, cloud, security and infrastructure teams to address availability, capacity, connectivity and recovery risks.
* Define and review monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboarding, observability and service-health reporting requirements.
* Assess the resilience and operational impact of vulnerabilities, BitSight findings, security findings and control gaps; coordinate remediation plans and monitor actions through closure.
* Support incident reviews and root-cause analysis, converting lessons learned into preventive improvements.
* Review platform changes, upgrades and architecture decisions for their impact on availability, recoverability and operational readiness.
* Report material risks, unresolved gaps, dependencies and remediation progress to relevant stakeholders.
* Promote consistent resilience practices across API gateway technologies and hosting models.
* Participate in major-incident escalation and the on-call support rotation when required, providing resilience, recovery and cross-team coordination expertise.

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here's what we are looking for:**

* Demonstrated experience in platform operations, infrastructure consulting, service reliability, SRE, disaster recovery or enterprise API platform support.
* Practical knowledge of both Apigee X and Apigee Hybrid.
* Strong knowledge of cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
* Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, business continuity, failover, capacity management and operational risk.
* Experience assessing technical architectures for resilience, recoverability and operational-readiness risks.
* Experience planning or governing disaster recovery and recovery-readiness exercises.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, observability and service-health reporting.
* Understanding of networking, connectivity, certificates, security controls and platform dependencies.
* Experience with incident management, problem management and root-cause analysis.
* Ability to define technical standards, produce clear assessments and drive cross-team remediation activities.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder-management and technical-consulting skills.
* Willingness and ability to participate in major-incident escalation and the on-call support rotation when required.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with SRE practices, Kubernetes, infrastructure automation or cloud platforms.
* Experience supporting security and compliance remediation in an enterprise environment.
* Knowledge of GCP and API platform network-connectivity patterns.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, Kubernetes and automation concepts.

**An array of benefits for you:**

* Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility.
* Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
* Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre-existing disease.
* In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

e0bcb12a.title: Program Manager, RWA, WW Returns & Recommerce
e0bcb12a.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon’s Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce (WWRR) team invents bold solutions in sustainable transportation and returns experiences that create trust and value for customers, selling partners, and shippers and benefit people and the planet. WWRR includes the full complement of business, product, program, operational, data, and software engineering teams, who work together to identify and remove defects that cause returns, reinvent the return experience, and manage the lifecycle of returned, overstock, and damaged products, with the objective of throwing nothing away.  
  
We are seeking a Program Manager to drive the launch and worldwide rollout of a new external-facing product portfolio. You will move a continuous pipeline of product launches, partner integrations, and marketplace expansions from ready-to-launch through pilot, GA, and worldwide scale — directly increasing the volume of capabilities in customers' hands.  
  
As launch and integration volume grows across the 2027 portfolio, this role scales with that activity. Your output is measured in launches delivered, partner integrations completed, and marketplaces enabled — with monthly productivity tracked against launches per PgM. You will work alongside product and engineering leaders who define capabilities, converting their roadmaps into executed, live-in-region launches.  
  
You will operate across multiple concurrent launch workstreams, coordinating UAT, instrumentation, KPI monitoring during rollout, merchant/partner onboarding, and launch documentation. This role requires strong program management fundamentals, launch-execution discipline, and comfort operating across teams in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities,  
  

* Drive product launches from ready-to-launch through worldwide rollout — own launch execution across a portfolio of new external-facing returns capabilities and pilots, moving each from pilot to GA to worldwide scale.
* Own launch readiness, quality gates, and post-launch KPIs — coordinate UAT, instrumentation, and go/no-go criteria so each launch meets bar, then monitor customer-facing and operational metrics during rollout and initiate corrective action to protect adoption.
* Deliver merchant and partner integrations at volume — manage the end-to-end onboarding and API integration experience for external partners and client applications, tracking readiness and clearing blockers to increase completed integrations.
* Run the launch pipeline across concurrent workstreams — prioritize competing launches, set and communicate realistic timelines, and manage dependencies across engineering, product, BD, and operations in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

92572bb1.title: Delivery Manager - US Staffing
92572bb1.description:
**Overview**
TekWissen Group is a workforce management provider throughout India and many other countries in the world.
  
  
**Job Title: Delivery Manager – US Staffing
  
  
Location: Bangalore
  
  
Job Type: Full Time
  
  
Work Type: Onsite
  
  
Shift Timing : US Shift
  
  
Experience: 15+ years**
**Job Description**

* We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Delivery Manager to lead and manage our US Staffing recruitment operations.
* The ideal candidate should have strong experience in US IT and Non-IT staffing, team leadership, client relationship management, MSP/VMS programs and end-to-end recruitment delivery.
* The candidate will be responsible for managing multiple recruitment teams, driving business performance, achieving placement targets, improving delivery efficiency and ensuring high levels of client satisfaction.
* This role requires a combination of strategic leadership, operational excellence, stakeholder management and strong business acumen.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**
**End-to-End Recruitment Delivery:**

* Lead and manage end-to-end US Staffing recruitment delivery across IT and Non-IT verticals.
* Ensure timely fulfilment of client requirements and achieve monthly, quarterly and annual placement targets.
* Drive recruitment performance through effective sourcing, screening, submission, interview coordination and placement strategies.
* Monitor critical and ageing requirements and ensure timely closures.

**Team Leadership & People Management**

* Lead, mentor and manage multiple recruitment teams consisting of Team Leads, Assistant Managers, Deputy Managers and Recruiters.
* Establish clear performance objectives, productivity benchmarks and accountability across teams.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, identify capability gaps and implement improvement plans.
* Develop leadership capabilities and build a high-performance recruitment culture.
* Drive employee engagement, retention and team development initiatives.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with direct clients, MSPs, implementation partners and hiring managers.
* Participate in client review meetings, business discussions and delivery performance reviews.
* Manage client escalations and ensure effective resolution of delivery challenges.
* Understand client hiring requirements, recruitment processes, SLAs and quality expectations.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen existing client relationships and expand account engagement.

**MSP / VMS Program Management**

* Manage recruitment delivery across MSP and VMS-based staffing programs.
* Ensure compliance with client-specific recruitment guidelines and submission processes.
* Demonstrate hands-on knowledge of platforms such as SAP Fieldglass, Beeline and other VMS tools.
* Monitor requisition ageing, submission ratios, interview conversion and fulfilment rates.
* Drive process improvements to enhance MSP program performance.

**Business & Financial Management**

* Take ownership of delivery performance, account productivity and business targets.
* Monitor revenue, gross profit, margins and overall account profitability, where applicable.
* Work closely with business leadership to develop delivery strategies and growth plans.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion, new business development and additional client requirements.
* Support RFP responses, client presentations and strategic business initiatives.

**MIS, Reporting & Performance Management**

* Analyse daily, weekly and monthly recruitment performance reports.
* Track key performance indicators such as:
* Number of submissions.
* Interview-to-submission ratio.
* Offer-to-joining ratio.
* Number of placements.
* Requirement fulfilment rate.
* Recruiter productivity.
* Time-to-fill and ageing requisitions.
* Revenue and gross profit performance.
* Present delivery updates and performance dashboards to senior management.
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective action plans.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience managing Fortune 500 client accounts.
* Exposure to multiple staffing domains such as IT, Engineering, Healthcare, Finance, Manufacturing and Life Sciences.
* Experience managing large recruitment teams across multiple locations.
* Experience in account management, P&L, revenue and margin management.
* Experience in scaling recruitment operations and improving delivery performance.

**TekWissen® Group is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity.**

eb096cdb.title: Strategic Program Manager
eb096cdb.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
  
  

* This position will be based on-site in our Bangalore office, working overnight IST hours to support the US Pacific Standard Time zone.\*\*

**Impact In This Role**
As a Strategic Program Manager (SPM) at Fictiv, you will collaborate with some of the world’s leading enterprises and innovative startups to accelerate product launches while maintaining the highest quality standards. Serving as a trusted advisor, you will leverage your expertise in engineering, operations, quality, and logistics to guide customers through every phase of the product lifecycle—from New Product Development (NPD) and New Product Introduction (NPI) to mass production.
  
  
You will play a critical role in ensuring customers’ products are launched on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Working closely with cross-functional teams across Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Fulfillment, you will scope, plan, and execute customer programs, consistently delivering exceptional service and tangible value throughout the product lifecycle.
  
  
With a focus on continuous improvement, you will help refine internal processes and drive operational enhancements that improve the customer experience. You will also mentor and guide Associate Strategic Program Managers (ASPMs), sharing knowledge and best practices to strengthen program execution and support the team’s overall success.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Champion the customer experience: Act as the primary customer advocate, building trusted relationships and delivering exceptional experiences that foster long-term customer loyalty.
* Lead cross-functional program execution: Collaborate with pre- and post-sales teams, including Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Fulfillment, to scope, plan, and execute customer programs, ensuring on-time delivery while proactively managing risks and changes throughout the program lifecycle.
* Apply technical and program management expertise: Leverage your knowledge of engineering and manufacturing processes, combined with strong program management skills, to identify risks early, develop mitigation strategies, and manage changes to keep programs on track.
* Serve as a trusted subject matter expert: Provide technical and operational insights to customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment on requirements, manufacturing feasibility, quality expectations, and program objectives.
* Drive program performance and accountability: Track and report on program milestones, timelines, deliverables, and key performance indicators, making necessary adjustments to maintain progress and meet customer expectations and quality standards.
* Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen operational efficiency, and enhance the overall customer experience in collaboration with cross- functional teams.
* Facilitate effective program communication: Lead regular status meetings with customers and internal stakeholders to communicate requirements, timelines, deliverables, and quality standards, maintain alignment, and proactively resolve blockers.
* Mentor and support Associate Strategic Program Managers (ASPMs): Share expertise, provide guidance, and reinforce program management best practices to strengthen execution capabilities and support the team's overall success.
* Support quality management: Adhere to and contribute to Fictiv's Quality Management System (QMS), supporting compliance with established quality standards and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Desired Traits**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Program management experience: 5+ years of experience managing complex projects or programs in fast-paced engineering or manufacturing environments.
* NPD and NPI expertise: Hands-on experience supporting New Product Development (NPD), New Product Introduction (NPI), and transitions into high-volume manufacturing.
* Manufacturing process knowledge: Expertise in one or more manufacturing processes, such as CNC machining, 3D printing, injection molding, sheet metal fabrication, die casting, or assembly.
* Customer-facing leadership: Experience leading complex, consultative customer engagements, using technical and operational expertise to align stakeholders, solve problems, and deliver successful outcomes.
* Program and risk management: Strong program planning, risk management, organizational, and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing demands and consistently meet deadlines.
* Tools and systems proficiency: Proficiency with program management tools and software for tracking milestones, managing deliverables, communicating updates, and reporting progress across distributed teams.
* Business and customer orientation: A self-starter with strong business acumen and a customer-first mindset, capable of solving complex problems and building meaningful relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement mindset: A demonstrated commitment to process optimization, operational excellence, service enhancement, and customer success.
* Mentorship and collaboration: A willingness to share knowledge, mentor colleagues, and promote best practices while working effectively across cross-functional teams.
* Growth mindset: A passion for continuous learning, developing innovative solutions, and tackling challenging problems in dynamic environments.
* Communication skills: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multicultural, cross-functional, and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong program management, risk management, and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines within a structured framework.
* Proficiency in standard program management tools and software used for tracking, communication, and reporting across distributed teams.
* Self-starter, with strong business acumen and a customer-first mindset, capable of solving problems and building deep, meaningful relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrates a focus on process optimization, service enhancement, and driving customer success.
* Passionate about learning, building solutions, and tackling challenges.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with experience working across multi-cultural, cross-functional teams.

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**
We’re actively seeking teammates who:
  
  

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

b7f80bd1.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
b7f80bd1.description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

**About the Role**

We're hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager for our Product & Engineering organization. You'll own two areas:

* **Product delivery and release readiness** for Seismic software (including Highspot by Seismic): making sure features ship on time, at quality, with go-to-market teams ready on day one.
* **Technical programs** that span teams, such as localization workflows, architecture upgrades, and other technical initiatives.

You'll work across Engineering, Product, Design, Product Marketing and customer-facing teams. You'll turn ambitious goals into clear plans, make tradeoffs visible, and keep programs moving without needing formal authority.

Who you are::

**Required**

* 5+ years as a Technical Program Manager or in a similar role in B2B SaaS, leading complex cross-functional programs.
* Experience managing the full software development lifecycle and go-to-market readiness for product launches. Critically, you have delivered not only internal projects, but you have overseen feature/product delivery to external customers.
* Deep experience with agile/scrum, and judgment about when to adapt process for a large, complex organization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Data-driven: you use metrics to make decisions, surface risks and measure success. You're comfortable getting data yourself with tools like Amplitude, SQL and Snowflake.
* Hands-on use of AI tools to automate workflows, speed up delivery and remove manual work. Please share examples in your application.
* Flexibility working across time zones, in particular coordinating across North America and sometimes China.

**Nice to have**

* Experience leading change management or new technology adoption across an organization.
* Experience with Jira/Confluence, LaunchDarkly, Salesforce, and sales enablement products.
* PMP, CSM, SAFe or similar certification.

What you'll be doing::

**Product delivery & release readiness**

* Own end-to-end program management for a core product feature area across multiple engineering teams in different geos, keeping a predictable delivery cadence.
* Run the release readiness process: drive sign-off from Engineering, QE, Security and other functions, and make sure features are high quality and well documented.
* Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, Support and Technical Account Managers so customer-facing teams are enabled and customers are set up for success at launch.

**Technical programs**

* Lead internal and/or customer-facing technical programs from definition through delivery: set scope, build the plan, line up owners and drive adoption.
* Lead change management for new processes and tools, including stakeholder alignment, communication, training and measuring adoption.

**Across both**

* Define and track program metrics and business KPIs, and give stakeholders and leadership clear, concise status.
* Spot risks and dependencies early, raise them with options, and drive them to resolution.
* Find manual, repetitive program work and automate it, including with AI tools.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First** **90 days****:** Own the release calendar for a major product area (to be determined), establish relationships across functions and run at least one release end to end.
* **First year:** Releases are predictable and GTM teams are consistently ready at launch. At least one technical program is delivered with measurable adoption.

Job Posting Footer:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

We collaborate with **global technology leaders** to design and deliver **reliable, intelligent, and future-ready** systems that help organizations **connect, collaborate, and secure** their operations.

With over a decade of success and a rapidly expanding portfolio across **corporate, institutional, and government sectors**, Ital Solutions is committed to **engineering excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction**.

You will collaborate with **clients, consultants, OEMs, and internal teams** to deliver technically sound and commercially competitive proposals that align with project requirements and industry standards.

* Validate designs and ensure **technical compliance** with consultant and client specifications.

* Maintain **up-to-date system drawings, schematics, and version-controlled documentation**.
* Collaborate with project and procurement teams for accurate equipment selection and pricing.
* Ensure **proposal quality, accuracy, and timely submission** for all tenders and bids.

* Attend **client meetings, technical discussions, and consultant presentations** to explain proposed solutions confidently.
* Coordinate with **OEMs and distributors** for product specifications, technical clarifications, and quotations.
* Support the sales team with **pre-bid queries, product demonstrations, and competitive positioning**.

**Post-Award Technical Support**

* Provide **handover documentation and technical clarifications** to project execution teams post-award.
* Assist with **design updates, material finalization, and integration planning** during the implementation phase.

**Innovation & Knowledge Development**

* Keep abreast of **emerging technologies, standards, and integration trends** in ELV, ICT, and security systems.
* Contribute to the development of **standard design templates, product libraries, and internal technical documentation**.
* Share insights with management to support **continuous improvement and knowledge sharing** across teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Bachelor’s or Diploma** in Electronics, Electrical, Communication, or related Engineering disciplines.
* **3-6 years** of hands-on experience in **Presales / Design / Estimation** within ELV, ICT, or Security Systems (India or GCC experience preferred).

**Job Description**

Freshservice is expanding what “AI-driven ITSM” means for our customers — from Freddy AI Copilot and Freddy AI Agent, to Agent Studio for building custom agentic workflows, to MCP Gateway connecting Freshservice to the broader AI stack. We're creating a new kind of Solutions Engineering role to match: the Lead AI Solution Engineer.

This is a specialist presales role for someone who can do three things at once: speak credibly to technical and business buyers about AI value, architect and demo AI solutions on top of Freshservice, and stay hands-on enough to help customers get those solutions live post-sale. You'll be the AI subject-matter expert embedded in SMB and Commercial deals, partnering with Account Executives, core SEs, Product, and Professional Services to win competitive deals and make sure the AI value we sell is the AI value customers actually realize.

You'll report into the Solutions Engineering leadership team and act as a force multiplier for the broader SE org — enabling peers, building reusable AI demo assets, and representing the voice of the customer back to Product on where our AI roadmap needs to go next.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the technical narrative for AI/Freddy across strategic and competitive deals — positioning Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, Agent Studio, and MCP Gateway against how prospects actually work today, not a generic AI pitch.
* Design and deliver tailored AI proofs-of-concept and demos: configuring agentic workflows, custom skills, and automations in Agent Studio, and connecting Freshservice to customer data and tools via MCP Gateway and APIs.
* Lead technical discovery specifically for AI use cases — ticket deflection, agent-assist, workflow automation, knowledge management — quantifying expected impact (deflection rate, resolution time, agent productivity) with the customer, not just for them.
* Lead internal projects that improve Solution Engineering efficiency and productivity, identifying repetitive processes and building AI driven workflows to simplify or automate them.
* Partner with Account Executives and core Solution Engineers as the AI overlay specialist on SMB, Commercial and competitive pursuits, joining deals at the point where AI differentiation matters most.
* Support deal-winning activities end to end: RFP/RFI responses, executive briefings, proof-of-value engagements, and security/architecture reviews for AI components (data handling, model governance, integration security).
* Bridge presales to delivery: work with Professional Services and Customer Success to help scope and de-risk the implementation of AI solutions sold, so what was demoed is what gets deployed.
* Build and maintain a library of reusable AI demo environments, reference architectures, and ROI/business-case models that the wider SE team can self-serve.
* Track competitive AI positioning versus ServiceNow (Now Assist), SysAid, Quest KACE, and other ITSM/ITAM players — including where competitors are genuinely ahead, so the team's positioning stays credible rather than one-sided.
* Represent customer and field feedback on AI features and gaps directly to Product and Engineering, influencing roadmap prioritization.
* Mentor and enable other SEs on AI positioning, demo technique, and objection handling as the internal go-to expert.

**Qualifications**

**What You'll Bring**

* 8+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Consulting, or Technical Presales, ideally within ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, or broader enterprise SaaS.
* Strong AI fundamentals. You deeply understand how LLMs and agents work in production: context engineering, memory, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, and the failure modes that actually show up at scale. You've worked with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or equivalent) and with both open and closed source models.
* Hands-on experience deploying or configuring AI/LLM-based solutions in a customer-facing context — this can be conversational AI/copilots, RAG-based knowledge assistants, or agentic workflow automation; deep AI/ML research experience is required.
* Hands on expectations around building internal agents and automations. For example, creating agents that can interact with multiple internal systems, collect and consolidate information from different sources, reason across that context, and provide actionable recommendations or trigger downstream workflows.
* A track record of selling and positioning AI or automation value to both business stakeholders (ROI, productivity, risk) and technical stakeholders (architecture, security, integration). Experience building production-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience running competitive deals and building honest, differentiated positioning rather than one-size-fits-all pitches.
* Comfort operating across the full deal lifecycle — from discovery and demo through proof-of-value and into implementation handoff.
* Excellent executive presence and communication skills; able to flex a technical AI conversation up to a CIO/CX-leader audience or down to a hands-on admin audience in the same week.
* Freshservice, Freshdesk, or comparable ITSM/CX platform experience (ServiceNow, SysAid, Zendesk, Jira Service Management) is a strong plus.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with Freddy AI, Agent Studio, or Freshworks products specifically.
* Experience with ITAM/discovery tooling (e.g., Device42) and how it feeds AI-driven automation.
* Exposure to AI governance conversations (data residency, model risk, responsible AI) in regulated industries.
* A builder's instinct — you'd rather stand up a working demo than a slide.

**Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

447d9874.title: Platform Engineer (Private Cloud Solutions)
447d9874.description:
**About Nexcess**

Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

**How we work**

* **Business alignment and focus come first.** Engineering here exists to move the business, not to be busy. You will know which few things matter most this month and why, say so when the work in front of you is not one of them, and land what you committed to on dates the business can plan around, at a quality that does not come back as an incident or a customer escalation.
* **Predictable, reliable delivery of quality software is the output of this job**, and everything below is in service of it.
* **This job gets more hands-on every quarter, not less.** The volume of code goes up while the time you spend typing it goes down, so the value moves to the two ends of it: what you specify, and what you verify. You will stay close to production, run the AI harness daily, read code you did not write, and keep your technical judgment current rather than remembered.
* **Whoever ships it owns it, regardless of what wrote it.** Most code is AI-generated now, so the judgment moved to either side of it: specifying exactly what to build, and verifying that what came back is correct, secure and operable. An agent wrote it is not a defense. Your name is on the merge.
* **You do not need to own the roadmap to know why the work matters.** You will not be the Product counterpart at this level and you are not expected to be. You are expected to understand what the customer gets and what the business gains from the thing you are building, and to ask before you build the wrong thing correctly. The engineers who move fastest here are the ones who ask that question early rather than at the review.
* **You go on call for what you build,** and you take your turn on the rotation. Engineering declares risk and timelines in writing for the business to accept, and that includes yours: when a date is at risk you say so early, with evidence, rather than quietly.

**Responsibilities**

* **Own platform features end to end within the Private Cloud Solutions domain.** Take work from specification through implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing production support across Nutanix and VMware environments.
* **Design, deploy, and maintain private cloud infrastructure.** Work with Nutanix platforms and related virtualization technologies to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure customer environments.
* **Build and operate multi-tenant Nutanix environments.** Support cluster design, deployment, administration, lifecycle management, and ongoing maintenance in shared production environments.
* **Improve platform reliability and operational efficiency.** Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work, standardize configurations, and reduce operational risk.
* **Translate requirements into clear technical specifications.** Identify dependencies, capacity needs, failure scenarios, and operational risks early and resolve ambiguity before implementation begins.
* **Verify changes before they reach production.** Validate platform changes, exercise failure scenarios, and provide clear evidence that changes are safe and production-ready.
* **Use AI-assisted engineering tools as part of your daily workflow.** Apply agentic tooling to implementation, automation, and review while remaining accountable for the quality and operability of the final result.
* **Review infrastructure and technical changes from other engineers.** Identify design, scalability, reliability, and operational risks early and provide clear, actionable feedback.
* **Own the systems you run.** Participate in on-call rotation, respond to incidents, document root causes and follow-up actions, and continuously reduce operational toil.
* **Work safely in existing and unfamiliar environments.** Understand complex or legacy infrastructure, make incremental improvements without unnecessary redesigns, and leave systems better documented and instrumented than you found them.
* **Mentor other engineers.** Share technical knowledge, explain design and operational decisions, and support less experienced engineers through implementation and review.
* **Coordinate dependencies across teams.** Identify cross-team requirements early andwork directly with the relevant engineers to avoid delivery blockers.

**Required**

* 5+ years of experience with **Nutanix administration**, including initial cluster design, deployment, and setup.
* 5+ years of experience with **Nutanix multi-tenant environments**, including installation, administration, maintenance, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of virtualization, compute, storage, networking, and production infrastructure.
* Experience building, operating, and supporting highly available private cloud or virtualized environments.
* Experience troubleshooting complex issues across multiple infrastructure layers.
* Experience planning and executing infrastructure changes in production environments.
* Experience participating in an on-call rotation and responding to production incidents.
* Ability to work effectively in unfamiliar or legacy environments and make safe, incremental improvements.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering tools as part of day-to-day technical work.
* Clear written communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote, distributed team across multiple time zones.

**Preferred**

* 5+ years of experience with **Linux administration**.
* Experience with **VMware** administration and virtualization environments.
* Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management.
* Experience with multi-tenant private cloud platforms.
* Experience in managed hosting, cloud platforms, or another high-availability service
* environment.
* Experience reviewing infrastructure changes and mentoring other engineers.

  
**The pay range for this role is:**  
5,000 - 6,000 EUR per month(SDC Cyprus)  
4,000 - 5,000 EUR per month(SDC Slovakia)  
3,000 - 4,000 EUR per month(SDC Bulgaria)

ac7b2e0d.title: Platform Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
ac7b2e0d.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience in cloud computing (e.g., Google Cloud or similar Public Cloud Platform, Compute, Storage, Networking, software, Platform as a Service (PaaS), Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)).
* Experience leading cloud migrations, digital implementations, or managed services operations for organizations.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, pen testing).

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs of concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will use your strategic acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.  

You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in-depth workshops.

* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

e47b1856.description:
**Job Title:** Solution Architect.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for elite, hybrid professionals who possess a rare combination of strategic business consulting acumen, deep technical AI architecture capabilities, and profound vertical domain expertise. In this role, you will act as the ultimate bridge between client business strategies and cutting-edge technology. You will engage directly with CXO-level stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities, architect comprehensive multi-agent systems, design robust ROI models, and lead engineering teams from initial blueprinting to production-scale deployment.

**Key Responsibilities**

As a domain-focused Solution Lead and AI Architect, your responsibilities seamlessly span the strategic and the technical lifecycles:

* **Strategic Discovery:** Engage directly with enterprise customers to break down complex processes, diagnose structural pain points, and map them directly to agentic AI opportunities.
* **Value Modelling & Proposals:** Lead discovery workshops and current-state assessments to define the overarching solution vision, crafting compelling business cases and ROI/cost-savings models for client leadership.
* **Core Architecture Design:** Translate complex business requirements into scalable, robust agentic AI architectures.
* **Multi-Agent Orchestration:** Design complex multi-agent systems encompassing advanced orchestration, planning, memory frameworks, tool/function calling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and strict guardrails.

e2273cad.title: Technical Architect
e2273cad.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

Project Description:  
The system utilizes specialized LLM agents and Gemini Enterprise solutions to perform automated enterprise data retrieval, multi-step logical reasoning, and knowledge synthesis leveraging tools like NotebookLM and the Google Workspace Ecosystem. The platform integrates robust enterprise security, Access Control Lists (ACLs), and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) protocols to securely connect disparate data silos (including third-party platforms like Microsoft Entra ID/M365, Salesforce, and Atlassian) while upholding organizational safety, security, and precision standards.

Role:  
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) specializing in Gemini Enterprise, Agentic AI, and Multi-Agent Systems

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Design, develop, and deploy production-grade Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) and agentic workflows using Gemini Enterprise  
Identify need for Pro Code Vs No Code design based on customer’s problem statement and data sources  
Design Deploy and custom agents using the Agent Development Kit (ADK), and Agent Platform AI Reasoning Engine and integrate with Gemini Enterprise  
Build native integrations across the Google Workspace Ecosystem (Docs, Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Meet) and NotebookLM for grounded enterprise research, document automation, and conversational discovery.  
Architect scalable short-term session storage, conversation state persistence, and long-term memory architectures across multi-agent interactions.  
Implement end-to-end authentication and authorization perimeters for agents, Google Cloud services, and 3rd-party SaaS integrations (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID / M365, Salesforce, Atlassian) using IAM, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and service identities.  
Enforce fine-grained Access Control Lists (ACLs), user/group permission inheritance, and data governance policies to ensure agents strictly adhere to enterprise access boundaries.  
Utilize developer tooling including Agent CLI and Antigravity for local rapid prototyping, testing, emulation, distributed tracing, and root cause analysis (RCA).  
Architect Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows, ensuring seamless Interrupt and Resume patterns between autonomous agents and human experts for critical decision points.  
Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to manage versioned agent deployments, automated testing, and continuous regression evaluations.  
Implement advanced reasoning patterns such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT), ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, and Self-Reflection to enhance agent reliability.  
Establish quantitative evaluation frameworks to measure agent trajectories, tool invocation precision/recall, and reasoning faithfulness.  
Collaborate directly with client engineering and architecture teams to deploy, validate, and operationalize enterprise agentic AI solutions in client environments.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

Must Have Skills  
Core Engineering & Frameworks: Strong proficiency in Python with production-level software engineering practices, along with deep, hands-on experience building multi-agent systems using Google ADK (Agent Development Kit) or comparable agentic frameworks.  
Gemini & Workspace Ecosystem: Solid hands-on experience deploying and customizing Gemini Enterprise, NotebookLM, and integrating with the broader Google Workspace Ecosystem (APIs, Add-ons, Drive/Docs connectors).  
Memory & State Architecture: Demonstrated expertise in managing agent session state, short-term context caching, and durable long-term memory backends (vector databases, relational/NoSQL session stores).  
Third Party Tools: Experience with MCP Connectors to securely integrate core third-party platforms (e.g., iManage, NetDocuments, Relativity, DocuSign, MS Office Suite, Sharepoint, JIRA) with Gemini Enterprise.  
Auth & Security: Strong understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (IAM, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, Service Accounts, Workload Identity Federation) across Google Cloud and 3rd-party SaaS platforms (Microsoft Entra ID, Salesforce, Atlassian).  
ACLs & Permissions: Deep working knowledge of enterprise Access Control Lists (ACLs), identity federation, permission trimming, and role-based access control (RBAC) across heterogeneous data sources.  
Developer Tooling: Proficiency in developer tooling such as Agent CLI and Antigravity for local simulation, debugging, prompt engineering, and execution graph tracing.  
CI/CD & DevOps: Proven track record of configuring and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions) for agent containerization, deployment, and test automation.  
Evaluation & Debugging: Practical knowledge of AI evaluation methodologies, trajectory analysis, and performing root cause analysis (RCA) on agent execution failures, tool errors, and prompt regressions.  
Client Collaboration: Strong technical communication, consulting acumen, and client-facing collaboration skills within an Agile environment.

Good-to have skills

Experience with inter-agent communication protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) architectures.  
Experience integrating agents with Enterprise Knowledge Graphs, structured ontologies, and hybrid vector search systems.  
Experience with enterprise data security frameworks such as Sensitive Data Protection (SDP/DLP) and VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC).

Certifications and Trainings  
Professional Machine Learning Engineer  
Google Skill Boost labs/course  
Introduction to Gemini Enterprise : https://partner.skills.google/course\_templates/1401  
Gemini Enterprise and NotebookLM : https://partner.skills.google/paths/3667  
Getting started with ADK: https://www.skills.google/catalog\_lab/32017  
Deployment: https://www.skills.google/catalog\_lab/32530  
Build and deploy multi agent: https://www.skills.google/course\_templates/1445

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

DevOps - GCP,Python,Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG),Model Context Protocol (MCP),Agent Orchestration Frameworks,Google Gemini

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

Qualifications and Prior Experience  
8+ years of experience in software development, cloud solution architecture, and AI engineering (preferably on Google Cloud Platform).  
Proven track record of designing, building, and deploying production AI agents or enterprise GenAI solutions using ADK, Vertex AI, or Gemini.  
Hands-on experience in customer-facing technical delivery, solutions engineering, or forward-deployed engineering (FDE) roles.  
Familiarity with enterprise Agile development lifecycles, sprint delivery, and stakeholder management

3618d871.title: Databricks Technical Platform Architect
3618d871.description:

optimize enterprise-scale Data, Analytics & AI platforms, with a primary focus on Databricks (70%) and AWS Cloud

Services (30%).

and service enablement, platform engineering, automation, performance optimization, and emerging AI technologies. The

role requires practical experience in enabling, integrating, and scaling enterprise platform capabilities rather than focusing

primarily on data pipeline development.

The architect will contribute to building scalable, secure, reliable, and future-ready platforms while collaborating with

dedicated Architecture Leads across Governance, Security & FinOps; Ingestion & Integration; and Self-Service

Enablement to ensure architectural consistency and seamless platform integration.

REQUIRED TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE & EXPERTISE

1.

Databricks Platform Architecture & Engineering (Primary – 70%)

Lakehouse platforms on AWS.

Strong expertise in Databricks account and workspace architecture, compute configurations, SQL Warehouses,

serverless computing, workload isolation, and multi-environment deployments.

configurations.

Generative AI workloads.

Hands-on experience with Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, Databricks Asset Bundles, Git, CI/CD automation, and

Strong understanding of Apache Spark architecture, compute performance optimization, platform observability,

troubleshooting, and operational reliability.

adoption.

Practical experience with AWS services, including:

Ability to design and implement secure, scalable integrations between AWS services, Databricks, and enterprise

Strong troubleshooting experience across AWS infrastructure, networking, service connectivity, permissions, and cloud

authentication, usage monitoring, and integration with external AI applications.

Experience enabling Databricks Omnigent (AI Agent Framework and Meta-Harness), including agent orchestration,

integration, and Model Serving endpoints.

Understanding of Ontology and Semantic Layer enablement, including business metadata, semantic models, entity

relationships, and integration with Databricks AI/BI Genie.

Familiarity with Databricks Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, and enterprise GenAI platform architecture.

Experience integrating Databricks-hosted AI services with AWS Bedrock, external LLM providers, APIs, and enterprise AI

Ability to evaluate emerging AI technologies, conduct technical POCs, and establish scalable, secure, and reusable AI

platform architecture patterns.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

7+ years of IT experience, including 5+ years in Cloud/Data Platform Architecture and 3+ years of hands-on Databricks

Platform Architecture experience.

Proven experience designing, implementing, configuring, and supporting enterprise-scale Databricks platforms on AWS.

Strong hands-on expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure, service enablement, networking, connectivity, and platform

integration.

Experience with Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, Git, CI/CD, platform automation, and multi-environment deployment

management.

Strong understanding of distributed computing, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, cloud-native architecture, and enterprise

platform integration.

Experience enabling enterprise AI/ML, Generative AI, and advanced analytics platform capabilities.

Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical solutions, develop architecture designs, troubleshoot complex platform issues,

and implement enterprise technology standards.

Strong technical problem-solving, architecture documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience supporting large-scale, multi-workspace, multi-domain enterprise Databricks environments.

Manufacturing domain experience and familiarity with SAP ERP data ecosystems, including ECC, S/4HANA, and SAP

Business Data Cloud.

Experience with dbt, SAP Business Data Cloud, and enterprise data integration platforms.

Hands-on exposure to Unity AI Gateway, Omnigent, Ontology/Semantic Layer enablement, Mosaic AI, and AI/BI Genie.

Experience integrating AWS Bedrock and external AI/LLM services with Databricks.

Relevant Databricks and AWS architecture certifications.

Pay: ₹2,125,000.00 - ₹2,260,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

aa2b8740.title: Associate Architect - Retail and Supply Chain
aa2b8740.description:
**About Tarento:**

Tarento is a fast-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high-impact solutions.

We're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose.

**Role: Solution Architecture - Retail & Supply Chain**

**Exp**: *8-12 years'*

**Location**: Bangalore

**Mode of work**: Hybrid

**About the role**

You will be the solution architect embedded with a global retail client's Integrated Planning team. You'll own the end-to-end architecture for supply chain and inventory initiatives across regions. The role sits between business stakeholders, client architects and delivery teams: you turn complex business problems into robust, scalable designs with practical short-term fixes and long-term target-state solutions.

  

**Key responsibilities**

* + Understand business and operational problems across supply chain, inventory and fulfilment, and translate them into clear architecture solutions.
  + Create and present High-Level Designs (HLDs) covering systems, integration flows, data flows and interfaces, and take them through review and sign-off with client architects and stakeholders.
  + Design integrations across ERP, OMS, POS, WMS, inventory services and data platforms (DC-to-DC in-transit tracking, store inventory visibility, click & collect, data lake feeds).
  + Define both interim solutions and long-term target architecture, with trade-offs, risks and dependencies clearly documented.
  + Work with business, product, delivery and regional teams across Europe, the Americas and APAC to keep architecture aligned with programme timelines and release plans.
  + Support delivery teams through build, testing and rollout by clarifying design intent, resolving integration issues and governing changes.
  + Spot opportunities to apply AI and new technology to the client's business problems, and shape them into proposals.

**Must-have skills**

* + 8+ years in IT, with 4+ years in solution or integration architecture roles.
  + Strong grounding in retail or supply chain domains: inventory, order management, distribution and fulfilment.
  + Hands-on experience with integration patterns (APIs, event-driven/messaging, batch and file-based) and enterprise systems (ERP, OMS, POS, WMS).
  + Proven ability to write clear, sign-off-ready HLDs and present them to senior technical and business audiences.
  + Working knowledge of cloud platforms and data platforms or data lakes.
  + Excellent stakeholder management and communication across geographies.

**Good to have**

* + Experience with Microsoft Dynamics/AX or similar retail ERP landscapes.
  + Exposure to AI/ML use cases in retail or supply chain.
  + Presales or consulting background (proposals, estimations, client pitches).
  + Architecture certification (TOGAF, Azure or AWS Solutions Architect).

**What success looks like**

* + HLDs delivered on time and signed off with minimal rework.
  + Smooth releases with no architecture-driven delays.
  + High client satisfaction and trust from client architects and business leads.

Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.
  
  
**We Are Proud Of**

* The work we do and the innovation we drive
* Our values of share, care and dare
* A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
* Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

**The role**
As a
**[Solution Architect]**
, you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring
**12+ YEARS]**
of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.

* A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
* A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
* Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data

The role requires close collaboration with clients, engineering teams, technical leads, and other architects throughout solution definition and delivery

Well versed with technologies including Java/JEE, .Microsoft .Net technologies

Ability to document key architecture decisions, assumptions, dependencies, risks, constraints, and trade-offs.
  
  
Technical Leadership

position based in
