bd2c5264.title: Sr Architect (Servicenow ITOM)
bd2c5264.description:
**Job Description: ServiceNow ITOM Architect**

**Company:** Altera Health (A Harris Computer Business)
  
**Location:** India (Remote / Hybrid)
  
**Function:** AI & Automation — Engineering

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **ServiceNow ITOM Expert** to join our AI and Tools Automation team. You will own the design, implementation, and evolution of our IT Operations Management capabilities on ServiceNow — spanning Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB governance, and AI-powered auto-remediation workflows. You will be a technical authority who can work independently, integrate ITOM deeply with monitoring platforms like **LogicMonitor, AppDynamics, SentryOne** , and drive intelligent, self-healing IT operations across a complex healthcare IT environment.

This is not a configuration role — we need someone who architects, engineers, and leads.

**Key Responsibilities**

**ITOM Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end architecture and roadmap for ServiceNow ITOM capabilities — Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB, and Health Log Analytics (HLA)
* Define platform standards, integration patterns, and governance models for ITOM across the organization
* Lead technical design reviews, contribute to architectural decisions, and represent ITOM in cross-functional planning
* Independently investigate, debug, and resolve complex ITOM platform issues — from MID Server failures to CMDB reconciliation conflicts — without escalation
* Identify opportunities to consolidate, automate, and modernize legacy monitoring and event workflows

**Discovery & CMDB Governance**

* Design and maintain **ServiceNow Discovery** patterns — horizontal, vertical, and cloud discovery across on-prem, Azure, and hybrid environments
* Own **CMDB** health — deduplication, reconciliation rules, CI relationships, data certification, and lifecycle management
* Build and enforce CMDB governance frameworks that ensure accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness
* Manage **Service Mapping** — application service discovery, dependency mapping, and business service modeling aligned to healthcare IT operations
* Design CI class structures, identification and reconciliation rules, and IRE (Identification and Reconciliation Engine) policies

**Event Management & AIOps**

* Architect and manage the **Event Management** pipeline — connector configuration, alert ingestion, event correlation rules, and suppression logic
* Configure and tune **Health Log Analytics (HLA)** for log-based anomaly detection and noise reduction
* Build intelligent alert correlation and deduplication rules to reduce alert fatigue and accelerate MTTR
* Design event-to-incident promotion workflows with smart routing, priority assignment, and SLA alignment
* Integrate **LogicMonitor** as a primary event source — mapping LM alert payloads to ServiceNow event schema, managing thresholds, and ensuring bidirectional status synchronization

**Auto-Remediation & Intelligent Workflows**

* Design and build **auto-heal workflows** that trigger automated remediation actions in response to ITOM events — owning the architectural principle that condition-determination logic belongs in the monitoring layer (LogicMonitor), with ServiceNow executing remediation based on clean, pre-evaluated signals
* Build **Flow Designer** and **Integration Hub** workflows for automated incident response, CI status updates, and cross-platform orchestration
* Develop spoke integrations and REST/MID-based connectors for third-party tools
* Implement safety checks and precondition validations within remediation flows to prevent unintended actions in production environments
* Continuously improve auto-remediation coverage and reliability through feedback loops with the monitoring team

**MID Server & Integration Engineering**

* Own **MID Server** architecture — deployment topology, cluster configuration, upgrades, health monitoring, and failover
* Design and maintain integration architecture between ServiceNow and external platforms — LogicMonitor, Azure Monitor, Kubernetes, and other operational tools
* Build and maintain **REST** , **SOAP** , and **scripted integrations** using Integration Hub, Scripted REST APIs, and Import Sets
* Manage credentials, connection pooling, and secure credential storage using ServiceNow Credential Vault

**AI-Augmented Engineering**

* Actively use **AI tools** (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) as a core part of the engineering workflow — for scripting, debugging, documentation, and solution design
* Leverage AI to accelerate complex problem-solving — generating Business Rules, Flow Designer logic, Scripted REST endpoints, and Groovy/JavaScript-based scripts faster and with higher quality
* Use AI to explore and prototype new ITOM automation patterns and self-healing use cases
* Stay current with ServiceNow’s native AI/ML capabilities — Predictive Intelligence, NLU, and Virtual Agent — and assess their applicability to the team’s operational goals

**Azure & Cloud Integration**

* Deep understanding of **Azure platform** as it relates to ITOM — Azure Monitor, Azure Arc, Log Analytics Workspaces, Event Grid, and resource tagging models
* Architect cloud discovery and service mapping for Azure-hosted workloads — VMs, AKS clusters, PaaS services, and resource groups
* Integrate Azure-native alerting and telemetry into the ServiceNow Event Management pipeline
* Understand Azure RBAC and Entra ID as they apply to MID Server service accounts, API integrations, and CMDB data sources

**GitHub & Development Practices**

* Operate confidently in **GitHub** — maintain ITOM configuration as code where possible, manage update sets through version control, and use GitHub Actions for deployment automation
* Document integration designs, flow logic, and architectural decisions clearly and maintain them in source control
* Apply software engineering discipline to ServiceNow scripting — clean code, peer review, and regression testing before deployment to production

**Platform Governance & Mentorship**

* Own the ITOM module’s platform health — upgrades, deprecation planning, performance tuning, and licensing awareness
* Define and enforce development standards for ITOM scripting, flow design, and integration work
* Mentor developers (such as Kamalesh) working on ITOM-adjacent tasks and conduct structured code and configuration reviews
* Contribute to organization-wide ITSM/ITOM alignment — ensuring CMDB, Event Management, and incident workflows operate as a cohesive system

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **10+ years** of ServiceNow experience, with **4+ years** specialized in **ITOM** — Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB
* Expert-level knowledge of **MID Server** architecture, deployment, and troubleshooting
* Deep proficiency in **ServiceNow scripting** — JavaScript, Business Rules, Script Includes, Scripted REST APIs, Scheduled Jobs
* Strong command of **Flow Designer** and **Integration Hub**
* Proven experience building **event-driven auto-remediation** workflows at production scale
* **Deep, hands-on Azure platform knowledge** — Monitor, Arc, Log Analytics, Event Grid, Entra ID; able to architect cloud ITOM integrations independently
* Experience integrating **LogicMonitor** or comparable monitoring platforms (Dynatrace, Datadog, SCOM) with ServiceNow Event Management
* **GitHub proficiency** — branching, PRs, Actions-based CI/CD, and managing ServiceNow config artifacts in source control
* Strong independent debugging skills — able to own and resolve complex, multi-system issues without escalation
* **Demonstrated fluency with AI tools** in day-to-day engineering — uses AI to solve problems, generate scripts, and prototype solutions
* Excellent communication skills — can represent ITOM architecture decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders

**Good to Have**

* Experience with **Health Log Analytics (HLA)** and log-based AIOps
* Familiarity with **Kubernetes / AKS** monitoring and CMDB integration for containerized workloads
* Knowledge of **ServiceNow Predictive Intelligence** and ML-based alert correlation
* Exposure to **ITSM** modules (Incident, Change, Problem) and their integration touchpoints with ITOM
* Familiarity with **LogicMonitor** platform internals — DataSources, alert payloads, Groovy scripting
* Understanding of healthcare IT environments and compliance considerations
* ServiceNow **Certified Implementation Specialist — ITOM** certification
* Experience with **Virtual Agent** or **NLU** for ITOM self-service scenarios

**Who You Are**

* An ITOM engineer who treats the platform as a **product** — not a tool to configure, but a system to architect and own
* **Deeply self-sufficient** — you debug across MID Servers, CMDB reconciliation logs, Flow Designer execution histories, and REST payloads without waiting to be unblocked
* You use AI as a natural extension of your engineering toolkit — it makes you faster and sharper
* You hold strong architectural opinions and can defend them clearly — including knowing where logic belongs (monitoring layer vs. remediation layer)
* Comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving team where you are the ITOM domain authority
* A collaborative mentor who raises the engineering bar across adjacent team members
* You care about data quality in the CMDB the same way a data engineer cares about pipeline reliability

e39a5464.title: Assistant Program Manager – Customer Experience & Automation (Kirana Club)
e39a5464.description:
**About Kirana Club**
India has over 12 million kirana stores, and most still depend on traditional wholesale markets to source products for their shops.
  
  
Kirana Club is changing how these retailers discover, source, and replenish inventory. With 4 million+ kiranas on the platform, we're building a commerce marketplace that connects retailers directly with brands and sellers.
  
  
Now part of the Meesho family, we're entering our next phase of growth, with an opportunity to rethink how B2B commerce and fulfilment work at scale.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for someone who loves solving problems at their root, building scalable systems, and using technology to make things work better.
  
  
As we scale, thousands of retailers interact with our platform every day — placing orders, tracking deliveries, raising concerns, and requesting resolutions. Our goal is to build a customer experience where things work so reliably that retailers rarely need to contact support.
  
  
You'll own initiatives that improve the end-to-end retailer experience by identifying recurring problems, understanding why they happen, and building long-term solutions through better processes, product improvements, and automation.
  
  
This is not a traditional customer support management role. You won't be managing support agents or day-to-day ticket queues. Instead, you'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Customer Support to systematically eliminate friction and build scalable customer experience systems.
  
  
**What You'll Work On**

* Root cause analysis: Deep dive into customer complaints, support tickets, order journeys, and operational data to identify recurring issues and their underlying causes.
* Process and system design: Build scalable workflows, SOPs, escalation mechanisms, and resolution processes that prevent recurring problems and reduce manual intervention.
* Automation and AI: Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support workflows, customer communication, refunds, and issue resolution using technology and AI.
* Customer experience improvements: Work with Product and Engineering to simplify customer journeys, improve self-service capabilities, and proactively resolve issues before customers need to reach out.
* End-to-end problem ownership: Take problems from identification to solution design, implementation, and impact measurement. Ensure fixes are permanent rather than temporary workarounds.
* Data-driven prioritization: Quantify the impact of different customer experience problems and prioritize initiatives that meaningfully improve customer satisfaction, retention, and operational efficiency.

Some of the problems you might work on include reducing delivery-related complaints, automating refund and claims workflows, improving NDR resolution, and designing better customer communication systems.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. You can break down ambiguous problems, identify patterns in data, and get to the actual root cause rather than treating symptoms.
* Systems thinking. You naturally look for ways to eliminate recurring problems through better processes, technology, and automation.
* Strong product and technology orientation. You understand how digital products and workflows operate and can work effectively with engineering teams to build solutions. You don't need to be an engineer.
* Excellent prioritization. You can distinguish high-impact problems from noise and balance quick wins with long-term improvements.
* High ownership and bias for action. You're comfortable taking an idea from problem identification to implementation without waiting for detailed instructions.
* Strong execution and stakeholder management. You can work across Product, Tech, Operations, and other teams to get things done.
* Comfort with data
* 3–6 years of experience in business operations, program management, product operations, strategy & operations, process excellence, or customer experience transformation. Experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, logistics, or high-growth technology companies is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Fewer customer complaints and repeat contacts per order.
* Recurring problems eliminated through permanent process or product fixes.
* Higher levels of self-service and automation without compromising resolution quality.
* Faster, more reliable issue resolution with fewer manual escalations.
* A better and more consistent experience that helps retailers trust Kirana Club as their regular sourcing platform.

Why this role
  
  
Customer experience at Kirana Club is fundamentally a product, technology, and systems problem — not just a support problem.
  
  
You'll have the opportunity to rethink how customer experience works for millions of small retailers, build solutions that scale without proportional increases in support operations, and work closely with leadership on initiatives that directly impact customer trust, retention, and business growth.
  
  
If you enjoy finding out why things break, fixing them permanently, and making complex systems work seamlessly, this role offers the opportunity to do exactly that.

7721a034.title: Senior Solution Engineer - GCC
7721a034.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
  
  
We are looking for world-class Solution Engineers to join our Global field teams whose technical skills and customer savvy will help customers understand and utilise the value of the cutting-edge data platform that we are building. They must share our passion about reinventing the data platform and thrive in a dynamic environment.
  
  
The Solution Engineer will work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team on a handful of global accounts with GCCs in India to accelerate their Snowflake journey. The Solution Engineer will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to make Snowflake customers successful in driving existing projects and uncover new use cases. This data architect will have a broad range of skills and experience ranging from data architecture to ETL/ELT, data science, security, performance analysis, analytics, etc. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solution, the customer-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to not only build demos and execute proof-of-concepts but also to provide consultative assistance on architecture and implementation.
  
  
***This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation.***
The Solution Engineer has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers
* Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation
* Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing
* Be an advocate and develop mutual trust with the technical audience on the customer side
* Run training sessions, workshops, webinars to help customers become proficient in Snowflake
* Keeping customers up to date on key Snowflake product updates and future roadmaps to help them represent Snowflake to their clients about latest technology solutions and benefits
* Run technical enablement programs to provide best practices, and solution design workshops to help customers create effective solutions
* Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive Snowflake adoption
* Represent Snowflake at customer or industry events
* Forward Strategic thinking - quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging. Sharing customer success stories & case studies to showcase the impact of Snowflake

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum 10+ years of experience working in customer facing solution engineering (tech sales) role, preferably with large Global accounts
* University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience
* Strong competency on modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science and data apps
* Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, in small groups or at public events, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
* Hands-on expertise with SQL and Python
* Experience working with large global accounts, GSIs and/or Global Capability Centers
* Experience with large-scale database technology (e.g. Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, Hadoop etc.)
* Pre-sales experience in data related tech products
* Sound understanding and experience in the enterprise market and technology ecosystem

**ADDED BONUS FOR:**

* Data Science/AI/ML experience across a variety of platforms
* Familiarity and experience with common BI and data exploration tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Metabase etc).
* Cloud Provider Experience - Amazon AWS/Microsoft Azure/Google Cloud
* Data modeling and data architecture experience
* Experience selling enterprise SaaS software to Global Accounts
* Experience working with customers in the manufacturing industry would be beneficial.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
  
  
How do you want to make your impact?

**Join us in architecting high‑performance embedded software that powers and drives the next generation of wind energy.**

**If you are passionate about building robust software solutions, leading the architecture of large-scale embedded and real-time systems, and driving best-practice software development, this role is for you.**

**We are looking for a technical leader with strong stakeholder management skills and deep expertise in C++ and embedded software engineering, ready to navigate a complex and fast-paced environment.**

**Vestas Technology & Operations > Research & Development (R&D) > Product Applications & Controls R&D > Turbine Control Software Module > Technical Management**

Vestas Technology & Operations (VTO) brings together R&D, manufacturing, supply chain, and quality into one integrated organization, ensuring our products meet high standards for quality, efficiency, and time-to-market.

Within VTO, the “WTG Controls” solution is a team of skilled engineers and specialists across India, Portugal, and Denmark. We organized in SAFe/FlowAgile ARTs and develop advanced software solutions that support the turbine performance including the control system.

Our work is rooted in strong systems engineering principles, with a focus on delivering robust, high-quality software across the full product lifecycle. We take ownership end-to-end — from design to delivery — and continuously push the boundaries of what turbine software can achieve.

  

**Responsibilities**

As a Software Architect for Turbine Software, you will report to the Module Design Owner for Turbine SW and play a central role in defining and safeguarding the software architecture that powers all Vestas wind turbines. Your key responsibilities will include:

* Lead the architecture, design, and evolution of high-performance, safety-critical embedded software systems primarily developed in modern C++ (C++17/20 and beyond)
* Collaborate across engineering and cross‑functional teams to ensure alignment. Define and own the software architecture guidelines for the WTG Control solution with ~400 people. Translate business and technical requirements into clear architectural solutions and development guidelines
* Define and enforce coding standards, architectural patterns, and best practices for scalable, maintainable, and testable systems. Write high‑quality, performance, and testable code, and analyze complex legacy and modern codebases to implement fixes and improvements
* Ensure better support for the utilization of AI agentic frameworks for development
* Provide expert troubleshooting and operational support for products, tools, and customer‑reported issues
* Promote continuous integration and automated testing practices for embedded (e.g., unit testing frameworks and hardware-in-the-loop testing). Maintain and update comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture descriptions and interface specifications, to support software functionality and lifecycle management
* Drive continuous improvement by enhancing processes, tools, and developing utilities that support operations and maintenance

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Familiarity with software architecture principles, including modular design, layered architecture, and interface-driven and modular development
* Extensive experience in modern C++ development, with strong knowledge of recent language features (C++17/20 and beyond). Demonstrated experience in a technical leadership role within a large Agile software development organization
* Proven experience in embedded software development preferably in real-time and/or safety-critical systems. Knowledge about Docker and Linux. Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps
* Beneficial with knowledge from RTOS2 or other open-source real-time operating systems
* General knowledge or experience in Secure Product Development and Cyber Security is beneficial
* Ability and motivation to understand complex technical domains, system behavior, and low-level software interactions
* Experience with AI agentic frameworks

  

**Competencies**

We are looking for a candidate who demonstrates the following competencies and personal attributes:

* Strong technical leadership within C++ and embedded systems domains, with the ability to guide and mentor engineers
* Proven ability to lead and collaborate with remote, multi‑location teams
* Proficient English communication and interpersonal skills
* Possesses a global mindset with deep cultural understanding
* Applies a systems engineering approach to problem‑solving and decision‑making
* Builds trust and influence through effective leadership and stakeholder management
* Results‑oriented, open‑minded, and thrives in an international, multicultural environment

  

**What we offer**

We offer an exciting opportunity to take full lifecycle responsibility for a key area of the turbine software system. You will join a highly adaptive and empowered team where you are encouraged to make decisions, drive initiatives, and implement your own solutions.

In this role, you will build a broad network across a truly global organization, gaining extensive opportunities for cross‑disciplinary collaboration and personal development. You will be part of a result-oriented environment that maintains a high professional standard and a strong commitment to technical excellence.

a8bc3a03.title: Senior Solution Architect
a8bc3a03.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Migration Architect to lead complex Data Centre Exit and DC Consolidation programmes, migrating large-scale enterprise estates to Amazon Web Services (AWS). This is a technically demanding, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of cloud architecture, migration engineering, and programme delivery.
  
  
You will be responsible for the end-to-end architectural direction of migration programmes — from initial discovery and dependency mapping through to wave execution, cutover, and post-migration optimisation. You will bring deep expertise in AWS infrastructure, licensing portability (BYOL, BYOS, AWS Licence Manager), network transformation using AWS Transit Gateway and Direct Connect, and the unique complexities that arise when exiting or consolidating physical data centres onto AWS.
  
  
This role is suited to an architect who is equally comfortable whiteboarding a target-state AWS Landing Zone architecture with a CTO and sitting with an engineering team to resolve a blast-radius dependency conflict the night before a cutover.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Design and own the target-state cloud architecture for DC Exit / DC Consolidation programmes on AWS, including compute (EC2, ECS, EKS), storage (EBS, EFS, S3), networking (VPC, Transit Gateway), identity (IAM, AWS SSO), and security (AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, SCPs)
* Lead application and infrastructure discovery using AWS Application Discovery Service (ADS), Migration Evaluator, and dependency mapping to produce migration-ready groupings and blast radius analysis
* Define migration patterns (rehost via AWS MGN, replatform to RDS/EKS, refactor to Lambda/containers, retire, replace with SaaS) per workload with clear technical rationale and risk assessment
* Produce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), High-Level Designs (HLDs), and Low-Level Designs (LLDs) to programme-grade quality, aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Framework
* Govern architectural consistency across migration waves and enforce AWS Landing Zone / Control Tower guardrails throughout the transition

**Licensing Portability & Compliance**

* Lead licensing portability strategy for DC exit — BYOL (Bring Your Own Licence) for Windows Server and SQL Server on EC2, AWS Licence Manager configuration, OEM licence impact analysis, and SPLA transition planning for MSP-operated environments moving to AWS
* Advise on AWS Dedicated Hosts as the mechanism for BYOL compliance for Windows Server and SQL Server (per-socket/per-core licence models), ensuring licence counts are correctly mapped to Dedicated Host instance families
* Design licence governance controls using AWS Licence Manager rules, resource tagging strategies via AWS Config, and integration with third-party SAM tooling (Flexera, Snow Software) to prevent compliance drift post-migration
* Engage the AWS account team and AWS Partner Network (APN) to maximise programme value through AWS Migration Acceleration Programme (MAP) funding, AWS Credits, and AWS Professional Services co-delivery

**Network Transformation**

* Design target-state hybrid network architectures on AWS: AWS Transit Gateway (TGW) as the centralised routing hub, AWS Direct Connect (dedicated and hosted connections), Site-to-Site VPN as failover, and SD-WAN integration with TGW Connect
* Define internet egress and traffic inspection strategy for the post-DC state, replacing DC-based security perimeters with AWS Network Firewall, AWS Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) with third-party NVAs (Palo Alto, Fortinet), and AWS WAF
* Lead DNS transformation planning — Amazon Route 53 Private Hosted Zones, Route 53 Resolver (inbound/outbound endpoints), split-horizon DNS — and IP addressing strategy for migration with minimal re-IP using AWS IPAM
* Design VPC architecture across accounts and regions: hub-and-spoke or flat TGW models, VPC sharing via AWS RAM, and PrivateLink for service consumption without public exposure
* Ensure latency-sensitive workloads (ERP, payments, OT/SCADA) are isolated in dedicated VPCs with appropriate Direct Connect SIFs and QoS, and their connectivity requirements validated pre-cutover

**Migration Programme Delivery**

* Own the migration wave plan using AWS Migration Hub as the central tracking plane — sequencing, dependency groupings, rollback criteria, and cutover playbooks across programmes of 500+ workloads
* Lead rehost migrations using AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) for agent-based lift-and-shift, and AWS Server Migration Service (SMS) or AWS VMware Cloud on AWS (VMC) for VMware estate migration
* Define and enforce go/no-go criteria for each migration wave, including pre-flight AWS MGN replication lag thresholds, post-cutover smoke test suites, and DNS TTL management during cutover windows
* Manage and resolve technical blockers across infrastructure, networking, security, and application teams during wave execution
* Ensure regulated workloads (financial services, public sector) are handled with appropriate regulatory notifications, BCP/DR evidence updated in AWS Resilience Hub, and audit trails via AWS CloudTrail

**FinOps & Cost Governance**

* Build pre-migration cost models using AWS Migration Evaluator and AWS Pricing Calculator, incorporating BYOL savings on Dedicated Hosts, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance pricing, S3 storage tiering, and data transfer / egress cost assumptions
* Establish a FinOps operating model — visibility via AWS Cost Explorer and Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), accountability through AWS account-level tagging and chargeback, optimisation via Compute Optimizer and Savings Plans, governance via AWS Budgets and anomaly detection
* Conduct post-migration right-sizing reviews using AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations and Trusted Advisor checks to close the gap between business case projections and actual AWS spend

**Stakeholder & Vendor Management**

* Act as the primary technical authority for client stakeholders up to CTO / CIO level, translating complex AWS architectural decisions into clear business outcomes
* Lead multi-vendor technical governance — defining interface agreements, RACI frameworks, and joint testing protocols across SIs, MSPs, and AWS
* Manage AWS account team, network vendors (Direct Connect providers, SD-WAN), and third-party migration tooling vendors as an integrated programme team

**Essential**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, with a significant portion focused on large-scale migration programmes (DC Exit, DC consolidation, or cloud-first transformation) on AWS
* Deep hands-on expertise in AWS compute and migration services: EC2 (including Dedicated Hosts for BYOL), AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), AWS Migration Hub, AWS Application Discovery Service (ADS), and AWS Database Migration Service (DMS)
* Demonstrable expertise in AWS licensing portability: BYOL on Dedicated Hosts (Windows Server and SQL Server per-socket/per-core models), AWS Licence Manager configuration, OEM licence restrictions, and SPLA transition planning for MSP colo environments
* Network transformation experience: AWS Transit Gateway, Direct Connect (dedicated and hosted), VPC design (hub-and-spoke, shared VPCs), Route 53 Resolver, AWS Network Firewall, and SD-WAN integration with TGW Connect
* Proven experience designing and executing migration wave plans for estates of 500+ VMs in enterprise or regulated environments, using AWS Migration Hub as the tracking plane
* AWS Landing Zone / Control Tower design and guardrail enforcement across multi-account organisations
* FinOps experience: AWS Cost Explorer, Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), Compute Optimizer, Savings Plans, and pre-migration cost modelling using AWS Migration Evaluator
* Strong technical documentation skills — ADRs, HLDs, LLDs, cutover playbooks, and AWS Well-Architected Review outputs to consulting-grade standard
* Experience operating in multi-vendor programme environments (SI, MSP, AWS account team triangles)

**Highly Desirable**

* Hands-on experience with VMware Cloud on AWS (VMC on AWS) as a migration accelerator for VMware-heavy DC estates
* Experience with AWS Outposts for hybrid workloads that cannot fully exit on-prem, and AWS Local Zones for latency-sensitive edge workloads
* Experience with third-party migration tooling: Zerto on AWS, Carbonite Migrate, CloudEndure (now MGN), or PlateSpin
* Container and modernisation experience: Amazon EKS, Amazon ECS, AWS App2Container (A2C) for containerising legacy applications during DC exit
* Azure exposure — useful for programmes with workloads that are split across hyperscalers

**Certifications**
**Certification**
**Status**
**Notes**
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional Required Core requirement at this level AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate Expected Assumed as prerequisite to Professional AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty Highly Desirable Essential for network transformation-heavy programmes AWS Certified Security – Specialty Highly Desirable For regulated and public sector programmes AWS Cloud Practitioner Expected Foundational — assumed at this level TOGAF / ArchiMate Desirable Enterprise architecture governance contexts Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) Desirable For multi-cloud or Azure-adjacent programmes
  
  
**Competency Framework**
**Competency**
**Behavioural Indicators at Senior Level**
Technical Depth Provides technically precise answers without being prompted; anticipates second-order consequences of architectural decisions Risk Ownership Proactively surfaces programme risks before they become issues; defines rollback criteria and escalation paths without being asked Stakeholder Influence Can translate technical complexity into business language for C-suite; influences without authority across vendor teams Delivery Pragmatism Makes pragmatic trade-off decisions under time pressure; knows when 'good enough now' beats 'perfect later' Continuous Learning Stays current with AWS service releases and deprecations; proactively shares knowledge with programme teams and clients via internal tech talks or runbook updates
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Lead architect role on high-visibility, enterprise-scale DC Exit programmes for FTSE 100 and public sector clients on AWS
* Direct access to AWS Migration Acceleration Programme (MAP) funding, AWS ProServe co-delivery, and AWS account team engineering support
* Structured career progression into Principal Architect or Cloud Practice Lead roles
* Certification support — AWS exam costs, study leave, and training budget (A Cloud Guru / Pluralsight / re:Invent access)

3e271ed5.title: Program Manager - Energy
3e271ed5.description:
**Note: This opportunity is based in Andhra Pradesh**

**About us**  
WRI India, an independent knowledge organisation registered as India Resources Trust, provides objective information and practical proposals to foster environmentally sound and socially equitable development. Through research, analysis, and recommendations, WRI India puts ideas into action to build transformative solutions to protect the earth, promote livelihoods, and enhance human well-being. Know more: wri-india.org

**Program Overview**

WRI India’s energy program aims to inform and guide India’s energy transition. The program’s strategy is built on five pillars: (1) Clean Energy Supply (2) Decarbonized Energy Consumption, (3) Energy for Equitable Development and (4) Energy, Minerals & Circularity and (5) Energy Transition Finance.

**Job Highlight:**

The energy program is looking for a candidate to lead a new initiative focussed on understanding the role of residential buildings in supporting India’s clean energy transition. This new initiative will study how residential buildings consume, generate, store and manage energy as an integrated system. The project will examine the need to go beyond increasing rooftop solar capacity in residential buildings given the changing electricity-system context. For example, distribution utilities are dealing with higher levels of distributed generation, demand profiles and tariff structures are evolving while regulatory frameworks for storage, demand flexibility and distributed-energy aggregation are catching up.

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator and structured problem-solver who can manage competing priorities, identify risks early, drive accountability, and bring teams together to achieve measurable outcomes. The right candidate has experience working in the building sector with demonstrated understanding of grid interaction and integration, renewable energy systems for buildings, battery storage, demand flexibility, demand side management and basic knowledge of electricity regulations.

**What you will do:**

* Understand the strategic context of the initiative; conduct rapid analysis of the stakeholder ecosystem, key players, institutions, government departments and private sector especially for the state of Andhra Pradesh. Identify entry points for the initiative’s goals within programs, schemes and policies of the state government.
* Identify and map key data sets, sources and coordinate with respective agencies for data collection.
* Conduct research on policies, programs and regulations supporting the outputs under the initiative.
* Lead and guide research, data analysis, developing techno-economic analytical and modeling frameworks for integration of renewable energy, storage and energy efficiency in residential buildings.
* Develop scope of work for consultants, manage and supervise their work, lead study design methodology(ies), documentation and reporting.
* Identify potential risks and develop mitigation and contingency plans for the delivery of the outputs under the initiative.
* Lead engagement and coordination with key stakeholders at the state level in Andhra Pradesh; work with colleagues to disseminate findings from the initiative, share lessons with other states and find entry points for the project outputs in policy design and implementation at both national and state level.
* Organize stakeholder convenings, maintain regular communication with key stakeholders and initiative partners. Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Stay up to date on the national and state-level policies and programs, new partnerships, and strategic opportunities for WRI India to contribute.
* Conduct and design research to support development of knowledge products. This would include identifying new research topics, questions, research methods and writing publications at WRI India or for external platforms.

**What you will need:**

**Qualifications**

* Graduate or post graduate degree in science, engineering, architecture, policy, or related fields
* At least 7-10 years of relevant experience in energy efficiency and or renewable energy, power systems and building sector

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Experience working in Andhra Pradesh -particularly with state government agencies, CSOs, academia, in the energy sector and the private stakeholders is necessary.
* Demonstrated experience in implementing projects related to demand flexibility, demand response, grid interactive buildings, behind the meter storage and energy efficiency in buildings.
* Knowledge and interest in national and international policy discourse around clean energy transition in buildings is necessary.
* Strong interest and knowledge of renewable energy, energy efficiency policies, programs and initiatives especially in building sector at the subnational and national levels in India.
* Prior experience in providing technical support to any state departments through a project management unit will be considered an asset.
* Technical and quantitative skills, some training in research methods, modelling and data analysis are necessary. Experience conducting cost-benefit analysis is an asset.
* Knowledge of electricity regulations, DISCOM planning, consumer participation and experience conducting primary data collection is desirable.
* Strong ability to communicate clearly and effectively in conversation and writing, including professional-quality writing for research and communications products.
* Willingness to travel on short notice when needed by the project/program.
* The ability to respond to urgent requests from team and external stakeholders and partners proactively is an asset.
* Ability to work cooperatively with others; to demonstrate flexibility in fulfilling assignments.
* Fluency in English and Telugu is a must. Proficiency in other languages is desirable.

**Potential Salary and Benefits: INR 18,00,000 to 24,00,000 Per Annum**

*“Salary shall be commensurate with experience, skills, and internal parity. WRI India offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package.”*

**Location: Andhra Pradesh**

**Duration**: 1 Year term Hire (Extendable based on performance and project requirements)

**Start date:** As soon as possible

**List of Documents to be attached:**

* **Cover Letter**
* **Resume**

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for interview purpose.

**How to Apply**

All applications must be submitted online through this career portal in order to be formally considered. Only select applicants will be contacted for interview. There will be a writing test conducted with final candidates. Please do not contact program staff directly for this position.

*Kindly note that WRI India’s recruitment process does not involve any payment at any stage. Applicants will never be asked to share bank account or financial information as part of the application. All official communication and offer letters are issued only through authorised WRI India email IDs.*

***Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) @WRI India***

*WRI India values and promotes diversity, equity and inclusion across all areas of our work and workforce. Integrating these values into our actions fosters a progressive and collaborative culture and can also enhance our impact. It is our responsibility to create a welcoming working environment for people of diverse cultures, backgrounds and experience to learn together. We are responsible for fostering a safe and inclusive workplace where questions, concerns and information about diversity, equity and inclusion are part of our ongoing dialogue and development.*

***Learn more about WRI India’s commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).*** **Click Here**

**People-centric to the core:**

We keep our people at the center of everything we do - from a welcoming work environment to benefits and a culture that encourages staff to stay healthy, happy, engaged, and growing.

**Some of the non-monetary benefits that our staff get:**

**Health benefits:** We cover health insurance for you and your loved ones for up to INR 8 lakhs

**Term Insurance:** Our term insurance policy covers life coverage of 50 lakhs per staffmember

**Employee Assistance program:** Promoting mental well-being and supporting staff in achieving a satisfying work-life balance

**Health & Nutrition:** Personalized diet recommendation from a certified dietitian based on the physical health condition and lifestyle

**Flexible work schedule:** Alternative work arrangements for all who are eligible by nature of their job

**Learning culture**: Workshops and trainings to empower staff, encourage new learning opportunities

**Rest and Recharge weeks:** We encourage staff to take time off to rest, rejuvenate, upskill, and pursue their interests.

**Our leave policy:** Avail personal time off at 36 per year, along with public holidays, maternity, paternity, and adoption leaves.

**Equal employment @WRI India**

*We believe in equal employment, it is our policy to recruit and provide opportunities for advancement in all job classifications without regard to caste, religion, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, parental status, or disability.*

About MBRDI

Mercedes-Benz Research and Development India (MBRDI), headquartered in Bengaluru with a satellite office in Pune, is the largest R&D center for Mercedes-Benz Group AG outside of Germany. Our mission is to drive innovation and excellence in automotive engineering, digitalization, and sustainable mobility solutions, shaping the future of mobility.

Job Title: Sr Program Manager - Data Center Exit - Modernization & Migration

Job Level: L5

Department: ITH/IT

Employment Location: Brigade Tech Gardens

Reporting To: Deputy General Manager

Role Overview

We are looking for a seasoned technology leader to drive enterprise cloud migration and AI-led application modernization initiatives. The individual will be responsible for orchestrating complex migration engagements involving multiple business units, application owners, infrastructure teams, data teams, security teams, cloud providers, and other stakeholders to migrate enterprise workloads from on-premises environments to the cloud.

The role encompasses a diverse portfolio of workloads, including data platforms and workloads, transactional applications, and virtual machine (VM)-based applications. The leader will be accountable for defining migration strategies, establishing execution roadmaps, managing interdependencies, mitigating risks, and ensuring successful delivery with minimal business disruption.

A key dimension of this role is to drive application modernization using AI, leveraging our internally developed AI modernization platform to transform traditional migration and modernization engagements into AI-enabled, agentic delivery models. The individual will work closely with architecture, engineering, and AI teams to operationalize AI capabilities across application discovery, assessment, modernization planning, code transformation, testing, and migration execution.

1. Cloud Migration Strategy & Execution

* Lead end-to-end migration of enterprise workloads from on-premises environments to cloud platforms, covering data workloads, transactional applications, and VM-based workloads.
* Define workload-specific migration strategies, including rehost, replatform, refactor, rearchitect, and retire or retain decisions, based on business objectives and technical considerations.
* Develop migration roadmaps, wave plans, dependency maps, resource plans, timelines, and execution governance.
* Drive application discovery, dependency assessment, infrastructure readiness, data migration planning, and cloud landing zone alignment.
* Ensure migration programs meet agreed objectives for cost, performance, scalability, availability, security, compliance, and business continuity.
* Anticipate and resolve migration risks, technical blockers, application dependencies, and cross-team execution challenges.
* Establish cutover, rollback, disaster recovery, and post-migration stabilization plans.

2. Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Leadership

* Serve as the central leader coordinating application owners, business stakeholders, infrastructure and operations teams, database and data engineering teams, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, cloud platform teams, and external partners.
* Drive alignment across multiple departments to establish migration priorities, ownership, dependencies, timelines, and acceptance criteria.
* Facilitate technical and business discussions to resolve competing priorities, clarify requirements, and accelerate decision-making.
* Establish a structured governance model with regular steering reviews, milestone tracking, risk and issue management, and executive reporting.
* Communicate migration progress, risks, decisions, and business impact clearly to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Build collaborative working relationships across teams and ensure accountability for deliverables throughout the migration lifecycle.

3. AI-Led Application Modernization

* Lead the technical strategy and execution of application modernization initiatives using AI-assisted and agentic approaches.
* Leverage the organization's internal AI modernization platform to accelerate application assessment, code analysis, dependency mapping, modernization recommendations, code transformation, documentation, test generation, and migration readiness.
* Identify opportunities to modernize legacy applications by improving architecture, maintainability, scalability, resilience, performance, and cloud-native compatibility.
* Guide modernization decisions involving monolithic decomposition, API enablement, containerization, microservices, database modernization, and adoption of managed cloud services, where appropriate.
* Work closely with engineering and architecture teams to validate AI-generated recommendations and transformations against enterprise architecture standards and business requirements.
* Establish human-in-the-loop review mechanisms, automated quality gates, security controls, testing standards, and approval workflows for AI-assisted modernization.
* Define reusable modernization patterns, reference architectures, playbooks, and accelerators to improve delivery consistency and reduce manual effort.

4. Agentic Transformation of Migration Engagements

* Champion the adoption of an agentic operating model for cloud migration and application modernization engagements using the internal AI modernization platform.
* Identify opportunities to orchestrate specialized AI agents across the engagement lifecycle, including discovery, assessment, planning, dependency analysis, remediation, code modernization, testing, migration validation, and reporting.
* Translate engagement requirements and delivery challenges into platform capabilities, agent workflows, automation opportunities, and reusable use cases.
* Partner with internal AI platform and product teams to refine capabilities based on real-world project requirements and feedback from delivery teams.
* Define appropriate autonomy levels, human approval checkpoints, escalation mechanisms, and auditability for agent-driven activities.
* Establish measurable improvements in delivery speed, engineering productivity, assessment accuracy, automation coverage, and overall engagement economics.
* Drive continuous improvement of the platform by capturing lessons learned, common patterns, exceptions, and reusable knowledge across migration programs.

5. Technical Governance & Solution Assurance

* Provide technical leadership across workload assessment, target-state architecture, migration design, modernization options, and production readiness.
* Review and validate solution designs, technology choices, integration patterns, security architecture, data protection, and operational requirements.
* Ensure migration and modernization approaches comply with enterprise security, regulatory, resilience, and governance requirements.
* Establish technical review checkpoints and quality standards across discovery, design, implementation, testing, migration, and post-migration operations.
* Help teams make informed trade-offs between speed, cost, technical debt reduction, business continuity, and long-term maintainability.
* Ensure AI-generated code and architecture recommendations are reviewed, tested, and approved before production adoption.

6. Program Delivery, Commercials & Business Outcomes

* Own delivery planning and execution across multiple concurrent migration and modernization workstreams.
* Track key milestones, dependencies, resource utilization, risks, delivery quality, budgets, and expected business outcomes.
* Define and monitor KPIs covering migration throughput, workload readiness, schedule adherence, defect rates, automation levels, productivity improvements, and cloud cost optimization.
* Partner with account, sales, consulting, and solutioning teams to shape migration proposals, define delivery approaches, estimate effort, and articulate value propositions.
* Identify opportunities to scale delivery through reusable assets, standardized processes, automation, and AI-enabled engineering.
* Drive post-migration optimization, operational handover, and continuous improvement to realize the intended business value.

Qualifikationen

Qualifications

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Extensive experience in enterprise technology leadership, cloud migration, application modernization, and large-scale digital transformation programs.
* Proven track record of leading complex, enterprise-wide cloud migration initiatives involving multiple business units, diverse application portfolios, and cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud architecture, landing zones, networking, security, and infrastructure services.
* Demonstrated experience in migrating data platforms, databases, transactional applications, and virtual machine (VM)-based workloads from on-premises environments to cloud platforms.
* Strong knowledge of migration strategies, including rehost, replatform, refactor, rearchitect, retire, and retain, with the ability to determine appropriate approaches based on business and technical requirements.
* Experience in application discovery, dependency mapping, workload assessment, migration wave planning, cutover management, rollback planning, disaster recovery, and post-migration stabilization.
* Proven expertise in enterprise application architecture, modernization patterns, cloud-native technologies, containerization, microservices, API-led architecture, and managed cloud services.
* Experience driving AI-led application modernization initiatives using generative AI, AI-assisted software engineering, and agentic AI capabilities.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled modernization platforms and tools supporting code analysis, application assessment, code transformation, automated documentation, test generation, and migration planning.
* Understanding of agentic AI architectures, multi-agent orchestration, workflow automation, human-in-the-loop controls, AI governance, and responsible AI implementation.
* Ability to translate enterprise migration and modernization requirements into reusable AI workflows, automation use cases, platform capabilities, and delivery accelerators.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security, identity and access management, data protection, regulatory compliance, cloud governance, resilience, observability, and operational readiness.
* Demonstrated experience in program and portfolio management, including delivery governance, financial management, resource planning, risk mitigation, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Ability to define and monitor delivery KPIs, productivity metrics, automation coverage, migration throughput, quality measures, cloud cost optimization, and business value realization.
* Experience working with senior business stakeholders, enterprise architects, engineering leaders, infrastructure and operations teams, cybersecurity teams, cloud providers, and technology partners.
* Strong commercial and consulting acumen, including solutioning, effort estimation, proposal development, delivery planning, and articulation of business value.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior executives and drive alignment across complex organizations.
* Ability to lead multiple concurrent migration and modernization engagements while balancing business priorities, technical complexity, delivery commitments, cost, quality, and risk.
* A continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to establish reusable frameworks, reference architectures, delivery playbooks, and standardized practices that improve engineering productivity and transformation outcomes.

Why Join Us?

* Be part of a purpose-driven organization that is shaping the future of mobility

* Work on cutting-edge technologies and global projects

* Thrive in a collaborative, diverse, and inclusive environment

* Access world-class infrastructure and continuous learning opportunities
