5fbea0ea.title: Tech S and T-Technical Program Manager-GDSF02
5fbea0ea.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technical Project / Program Manager**
**Experience**
- 10-12 years
  
  
**Program Leadership**
- 5+ years
  
  
**Role Focus**
- Technical Delivery
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Technical Project / Program Manager to lead complex enterprise technology programs from planning through production rollout. The role combines strong program governance with sufficient technical depth to manage architecture, engineering, cloud, data and AI workstreams, while ensuring scope, schedule, quality, risk, dependencies and stakeholder outcomes remain controlled.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end project/program planning, delivery roadmap, milestones, dependencies, RAID management, governance and executive reporting.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams across product, architecture, software engineering, data/AI, cloud/platform, DevSecOps, QA, security and operations.
* Translate business and technical objectives into executable release plans, workstreams, sprint milestones and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Lead dependency management across applications, APIs, infrastructure, environments, vendors and upstream/downstream teams.
* Drive architecture, design, security, testing, release and production-readiness checkpoints; ensure decisions and actions are closed on time.
* Monitor delivery using Azure DevOps or Jira dashboards, including scope, schedule, velocity, defects, blockers, risks and release readiness.
* Facilitate steering committees, program reviews, technical forums, escalation management and stakeholder communications.
* Manage change control, resource/capacity planning, vendor coordination and financial tracking where applicable.
* Promote disciplined Agile/SAFe delivery, CI/CD adoption, automation, technical-debt visibility and continuous improvement.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 12+ years in technology delivery with 5+ years managing complex technical projects or multi-team programs.
* Experience delivering enterprise applications, cloud modernization, platform engineering, data/analytics or AI-enabled initiatives.
* Solid understanding of microservices, APIs, cloud platforms, data pipelines, CI/CD, DevSecOps, containers and production operations.
* Hands-on program management using Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, GitHub or equivalent tools; strong command of Agile, Scrum and/or SAFe practices.
* Ability to understand architecture diagrams, challenge technical assumptions, identify integration dependencies and convert technical risks into actionable plans.
* Strong executive communication, negotiation, facilitation, vendor management, conflict resolution and escalation-management skills.

**Success Measures**
Milestone and release predictability | Schedule and scope variance | Dependency closure | RAID aging | Defect leakage | Release readiness | Production stability | Stakeholder confidence | Team throughput | Budget/resource adherence
  
  
**Education And Preferred Background**
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum, SAFe, PRINCE2, cloud or technology certifications are preferred. Experience in enterprise SaaS, modernization, utilities, financial services, healthcare or other regulated environments is beneficial.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
A delivery-focused technical leader who can operate confidently with architects and engineers while maintaining rigorous program governance. The candidate should be able to identify technical dependencies early, challenge unrealistic plans, drive decisions and escalations, and provide executives with a clear view of delivery health and business impact.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

c9d9a75d.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data
c9d9a75d.description:
**Aliases**
**:**
Project Manager, Program Manager, Product Manager, Data Operations Lead, Data Delivery Lead, Technical Delivery Lead, or Data Governance Lead.
  
  
**About Truveta**
Truveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values.
  
  
**This opportunity**
Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early employees, you will help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub.
  
  
You will be the program owner for the Data Platform work carried out in India. That means the data-source onboarding, the processing and quality programs, the governance and access work, and the release and adoption of what the team builds. It is a single, senior, hands-off-the-keyboard role with real accountability and no direct reports.
  
  
**Who We Need**
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead complex, cross-functional programs across data acquisition, data processing, data quality, governance, platform delivery, and data-product adoption. You will work closely with engineering, data engineering, product, data science, operations, security, compliance, and business stakeholders to convert ambiguous data challenges into clear programs, measurable outcomes, and reliable production capabilities.
  
  
You will have built systems and we expect you to read an architecture diagram without help, to follow a design review closely enough to ask the question everyone else missed, and to know from experience which risks are worth a week of the team's time and which are not. You will not have formal authority over the teams you depend on, so the job is done through clarity, technical credibility, and follow-through.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
In this role you will:
  
  

* Own programs from problem definition and planning through delivery, adoption, and post-launch measurement.
* Build and maintain roadmaps, milestones, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and the delivery mechanisms that keep them useful.
* Partner with engineering and data teams on architecture, technical constraints, sequencing, and delivery risk, at a depth that lets you challenge the plan rather than only record it.
* Coordinate data-source onboarding, ingestion, transformation, normalization, enrichment, and validation programs.
* Drive resolution of data-quality issues, operational defects, and recurring pipeline failures, including the root-cause work that stops them recurring.
* Coordinate data governance, access control, privacy, security, metadata, lineage, and compliance initiatives.
* Identify cross-team blockers and drive them to resolution without relying on formal authority.
* Facilitate technical reviews and ensure major decisions, trade-offs, assumptions, and risks are written down where people will find them.
* Coordinate launch readiness, release management, operational support, and post-launch reviews.
* Prepare clear written updates and recommendations for engineering and business leadership across India and Seattle.
* Improve program management practice, reporting automation, delivery predictability, and operational maturity at the site.

**Required Qualifications**
The experience requirement is 11+ years in total, composed of 7+ years in a hands-on individual-contributor technical role and 4+ years in a technical program or project management role. The two are counted separately and added; a year spent doing both is counted once.
  
  

* At least 11 years of professional experience in total.
* At least 7 years in a hands-on individual-contributor in technical roles such as software engineering, quality assurance, data engineering, analytics engineering, systems engineering, or platform engineering.
* At least 4 years in a technical program management or technical project management role, owning delivery across engineering teams.
* Experience delivering programs involving data platforms, data pipelines, data governance, analytics infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Working knowledge of data ingestion, ETL and ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and data quality.
* Ability to read architecture diagrams and hold a substantive conversation with engineers about designs, trade-offs, dependencies, and operational risk.
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams, driving requirements, delivery plans, risk management, release readiness, and adoption.
* Strong written communication, including executive status reporting and written recommendations that carry out a decision.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and influencing teams.
* Familiarity with Agile development, release processes, incident management, and production operations.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
The following skill sets would be good to have:
  
  

* SQL or equivalent data-querying ability used in practice rather than in principle.
* Hands-on background with Kafka, Spark, Flink, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, AWS Glue, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with data governance, metadata, data lineage, access control, privacy, security, or compliance programs.
* Experience with external data suppliers, healthcare data, financial data, or other regulated datasets.
* Experience operating data platforms against measurable uptime, freshness, accuracy, completeness, latency, and cost targets.
* Experience managing distributed programs across India and the United States.
* Experience standing up program management practice at a new site or in a new platform area.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Aha, Linear, Asana, Smartsheet, or equivalent tools.

c3491cce.title: Senior Technical Program Manager [T500-31136]
c3491cce.description:
**Who We Are:**

Founded in 1998 at Vancouver, lululemon is a performance and lifestyle product company that create transformational products and experiences that build meaningful connections, unlocking greater possibility and wellbeing for all. We are driven by our brand purpose to elevate human potential by making individuals feel their best which helps us design our products with high filter and high style. We use a unique product creation methodology called Science of Feel in all our products to offer convenient, comfortable, and long-lasting experience. We owe our success to our innovative products, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in.

**About This Team:**

The Commerce & Transactions organization is responsible for the technology platforms, services, and capabilities that power lululemon’s global commerce ecosystem. Spanning checkout, payments, order management, fulfillment, post-purchase experiences, and core commerce platforms, the team delivers scalable, reliable, and secure solutions that enable seamless end-to-end guest experiences.

Working across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Digital, and Supply Chain organizations, the team drives strategic technology initiatives that support business growth, operational excellence, and innovation. Through modern platform capabilities, strong engineering practices, and cross-functional partnership, Commerce & Transactions ensures lululemon can continuously evolve its commerce capabilities while delivering exceptional guest experiences at global scale.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead complex technical delivery by coordinating across multiple engineering teams and technical domains, establishing clear program structure and delivery frameworks, and driving outcomes that deliver business value while managing complexity and risk. You demonstrate advanced technical acumen, with deep understanding of solution design and system architecture across multiple components and services, allowing you to anticipate architectural impacts, guide technical trade-offs, and drive informed program decisions. You will translate organizational objectives into effective program approaches, align delivery with engineering priorities, and support strategic decision-making through disciplined execution and stakeholder partnership.

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Lead complex, cross-functional technical programs across Commerce & Transactions platforms, establishing measurable outcomes for delivery, scalability, reliability, security, performance, operational readiness, and business value.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, and Operations teams to define program strategy, scope, delivery plans, and execution approaches for large-scale initiatives.
* Develop and manage integrated program plans across multiple engineering teams, platforms, and services, ensuring alignment on milestones, dependencies, and business objectives.
* Drive delivery execution through effective technical governance, clear accountability, architecture and security reviews, decision and escalation frameworks, quality gates, and proactive issue resolution.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate technical risks, architectural dependencies, platform constraints, technical debt, reliability and resilience gaps, security concerns, and scalability limitations to ensure predictable program outcomes.
* Translate complex technical concepts, trade-offs, and constraints into clear business impacts, enabling informed decision-making at all levels of the organization.
* Facilitate alignment across architects, engineers, product leaders, and executive stakeholders to drive clarity, prioritization, and successful program delivery.
* Partner closely with engineering and architecture leaders to validate technical approaches, challenge assumptions, and ensure strategic enabling work is appropriately prioritized.
* Lead multi-system integration efforts by coordinating API and data-contract alignment, end-to-end testing, performance and security validation, deployment and rollback readiness, production observability, operational handoffs, and post-launch stabilization.
* Drive resolution of cross-team dependencies, competing priorities, and delivery conflicts while balancing business objectives, technical quality, and organizational constraints.
* Provide clear, concise, and technically grounded updates to senior leadership, communicating program health, delivery and reliability metrics, risks, key decisions, architectural trade-offs, and business impacts.
* Influence investment decisions related to platforms, tooling, infrastructure, and technical modernization initiatives that support long-term business growth and operational excellence.
* Champion continuous improvement in technical program management practices, governance, planning, and execution across the organization.

**Must-Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience leading complex technical programs within retail, eCommerce, digital, or technology-driven organizations.
* 8+ years of experience in technical delivery, software engineering, technical program management, or related technology leadership roles.
* Proven track record delivering large-scale, cross-functional programs across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Data, and Operations teams.
* Experience leading technical initiatives across commerce platforms, including Checkout, Payments, Order Management, Fulfillment, Post-Purchase Experiences, Returns, Shipping, and Next Generation Commerce capabilities, with an understanding of order and payment integrations, data flows, API contracts, event-driven integrations, and end-to-end transaction lifecycle management.
* Strong technical acumen with a solid understanding of software development lifecycles, APIs, microservices, cloud technologies, integrations, distributed systems, platform architectures, system reliability, observability, performance engineering, scalability, and application security.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex dependencies, technical risk, organizational alignment, and large-scale program execution.
* Exceptional communication, executive stakeholder management, and influencing skills with the ability to drive alignment across technical and business teams.
* Experience establishing governance models, operating rhythms, escalation frameworks, and delivery mechanisms for complex programs.
* Technical program management experience across modern application and platform technologies, including Java-based services, GraphQL, Node.js, React, cloud platforms, Kubernetes, Kafka or comparable event-streaming technologies, and GitLab or comparable CI/CD tooling, with a strong understanding of DevSecOps, automated testing, deployment strategies, and engineering excellence practices.
* Strong experience with Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, and related planning platforms.
* Experience leading platform modernization, cloud transformation, and highly distributed enterprise technology programs, including infrastructure as code, resilience and disaster-recovery planning, production observability, performance optimization, secure delivery practices, and operational readiness.

**Preferred:**

* Experience within retail, eCommerce, omnichannel, supply chain, or digital commerce organizations.
* Knowledge of commerce ecosystems including checkout, payments, post-purchase journeys, order orchestration, fulfillment, returns, and customer experience platforms.
* Experience supporting global technology organizations and large-scale enterprise transformation initiatives.
* PMP, SAFe, Scrum Master, or equivalent program management certification.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while influencing outcomes across multiple organizations and leadership levels.

**Must Haves:**

* Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life.
* Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results.
* Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same.
* Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.
* Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.
* Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.

8292473d.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
8292473d.description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.8B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a highly accomplished Technical Program Manager (TPM) — at the Staff level — to play a pivotal role in spearheading our product development and geographic expansion initiatives. This strategic role requires a deep technical background to effectively partner with product managers and engineering managers, providing technical leadership to own the execution plan and deliver complex, cross-team engineering initiatives. You will be the champion for predictable and timely delivery, able to take ownership of and drive the mitigation of risks to the program, and skilled in facilitating quantifiable success across diverse engineering and product teams. Your core responsibility is to ensure the predictable delivery of products by actively engaging in technical discussions, identifying and proactively resolving dependencies and technical blockers, mitigating architectural risks, and applying best-in-class program management practices.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Technical Strategy & Planning
  
  

* Drive strategic, cross-functional planning and prioritization, partnering with Product and Engineering leadership to develop comprehensive program plans, including roadmap definition, dependency mapping, and resourcing models.
* Drive the process of translating high-level business and product requirements into actionable, concrete engineering tasks, milestones, and technical specifications.
* Contribute to the definition and tracking of effective technical metrics, driving improvements that optimize engineering operating performance and system health.

Technical Execution & Delivery
  
  

* Lead and facilitate regular program-level meetings and reviews with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure projects achieve successful outcomes.
* Proactively monitor program health, tracking status, risks, issues, and complex technical dependencies across engineering teams.
* Deep dive into technical issues to facilitate resolution, and drive appropriate executive-level escalations and program-level change management processes as-needed.
* Take personal ownership of engineering roadblocks and technical delays, escalating issues appropriately and driving them to timely closure by working directly with engineering leads.

Process & Communication
  
  

* Manage high-level program communications, ensuring all stakeholders—from delivery teams to executive management—are consistently informed of roadmap changes, release plans, and delivery status, with a clear explanation of technical trade-offs and risks.
* Establish, document, and champion the adoption of new program frameworks, tools, and best practices across the R&D organization.
* Act as an agent of change, helping to establish and strengthen the Technical Program Management function across the company.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience as TPM, Engineering Lead, Manager, or equivalent working directly with software engineering teams.
* Proven track record to communicate technical issues effectively to technical and non-technical partners at different levels of the organization.
* Proven ability to build and implement detailed plans accounting for ambiguity, dependencies, and technical complexity in a fast-moving environment.
* Demonstrated excellence in the practice of technical program management, especially in establishing TPM processes from scratch.
* Highly skilled in pragmatically identifying, tracking and reporting on cross team dependencies and collaboratively addressing them effectively with providing/receiving teams.
* Demonstrated attention to detail and a hands-on disposition.
* Excellent problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Outstanding ability to effectively communicate across all levels of the organization from engineers to executives.
* Four-year Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related degree, or equivalent work experience.

**Additional Information**
Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com
  
  
Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.
  
  
**The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors, including but not limited to, location, experience, education, training, and business need. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, commissions, and/or equity, subject to applicable plan documents and company policy. Successful candidates hired for this role may also be eligible to participate in the company's benefits programs, which may include, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement benefits, and/or paid time off, as determined by company policy**

f05323d5.title: Technical Program Manager
f05323d5.description:
**Location:**
Bengaluru, India

**Setup:**
Work from Office

**Experience:**
3 to 6 years

**Reports to:**
Head of Engineering

**About us**

GIVA is one of India's fastest growing jewellery brands. We started online in 2019 and have grown into a house of silver, gold, and lab-grown diamond jewellery, sold in about 500 stores across India, on our website and app, and on India's largest marketplaces.

Behind this sits a microservices platform running on AWS and GCP. Cart and orders, payments, catalog, identity, and serviceability are separate services that talk to each other through APIs and Kafka events, and they connect to a POS used across our stores, to inventory and shipping partners, and to an ERP implementation.

**The role**

You will be the link between Product and Engineering. When Product approves an initiative, you turn it into an engineering-ready tech doc, a committed timeline, and tracked delivery. You work with Engineering Managers and Tech Leads to understand and document the requirements, you take their estimates and turn them into a dated plan, and you keep Product and leadership informed until launch.

Product decides what and why, Tech Leads decide the design, and Engineering Managers decide who builds it and how fast. You work closely with all these stakeholders, solve the blockers, and ensure the projects are delivered on time.

**What you will do**

**Own the tech doc**

* Convert approved PRDs into tech docs with the Engineering Manager and Tech Lead.
* Maintain the doc template: context, goals and non-goals, design, service impact, schema and event changes, rollout, rollback, observability, risks, and open questions.
* Run design reviews and drive open questions to closure.
* Enforce the "ready for engineering" gate: a signed-off PRD and an approved tech doc before build starts.
* Keep the doc current so it stays the source of truth
* Own the timeline
* Facilitate estimation. Engineering Managers and Tech Leads estimate; you never invent numbers.
* Break scope into milestones and publish a committed date with a buffer and written assumptions.
* Re-plan openly when scope or capacity changes, and agree the new date with the Product and the Engineering Manager.

**Manage cross-team dependencies**

* Map dependencies between services and teams, for example orders to payments, catalog to storefront, and POS to inventory.
* Track Kafka event contracts and API changes that affect more than one team, and sequence the work so no team is blocked.
* Own the timeline for third-party integrations such as inventory, shipping, payment gateways, and the ERP.
* Act as the single point of contact for cross-team integration issues.

**Track delivery and escalate early**

* Publish a weekly status as on track, at risk, or off track, with reasons.
* Keep a live risk and blocker log with an owner and a due date for each item.
* Escalate with options (cut scope, add capacity, or move the date) rather than only describing the problem.
* Run launch readiness covering rollout, rollback, and monitoring, and hold a retro after launch.

**Improve how we plan**

* Define and refine the planning process, templates, and status formats with Engineering and Product.
* Track predictability and doc coverage, and report them to leadership each quarter.

**What success looks like in the first 12 months**

* Every new initiative has an approved tech doc before build starts.
* At least 80% of milestones are delivered by the committed date.
* The number of dependencies discovered late in an initiative goes down each quarter.
* Risks reach leadership within three days of being identified.
* Product leads and Engineering Managers rate the planning process 4 out of 5 or higher in the quarterly survey.
* You carry two to three major initiatives at a time without a drop in quality.

**What you bring**

* 3 to 6 years in software engineering, technical program management, or engineering management, with at least 1 year running programs across teams.
* Enough technical depth to read code and review architecture for microservices and event-driven systems.
* Experience writing tech docs that include API contracts, schema changes, and rollout and rollback plans.
* A working grasp of asynchronous flows: idempotency, retries, ordering, and failure handling.
* A record of managing dependencies across several teams and external vendors.
* Clear and precise written communication.
* Comfort telling Product or an Engineering Manager that a date is not realistic, and bringing options with that message.

**Good to have**

* Experience in e-commerce or omnichannel retail, covering cart, orders, inventory, fulfilment, and payments.
* Experience with ERP or warehouse system integrations, such as Oracle Fusion.
* Familiarity with AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, and Terraform-based infrastructure changes.
* Exposure to data pipelines built on BigQuery, dbt, or similar tools.
* Experience running a large platform migration or cutover.
* Awareness of PCI-DSS or DPDP requirements.

Lexsi Lab is a frontier AI research lab and platform company building the

****DL-Backtrace****

****deep AI understanding, system-level thinking, and executive communication skills****

.

****sovereign, governed, and defensible AI systems****

using Lexsi’s platform and research-led primitives.

This role is not about running delivery projects. It is about
****owning technical credibility in complex sales cycles****

.

You will lead technical discovery, solution design, and executive-level presentations for large, multi-stakeholder customers across Europe, the Middle East, and South Asia. You will frame customer problems around AI sovereignty, risk, governance, cost, and control, and translate them into clear architectures and evidence-backed solutions.

Who You Are

You have significant experience working with AI systems and have spent time in
****pre-sales, solution architecture, or technical consulting roles****

tied to complex enterprise deals. You have built or shipped AI products and understand modern ML systems beyond surface-level tooling.

You are comfortable discussing topics such as explainability, alignment, evaluation, and deployment trade-offs with both researchers and senior enterprise stakeholders. You can walk into a high-stakes meeting and clearly explain why governance, auditability, and model optionality matter, without losing the room in technical detail.

You write clearly, present confidently, and operate well in ambiguity. You enjoy shaping solutions rather than following scripts.

Why This Role at Lexsi

WDS works across Microsoft’s commercial ecosystem, including OEMs, silicon partners, distributors, resellers, and services partners - to drive Windows platform adoption, protect and grow share, and ensure customers realize long‑term value from their device and endpoint investments.

, enabling customers to modernize their environments, adopt AI‑driven workflows, and build confidence in Windows as the foundation for future innovation.
  
  
As a Windows Specialist, you will defend and grow Windows within Microsoft’s largest and most strategic customers. You will operate as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders - anchoring engagement with the CIO while expanding influence across CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders - to ensure Windows remains the foundational platform for secure, AI‑driven work.

[

* Equivalent professional experience.

* Prior background in technical sales, solutions architecture, GBB or platform Specialist roles, where credibility across both business outcomes and technical depth was required.

* Proven experience of modern endpoint management and workplace transformation strategies with expertise in Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager and cloud-native management. Able to advise senior leaders on device management modernization, security, operational efficiency and AI readiness, guiding customers through strategic platform decisions and transformation roadmaps.

Able to translate platform and hardware innovation into measurable business outcomes, productivity gains and competitive advantage for customers evaluating next-generation endpoint strategies.

**Experience: 8-10 Years | Location: Offshore**

**Role Summary**

Looking for an experienced **SAP Data & Analytics Developer/Architect** with a strong foundation in **SAP BW/BW/4HANA and SAP HANA**, complemented by hands-on SAP Datasphere experience. The role will support enterprise data modernization programs, helping clients modernize existing SAP BW landscapes and build scalable, governed cloud data solutions using SAP Datasphere.

**Key Responsibilities**

* 7–8 years of overall SAP Data & Analytics experience, with strong hands-on expertise in **SAP BW 7.x, BW/4HANA and SAP HANA**.

b1dc2ae4.title: Software Architect I
b1dc2ae4.description:
**Role description**

At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

**Summary:**

UST is hiring for Solution/Platform Architect

* The candidate should have 12–18+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 5 years in a Solution Architect, Platform Architect, Enterprise Architect, Principal Architect, or equivalent technical leadership role, with demonstrated responsibility for architecting and delivering complex enterprise technology solutions.

* The candidate should have strong experience in enterprise and solution architecture, with the ability to design scalable, modular, secure and highly available solutions using microservices, API-first, event-driven and cloud-native architectural patterns. The individual should be comfortable defining architecture principles, technology choices, integration patterns, non-functional requirements and technical standards for large-scale platforms.

* The candidate should have strong hands-on architectural experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS or equivalent hyperscale cloud platforms. Experience should include designing cloud-native and hybrid architectures using containers, Kubernetes, serverless technologies, API management, messaging, event streaming, CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability, resilience and enterprise security practices.

* The candidate should have good experience with IoT, connected products or industrial technology solutions, including device connectivity, telemetry ingestion, edge computing, device and asset management, remote monitoring and control, rules and event processing. Experience with technologies and protocols such as MQTT, OPC-UA, REST APIs and industrial/automotive connectivity patterns would be highly desirable.

* The candidate should have practical experience in Digital Twin architecture and solutions, with an understanding of how physical assets, equipment, vehicles, manufacturing systems or infrastructure can be digitally represented using asset models, relationships, telemetry, events, states and historical information. Experience with asset modelling, knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic models, configuration twins and software twins would be an advantage.

* The candidate should have strong enterprise integration and data architecture experience, including integration with systems such as ERP, MES, PLM, CRM, GIS, data platforms and enterprise applications. The individual should be capable of defining APIs, integration patterns, event flows, data models and semantic/context layers required to create integrated enterprise solutions.

* The candidate should have strong practical knowledge of Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI architectures. This should include experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector and semantic search, prompt and context engineering, AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, function/tool calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP). The person should understand how AI can securely access enterprise information, reason over contextual data and support or automate business and operational processes.

* The candidate should be an active user of modern AI-assisted tools, rather than having only theoretical knowledge of AI. **Position: Infrastructure, Cloud & Security Architect**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure, Cloud & Security Architect to lead the design, implementation, security, automation, and operations of our enterprise infrastructure and cloud environments. This is a hands-on technical role responsible for building scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available platforms while ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and business continuity.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise across cloud infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, automation, DevSecOps, disaster recovery, and enterprise architecture. The role requires close collaboration with engineering, product, operations, and business teams to deliver secure and reliable technology solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture**

* Design, implement, and manage cloud infrastructure on Azure and AWS.
* Architect scalable, secure, and highly available cloud platforms.
* Build and manage Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or equivalent).
* Design multi-environment deployment strategies for development, testing, staging, and production.
* Drive cloud modernization and infrastructure optimization initiatives.

**Infrastructure & Platform Engineering**

* Manage enterprise Windows and Linux server environments.
* Design and maintain networking components including Load Balancers, Firewalls, VPNs, NAT, DNS, Reverse Proxies, and Virtual Networks.
* Administer storage, virtualization, compute, and enterprise infrastructure services.
* Manage backup infrastructure and recovery solutions.

**Information Security**

* Design and implement secure infrastructure following security-by-design principles.
* Implement Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, RBAC, and Privileged Access Management.
* Manage SSL/TLS certificates, secrets management, encryption, and key management.
* Secure cloud platforms, Kubernetes environments, and enterprise workloads.
* Implement network segmentation, Zero Trust architecture, and endpoint security.
* Conduct infrastructure hardening and security baseline implementation.
* Support vulnerability management, remediation, and security risk reduction.

**Security Operations**

* Manage and optimize enterprise security tools including SIEM, EDR, IAM, DLP, and vulnerability management platforms.
* Support incident response, threat investigations, and security monitoring.
* Implement security automation and orchestration where applicable.
* Collaborate with internal teams to strengthen the organization's security posture.

**High Availability & Business Continuity**

* Design High Availability (HA) architectures across multiple regions and availability zones.
* Define and implement Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies.
* Establish backup policies, recovery procedures, and business continuity plans.
* Define and achieve RPO, RTO, and service availability objectives.
* Conduct disaster recovery testing and resilience assessments.

**Automation & DevSecOps**

* Automate infrastructure provisioning and operational processes.
* Develop automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
* Integrate security into CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement policy-as-code and infrastructure governance practices.
* Improve operational efficiency through automation and standardization.

**Monitoring & Operations**

* Implement enterprise monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability solutions.
* Perform proactive performance tuning, capacity planning, and root cause analysis.
* Ensure infrastructure reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
* Define operational standards, documentation, and best practices.

**Compliance & Governance**

* Support compliance initiatives including ISO 27001, SOC 2, and other regulatory frameworks.
* Participate in internal and external security audits.
* Develop and maintain infrastructure and security documentation.
* Implement governance controls for cloud, infrastructure, and security operations.

**Cost Optimization**

* Monitor and optimize cloud infrastructure costs.
* Recommend architecture improvements for performance and cost efficiency.
* Drive infrastructure utilization and resource optimization initiatives.

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, IT, and Security teams.
* Support customer security assessments, technical due diligence, and infrastructure-related RFPs/RFIs.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineering and operations teams.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in Infrastructure, Cloud, and Information Security.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure and AWS cloud platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tools.
* Strong networking knowledge including Firewalls, Load Balancers, VPNs, DNS, NAT, Proxies, and Routing.
* Deep understanding of Identity & Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, RBAC, and directory services.
* Experience with enterprise security technologies including SIEM, EDR, DLP, Vulnerability Management, and Endpoint Security.
* Strong experience with Windows and Linux administration.
* Experience implementing High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Backup, and Business Continuity solutions.
* Hands-on scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud security frameworks, Zero Trust, and infrastructure hardening.
* Experience supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar compliance programs.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, or cybersecurity certifications.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Security Center, or equivalent security platforms.
* Experience with container security and cloud-native security solutions.
* Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost optimization practices.
* Experience working in SaaS or product engineering environments.
* Exposure to AI-enabled security tools and automation.

4049001b.title: EPM Cloud Architect
4049001b.description:
**Job Description**
About the Company/Team
  
  
Join a team focused on delivering enterprise-scale Oracle EPM solutions that enable Finance organizations to improve planning, forecasting, consolidation, reporting, and performance management.
  
  
The team partners closely with Finance, IT, enterprise architecture, and implementation stakeholders to design scalable and maintainable Oracle EPM Cloud landscapes. The focus is on applying Oracle-recommended practices, strong architectural governance, automation, integration, and performance optimization to solve complex business challenges.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Translate Finance and Tax requirements into scalable solutions for consolidation, close, tax provision, and reporting.
* Define application architecture, dimensions, calculations, security, reporting, integrations, and automation.
* Architect integrations with Oracle Fusion ERP and other enterprise systems using appropriate EPM tools and APIs.
* Optimize application performance across consolidations, calculations, data loads, scheduling, and reporting.
* Serve as the design authority, evaluating solution options and communicating trade-offs, risks, and recommendations.
* Lead architecture workshops, design reviews, PoCs, and troubleshooting; mentor delivery teams and oversee implementation through production transition.

**Responsibilities**
**Mandatory Qualifications**

* 10+ years of EPM experience, including substantial hands-on Oracle EPM Cloud implementation experience.
* Proven experience as a Solution Architect, Application Architect, or equivalent design authority, with at least three end-to-end EPM implementations.
* Architect-level expertise in at least one application:

+ FCCS: Consolidation, ownership structures, intercompany eliminations, currency translation, and financial reporting.
+ TRCS: Tax provision, current and deferred tax, effective tax rate reconciliation, and tax disclosures.

* Strong knowledge of financial statements, dimensional design, calculation logic, security, and performance optimization.
* Experience with Data Integration, Integration Agent, Pipelines, REST APIs, EPM Automate, and scripting where applicable.
* Strong technical leadership, problem-solving, consulting, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong consulting and executive communication skills, with the ability to explain complex architecture topics and guide stakeholders toward appropriate solution decisions.
* CA, CPA, MBA in Finance, B.E., B.Tech., MCA, or equivalent relevant education and experience.

**Good-to-Have**

* Experience architecting multi-application Oracle EPM Cloud landscapes and enterprise integrations with Oracle Fusion ERP/HCM.
* Knowledge of EDMCS
* Experience designing large-scale EPM solutions involving high data volumes, complex organizational structures, multiple currencies, and complex business processes.
* Experience conducting architecture assessments, application health checks, performance reviews, and solution modernization initiatives.
* Experience leading architecture workshops, design reviews, and Proofs of Concept (PoCs).
* Experience mentoring EPM consultants, developers, and technical teams.
* Understanding of EPM Cloud operational processes, including migrations, quarterly updates, production support, Service Requests (SRs), RFCs, and My Oracle Support.
* Relevant Oracle EPM Cloud certifications.

**Self-Assessment Questions**
Before applying, consider the following:
  
  

* Have I led architecture for complex FCCS and/or TRCS implementations?
* Can I independently architect an enterprise FCCS and/or TRCS solution, covering application design, dimensions, calculations, security, integrations, reporting, automation, and performance?
* Have I delivered end-to-end EPM implementations, from architecture and design through deployment and production transition?
* Can I translate complex financial consolidation and close and/or tax provision and reporting requirements into scalable, maintainable EPM solutions?
* Can I independently work on user issues or user requirement in FCCS or TRCS?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

****About The Role:****
Enterprise Technology & Platforms (ETP) is seeking the Azure Cloud Engineer to join Cloud Platform Engineering, part of the Cloud & Infrastructure group. You will be responsible for building Cloud landing zones architecture, design and implementation, and provide guidance to our stakeholders, developing and communicating cloud governance and cloud security best practices, and creating and executing automated deployments via Infrastructure as Code and AI tools.
  
  
This role requires a self-driven, motivated candidate who works effectively both independently and collaboratively, and can take a task all the way to completion. The successful candidate will work in multiple cloud clouds within Cloud Architecture, Engineering, and DevOps, and must be flexible and able to adapt quickly to new challenges & skills required to deliver the services.
  
  
**The Team**
Cloud Platform Engineering is part of S&P Global's Corporate Cloud & Infrastructure group. The team is responsible for developing and executing strategies that align cloud adoption with business goals while ensuring robust architecture and governance to meet compliance and security standards. We focus on cloud engineering excellence and drive agility and innovation through advanced AI and ML cloud capabilities.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities & Impact****

* Own the engineering of S&P Global's Azure cloud platform as the primary responsibility, providing consultancy and hands-on engineering support to all business divisions, with secondary support for AWS and GCP.
* Provide expert guidance on Azure cloud architecture, lead design reviews, and establish best practices for landing zones, networking, and workload design that improve efficiency, resilience, and reliability; apply the same principles across AWS and GCP as needed.
* Lead the design and implementation of centralized Azure governance, including management groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy, RBAC, and Microsoft Entra ID integration, while supporting equivalent controls in AWS (organizations, SCPs, IAM) and GCP (organization policies, IAM) to keep multi-cloud operations secure and scalable.
* Design, implement, and manage Azure environments using CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform), and extend these patterns to AWS and GCP where required.
* Evaluate, review, and enable the secure onboarding of AI and ML services, with a focus on Azure AI capabilities, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, performance, and scalability.
* Partner with engineering, platform, CloudOps SRE, and security teams to improve delivery speed, reliability, and risk reduction across Azure and, secondarily, AWS and GCP.
* Advance infrastructure-as-code and configuration-as-code across Azure, AWS, and GCP to improve consistency, repeatability, and auditability by leveraging AI tools.
* Monitor and troubleshoot pipeline, deployment, and platform issues across Azure environments, and support L3 troubleshooting.
* Create documentation, standards, and reusable patterns for Azure landing zones and secure cloud delivery, with multi-cloud guidance for AWS and GCP.

****Required Qualifications****

* 5+ years of relevant Cloud Engineering and DevOps experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a similar major or certified development program.
* Expertise working with Azure cloud technologies with a focus on designing environments that adhere to best practices in terms of security, compliance and operational efficiency.
* Proven experience in Automation, CI/CD pipelines and DevOps principles, with a preference for experience in Terraform, Python and GitHub.
* Demonstrated problem-solving ability and a proactive approach to identifying, resolving issues, and raising improvement opportunities.
* Ability to adapt to a dynamic work environment and handle multiple priorities.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, including experience speaking to technical and business audiences.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Expertise working with Azure, AWS and GCP cloud technologies with a focus on designing environments that adhere to best practices in terms of security, compliance and operational efficiency.
* Experience with policy-as-code, Cloud vulnerability remediation
* Experience in working in Cloud Platform Engineering team supporting Cloud Operation escalation and providing resolution
* Experience with Terraform, Helm, or similar infrastructure automation tools.
* Familiarity with compliance, audit controls, and secure engineering standards.

Relevant certifications such Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert and Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert.
  
  
**Grade: 10 {5 to 9 years’ experience}**
**Shift Time: 1pm to 10pm IST**

78787c78.title: Infrastructure & Platform Architect
78787c78.description:
**Infrastructure & Platform Architect**

**ENTERPRISE DATA & ANALYTICS**

  

**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER**. Its our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Architecture**

* Lead the architecture, design, deployment, and management of enterprise cloud infrastructure primarily on **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**.
* Provide technical leadership and hands-on expertise across Oracle cloud services and technologies, including:

+ **Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)** – Enterprise application integration, API-based connectivity, and integration orchestration.
+ **Oracle Data Transforms (ODT)** – Data transformation, ELT workflows, and data integration.
+ **Oracle GoldenGate (OGG)** – Change Data Capture (CDC), replication, and real-time data integration.
+ **Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP)** – Modern data platform architecture, data engineering, analytics, and AI-enabled workloads.

* Architect scalable, secure, highly available, and cost-effective OCI environments.
* Design and implement cloud networking, IAM, security policies, connectivity, and resource governance.
* Lead platform modernization, infrastructure optimization, and cloud integration initiatives.
* Establish architecture standards, best practices, and operational guidelines for Oracle Cloud platforms.

  

**2. Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Architecture**

* Design, implement, and support enterprise infrastructure and data platforms on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**.
* Provide architectural guidance across GCP services, including:

+ BigQuery
+ Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow)
+ Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
+ Cloud Run
+ Cloud Storage
+ Compute Engine
+ IAM, VPC, and Cloud Monitoring

* Design and support hybrid and multi-cloud architectures integrating OCI and GCP.
* Ensure infrastructure scalability, security, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to design reliable and scalable cloud data platforms.

  

**3. Kubernetes & Container Platform Architecture**

* Architect, deploy, and manage enterprise Kubernetes environments, including **Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)**.
* Define standards for container orchestration, workload deployment, scaling, security, and networking.
* Drive adoption of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and container-based deployment strategies.
* Provide technical guidance on Kubernetes cluster management, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and platform reliability.
* Establish best practices for container security, high availability, and disaster recovery.

  

**4. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Automation**

* Lead the design and implementation of **Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** solutions across OCI and GCP.
* Develop standardized, reusable Terraform modules for automated cloud infrastructure provisioning.
* Architect **self-service cloud provisioning solutions** that enable engineering teams and business users to request and deploy approved cloud resources through automated workflows.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, access management, and environment lifecycle management.
* Establish infrastructure governance, policy enforcement, approval workflows, and automated compliance validation.
* Integrate infrastructure automation with GitLab CI/CD or equivalent DevOps platforms.
* Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual operational effort and improve platform efficiency.

  

**5. Enterprise Data Platform & Pipeline Architecture**

* Provide architectural guidance and operational oversight for enterprise data platforms and integration pipelines across OCI and GCP.
* Support Oracle GoldenGate CDC pipelines, OIC integrations, Oracle Data Transforms, and cloud-based data ingestion and transformation frameworks.
* Guide the implementation and optimization of data orchestration tools such as Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow) and dbt.
* Design reliable data integration patterns across Oracle applications, cloud databases, and enterprise analytics platforms.
* Collaborate with data architects and engineers to ensure data platform scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Establish monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational standards for enterprise data pipelines.

  

**6. Infrastructure Operations, Monitoring & Platform Reliability**

* **Lead and provide technical direction to cloud infrastructure, platform support, and monitoring teams** responsible for maintaining enterprise cloud environments.
* Oversee day-to-day platform operations, infrastructure health, monitoring, incident management, and production support.
* Establish operational processes, service-level objectives (SLOs), availability targets, and platform reliability standards.
* Implement proactive monitoring, centralized logging, alerting, and automated incident response across OCI and GCP.
* Drive root cause analysis (RCA), problem management, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Lead infrastructure patching, upgrades, vulnerability remediation, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
* Establish operational runbooks, escalation procedures, and support models.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring infrastructure support and maintenance activities.

  

**7. Technical Leadership, Governance & Collaboration**

* Serve as a **senior technical leader and subject matter expert** for enterprise cloud infrastructure and platform architecture.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and platform modernization initiatives.
* Mentor platform engineers, infrastructure engineers, DevOps engineers, and cloud support teams.
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, networking, data engineering, and application teams.
* Drive cloud governance, infrastructure standardization, security compliance, and cost optimization.
* Evaluate emerging cloud technologies and recommend platform improvements aligned with enterprise objectives.
* Provide technical oversight for vendor implementations, infrastructure upgrades, and cloud transformation initiatives.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* **10+ years of hands-on experience** in Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Architecture, Platform Engineering, or DevOps, including significant experience leading enterprise cloud infrastructure initiatives.
* **Strong, recent, and hands-on expertise in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**, including designing, provisioning, configuring, deploying, and managing production cloud environments.
* **Demonstrated hands-on experience with Oracle cloud data and integration technologies**, particularly:

+ **Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)** – Integration development, deployment, administration, and troubleshooting.
+ **Oracle Data Transforms (ODT)** – Data integration, transformation workflows, and platform administration.
+ **Oracle GoldenGate (OGG)** – CDC, replication, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
+ **Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP)** – Practical knowledge of its architecture, capabilities, and integration with enterprise data and AI workloads.

* **Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, including infrastructure architecture, cloud networking, IAM, Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Storage, and core data platform services.
* **Proven experience with Kubernetes**, preferably Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), including cluster administration, container deployments, networking, scaling, security, and troubleshooting.
* **Extensive hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**, including building reusable modules, automating cloud resource provisioning, and implementing standardized infrastructure deployment frameworks.
* **Experience designing and implementing self-service infrastructure automation**, enabling automated provisioning of cloud services with appropriate governance and access controls.
* **Hands-on experience with CI/CD and DevOps automation**, preferably GitLab CI/CD, including infrastructure and application deployment pipelines.
* **Prior hands-on experience with enterprise data platforms and pipelines**, including data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and integration tools such as Oracle GoldenGate, OIC, ODT, BigQuery, Cloud Composer (Airflow), or dbt.
* **Demonstrated experience leading infrastructure operations, platform maintenance, and production support teams**, including incident management, monitoring, troubleshooting, and service reliability.
* **Strong experience with enterprise cloud monitoring and observability**, including OCI Monitoring, OCI Logging, Google Cloud Monitoring, and centralized alerting solutions.
* **Practical experience with cloud security, networking, IAM, disaster recovery, high availability, and infrastructure governance**.
* **Proven technical leadership experience**, including architecture ownership, mentoring engineers, leading technical reviews, and coordinating cross-functional engineering and support teams.
* Strong scripting and automation experience using Python, Bash, or equivalent technologies.
* Excellent analytical, architectural decision-making, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  

**Important:** This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership position. Candidates must demonstrate recent implementation and operational experience with **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Oracle integration technologies**, along with the ability to architect solutions, lead engineering teams, and maintain enterprise cloud platforms. Experience limited to high-level architecture, advisory roles, or people management without hands-on technical involvement will not be sufficient.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing Oracle AI Data Platform and AI-enabled enterprise data solutions.
* Experience with Oracle Autonomous Database, Oracle Fusion Cloud applications, and Oracle Database services.
* Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud integration architectures between OCI and GCP.
* Knowledge of GitOps, Helm, Argo CD, and Kubernetes deployment automation.
* Experience with enterprise cloud FinOps, cost governance, and resource optimization.

Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

ba0a4f00.title: Tech S and T-Technical Program Manager-GDSF02
ba0a4f00.description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: Nov 27, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1761660

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Technical Project / Program Manager**

**Experience** - 10-12 years

**Program Leadership** - 5+ years

**Role Focus** - Technical Delivery

  

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a Technical Project / Program Manager to lead complex enterprise technology programs from planning through production rollout. The role combines strong program governance with sufficient technical depth to manage architecture, engineering, cloud, data and AI workstreams, while ensuring scope, schedule, quality, risk, dependencies and stakeholder outcomes remain controlled.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end project/program planning, delivery roadmap, milestones, dependencies, RAID management, governance and executive reporting.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams across product, architecture, software engineering, data/AI, cloud/platform, DevSecOps, QA, security and operations.
* Translate business and technical objectives into executable release plans, workstreams, sprint milestones and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Lead dependency management across applications, APIs, infrastructure, environments, vendors and upstream/downstream teams.
* Drive architecture, design, security, testing, release and production-readiness checkpoints; ensure decisions and actions are closed on time.
* Monitor delivery using Azure DevOps or Jira dashboards, including scope, schedule, velocity, defects, blockers, risks and release readiness.
* Facilitate steering committees, program reviews, technical forums, escalation management and stakeholder communications.
* Manage change control, resource/capacity planning, vendor coordination and financial tracking where applicable.
* Promote disciplined Agile/SAFe delivery, CI/CD adoption, automation, technical-debt visibility and continuous improvement.

  

**Required Experience and Skills**

* 12+ years in technology delivery with 5+ years managing complex technical projects or multi-team programs.
* Experience delivering enterprise applications, cloud modernization, platform engineering, data/analytics or AI-enabled initiatives.
* Solid understanding of microservices, APIs, cloud platforms, data pipelines, CI/CD, DevSecOps, containers and production operations.
* Hands-on program management using Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, GitHub or equivalent tools; strong command of Agile, Scrum and/or SAFe practices.
* Ability to understand architecture diagrams, challenge technical assumptions, identify integration dependencies and convert technical risks into actionable plans.
* Strong executive communication, negotiation, facilitation, vendor management, conflict resolution and escalation-management skills.

  

**Success Measures**

Milestone and release predictability | Schedule and scope variance | Dependency closure | RAID aging | Defect leakage | Release readiness | Production stability | Stakeholder confidence | Team throughput | Budget/resource adherence

  

**Education and Preferred Background**

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum, SAFe, PRINCE2, cloud or technology certifications are preferred. Experience in enterprise SaaS, modernization, utilities, financial services, healthcare or other regulated environments is beneficial.

  

**Ideal Candidate**

A delivery-focused technical leader who can operate confidently with architects and engineers while maintaining rigorous program governance. The candidate should be able to identify technical dependencies early, challenge unrealistic plans, drive decisions and escalations, and provide executives with a clear view of delivery health and business impact.

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

d609b5a7.title: Technical Program Manager
d609b5a7.description:
**About The Company**
**Who are we?**
Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.
  
  
We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  
  
Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.
  
  
We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  
  
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.
  
  
Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.
  
  
As a Technical Program Management III, you will play a critical role in overseeing and managing complex technical programs to ensure successful delivery within established timelines and quality standards. Your experience of 8.0-10.0 years will be instrumental in providing strategic direction, leadership, and guidance to cross-functional teams throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of large-scale technical programs.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to define project scope, goals, and deliverables.
* Apply AI Orchestration & Agentic Design principles to streamline program workflows and enhance efficiency.
* Utilize Systems Thinking to analyze complex problems and design innovative solutions.
* Implement Performance Engineering practices to optimize system performance and scalability.
* Utilize your expertise in at least one programming language such as Java, GoLang, Python, NodeJS, ReactJS, or React Native to drive technical excellence.
* Manage databases including Redis, Aerospike, Cassandra, MySQL, Mongo, Solr, or ElasticSearch to ensure data integrity and availability.
* Facilitate collaboration among team members, fostering a culture of innovation, teamwork, and knowledge sharing.
* Exercise Thought Leadership by staying abreast of industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies.
* Conduct Requirement Gathering and Analysis to understand project objectives and stakeholder needs.
* Evaluate new technologies, tools, and frameworks to make informed decisions for project implementation.
* Perform Risk Analysis to identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis to address issues proactively and prevent recurrence.
* Implement Cost Optimization strategies to maximize project efficiency and ROI.
* Demonstrate Analytical Thinking to solve complex technical challenges and make data-driven decisions.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders, team members, and senior leadership to ensure project alignment and transparency.

**Overall, your role as a Technical Program Management III is instrumental in driving the successful delivery of technical programs through effective leadership, strategic planning, and collaboration, enabling organizations to achieve their business objectives.**
**Required Skills**
architecture, java, problem solving, program management
