2131c639.title: Program Manager: (Procurement+Logistics+SCM)
2131c639.description:
Program Manager Logistics, Supply Chain & Procurement   
 Program Manager Logistics, Supply Chain   
 & Procurement   
 Role   
 Program Manager / Project Manager Logistics,   
 Supply Chain & Procurement   
 Location   
 Bangalore Diamond District, Indiranagar   
 Work mode Full-time, 5 days a week from office   
 Experience 610 years in logistics, supply chain and/or   
 procurement, with at least 23 years leading teams   
 or programs   
 Reports to   
 Function   
 Head of Logistics   
 Global Logistics & Supply Chain (working closely   
 with Sourcing, Procurement, Sales and Business   
 Finance across all business units)   
 About Mstack   
 Mstack is a chemicals + AI company re-imagining how specialty and industrial chemicals   
 are sourced, developed and delivered across the world. With a team of ~225 people and   
 annual revenue of ~$180M, we connect high-quality manufacturing capacity in Asia with   
 customers across the Americas, the Middle East, Asia and, increasingly, Europe using   
 technology and data to make a traditionally opaque, fragmented supply chain faster, more   
 reliable and more transparent.   
 Our business model   
 Asset-light by design. We own no manufacturing plants. Products are made through a   
 network of contract and toll manufacturing partners, which lets us scale quickly   
 across products and geographies without heavy capital investment.   
 From trading to product ownership. Once we are confident in a product and its   
 market, we acquire ownership of the recipe and formulation. Today, roughly half our   
 revenue comes from trading and the other half from R&D-led products, contract   
 manufacturing and owned formulations and over the next 34 years we are   
 deliberately shifting the mix toward proprietary products.   
 Page 1 of 6

Program Manager Logistics, Supply Chain & Procurement   
 R&D at the core. Our R&D lab in Hyderabad's Genome Valley develops and   
 commercialises new products (two agrochemical products launched last year, with   
 more in the pipeline), and new labs are being set up in Bangalore and China.   
 Five business units   
 Each business unit runs like a focused mini-company, with its own sourcing and   
 procurement, program/logistics coordination, business finance and sales.   
 Oil & Gas and Paints & Coatings our largest businesses (~65% of revenue), serving   
 global energy-services leaders and Fortune 500 chemical companies across the US,   
 Middle East, Mexico and Brazil.   
 Agrochemicals an India-to-India business backed by in-house R&D.   
 Personal Care manufactured in India and supplied to OEMs and ODMs in China and   
 Southeast Asia, a market few Indian chemical players have cracked.   
 Food & Nutrition our newest unit, bringing specialty European ingredients to   
 Indian customers.   
 We are also expanding in China, adding Pharma, Agrochemicals and Food & Nutrition to   
 our portfolio there.   
 Global footprint   
 Mstack started in the US and has since grown into Canada, Mexico, Brazil and wider Latin   
 America, the Middle East and China, with Europe next. India is our largest base, with our   
 Bangalore headquarters, offices in Mumbai, Delhi and the Gujarat chemical belt   
 (Vadodara, Ankleshwar, Bharuch), and our Hyderabad R&D lab. Our team in Shanghai   
 covers sales, sourcing and logistics for China.   
 How we source   
 Our centralised sourcing and procurement team in Bangalore finds the right supplier, in   
 the right geography, at the right price for every customer need for example, supplying   
 a US tier-1 customer from India, China, the Middle East, Korea or Taiwan. We work in two   
 ways:   
 Customer-driven: our sales teams identify a customer need, and sourcing builds the   
 supply solution around it.   
 Product-driven: we lead with products and formulations we know deeply and take   
 them to market.   
 Volumes range widely from oil and gas commodities moving at 2030 metric tons a day   
 and epoxies at around a container a day into the US, to high-value personal care   
 ingredients shipped at 25 tons a month. That variety is exactly what makes logistics at   
 Page 2 of 6

Program Manager Logistics, Supply Chain & Procurement   
 Mstack challenging and interesting.   
 The role   
 We are looking for a Program Manager to own the end-to-end movement of goods across   
 Mstack's global supply chain from the supplier's factory gate to the customer's door.   
 You will run first-mile, middle-mile and last-mile operations across multiple countries, lead   
 a team of logistics coordinators, manage budgets and freight costs, and use data to make   
 our supply chain faster, cheaper and more predictable.   
 This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of logistics, procurement and business   
 strategy. You will work daily with sourcing, sales, finance and manufacturing partners, and   
 with transporters, freight forwarders and customs brokers turning a complex, multi-   
 geography network into a reliable engine for growth.   
 Key responsibilities   
 End-to-end logistics execution   
 First mile: plan and coordinate pickups from contract and toll manufacturers and   
 suppliers; manage material readiness, packaging, labelling, quality checks and   
 dispatch schedules.   
 Middle mile: manage domestic linehaul and international freight (FCL, LCL, ISO tanks,   
 bulk and air), container bookings, port operations, transshipment and warehousing   
 with freight forwarders and CHAs.   
 Last mile: ensure on-time, in-full delivery to customers across the US, LATAM, the   
 Middle East, China, Southeast Asia and India, including destination customs clearance   
 and final delivery coordination.   
 Trucker and carrier coordination: build and manage a reliable network of   
 transporters, truckers and fleet partners; handle vehicle placement, real-time   
 tracking, detention and demurrage, and resolution of transit exceptions.   
 Handle dangerous-goods (DG/hazmat) shipments safely and in compliance with   
 applicable regulations.   
 Documentation and compliance   
 Own shipping and trade documentation end to end: commercial invoices, packing   
 lists, bills of lading, certificates of origin, MSDS/SDS, COAs, e-way bills, shipping bills   
 and insurance.   
 Page 3 of 6

Program Manager Logistics, Supply Chain & Procurement   
 Ensure compliance with exportimport regulations, customs requirements, Incoterms   
 and country-specific rules in each market we serve.   
 Maintain audit-ready records and work with finance on freight invoicing, duty   
 drawbacks and reconciliations.   
 Procurement and vendor management   
 Partner with the sourcing team on supplier selection, lead times and landed-cost   
 evaluation.   
 Run RFQs and negotiate rates and contracts with freight forwarders, shipping lines,   
 transporters, CHAs and warehouses.   
 Track vendor performance on cost, service levels, transit time and damage, and drive   
 continuous improvement.   
 Budgeting and cost management   
 Own the logistics budget for your programs: forecast freight and handling spend,   
 track actuals against plan and explain variances.   
 Identify and deliver cost savings through route optimisation, load consolidation, mode   
 selection and better contracts.   
 Build landed-cost and cost-to-serve models that inform pricing and sourcing   
 decisions.   
 Analytics and strategy   
 Define and track KPIs: OTIF, transit times, freight cost per ton, demurrage/detention,   
 documentation accuracy and vendor scorecards.   
 Build dashboards and reports for leadership; turn data into clear recommendations.   
 Develop the logistics strategy for new lanes, geographies and business units as   
 Mstack expands into Europe and beyond.   
 Identify opportunities to digitise and automate logistics workflows in partnership   
 with our tech teams.   
 Coordination, communication and team leadership   
 Act as the single point of contact for shipment status across sales, sourcing, finance,   
 manufacturing partners and customers.   
 Lead, coach and grow a team of logistics coordinators; set priorities, review   
 performance and build strong processes.   
 Run regular program reviews with business unit heads and escalate risks early with   
 clear mitigation plans.   
 Page 4 of 6

Program Manager Logistics, Supply Chain & Procurement   
 Manage escalations and crises delays, port congestion, documentation issues,   
 damaged cargo calmly and quickly.   
 What you'll bring   
 Bachelor's degree in engineering, supply chain, logistics, business or a related field;   
 an MBA or PG in Supply Chain / Operations is a strong plus.   
 610 years of experience across logistics, supply chain management and   
 procurement, including at least 23 years managing a team or multi-stakeholder   
 programs.   
 Hands-on experience across first-mile, middle-mile and last-mile operations, including   
 direct trucker and transporter coordination.   
 Strong working knowledge of international shipping (sea, air, road), exportimport   
 documentation, customs processes and Incoterms.   
 Proven track record of owning a logistics budget and delivering measurable cost   
 savings.   
 Experience working with data Advanced Excel / Google Sheets is a must; exposure   
 to SQL, Power BI, Tableau or similar is a plus.   
 Willingness to work 5 days a week from our Bangalore (Indiranagar) office, with   
 flexibility to coordinate across global time zones when needed.   
 Skills and competencies   
 Communication: clear, confident written and spoken English; able to communicate   
 with truckers on the ground and with senior leadership and global customers alike.   
 Coordination: keeps many moving parts aligned across teams, partners and time   
 zones without dropping the ball.   
 Team management: builds accountable, high-performing teams; leads by example and   
 develops people.   
 Analytical thinking: comfortable with numbers; uses data to diagnose problems and   
 make decisions.   
 Strategic mindset: sees beyond today's shipment to design scalable processes and   
 networks.   
 Budgeting and commercial acumen: understands cost drivers and how logistics   
 decisions affect margins.   
 Negotiation: secures strong rates and terms while keeping long-term partner   
 relationships healthy.   
 Page 5 of 6

Program Manager Logistics, Supply Chain & Procurement   
 Problem-solving under pressure: stays calm, decisive and solution-oriented when   
 things go wrong.   
 Good to have   
 Experience in chemicals, specialty chemicals, oil & gas, agrochemicals, pharma or   
 other process industries.   
 Experience handling hazardous / DG cargo, ISO tanks and bulk liquids.   
 Exposure to US, LATAM, Middle East, China or Southeast Asia trade lanes.   
 Experience in a high-growth startup or asset-light / tech-enabled supply chain   
 business.   
 Familiarity with TMS, ERP (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Zoho) and shipment-tracking   
 platforms.   
 Why join Mstack   
 Global scale from day one: run shipments across five continents and dozens of trade   
 lanes.   
 Real ownership: a direct line of sight to how your decisions shape margins, customer   
 experience and growth.   
 Build, not just run: help design the logistics backbone of a fast-growing chemicals +   
 AI company as it moves from trading to proprietary products.   
 Learn across the value chain: work alongside sourcing, R&D, manufacturing, sales and   
 finance in a business that blends deep industry expertise with technology.   
 A sharp, ambitious team in a high-ownership, fast-paced environment.   
 Location: Diamond District, Indiranagar, Bangalore • Work mode: 5 days from office   
 Page 6 of 6

aa611f35.title: HCM Cloud Functional Solution Architect
aa611f35.description:
About Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS)

Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) helps customers maximize the value of their Oracle technology investments, from implementation and adoption to ongoing improvement. Bringing together Oracle product expertise, industry understanding, and delivery experience, CSS works with customers to address business priorities, strengthen technology adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes.

Within CSS, Oracle Innovation Studios brings together specialists across AI Studio, Cloud Platforms Studio, Industry Studios, Fusion Apps Studios, and Security Studio. Our teams co-innovate with customers to identify valuable use cases, validate ideas through prototypes, and deliver secure, scalable solutions. We collaborate across Studios, Product Development, sales, and delivery, combining reusable assets and practical AI capabilities to improve delivery productivity and turn business priorities into lasting customer value.

Why join CSS?

* Build on your expertise. Deepen your Oracle specialization while expanding your understanding of connected business processes and technologies across the Oracle ecosystem.
* Apply AI to real business needs. Develop practical knowledge of AI and automation through customer solutions and improvements to the way we design, build, and deliver.
* Connect your work to customer outcomes. Contribute across discovery, solution design, prototyping, delivery, and adoption, with opportunities shaped by your role and Studio.
* Learn through collaboration. Work with specialists, architects, engineers, and functional experts across Studios and Product Development to strengthen your solution judgment.
* Extend your impact. Create reusable assets and share knowledge through mentoring, workshops, demonstrations, technical publications, and continuous learning.

Fusion Apps Studios

Fusion Apps Studios help customers realize greater value from Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications by improving business processes, adopting new capabilities, and making better use of embedded AI. The team assesses existing environments, identifies adoption and process gaps, and develops practical improvement roadmaps. Solutions prioritize standard functionality, supported by integration and extensions where needed. Depending on the role, work may include Visual Builder Studio, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle APEX. Join Fusion Apps Studios to deepen your functional or technical expertise while broadening your contribution to customer advisory, connected processes, and business transformation.

As an Oracle Fusion HCM Solution Architect, you will own end-to-end solution design across two designated HCM services, translating complex business requirements into integrated, secure and effective solutions. You will combine deep hands-on expertise in your primary service with sufficient functional depth in the secondary service to evaluate, challenge and approve solution designs.

You will lead customer engagements across discovery, design, configuration reviews, testing, cutover and post-go-live resolution. Working with functional consultants, technical specialists and senior customer stakeholders, you will govern cross-service design decisions, resolve dependencies and evaluate downstream business impacts.

The role combines functional architecture, delivery leadership, customer advisory and presales responsibilities. You will mentor consultants, maintain solution quality, identify practical AI opportunities and communicate design alternatives, trade-offs and recommendations to support successful implementation outcomes.

Occasional travel will be required.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Own integrated functional architecture across at least two HCM services, aligning solution scope and design decisions with business objectives and resolving dependencies across workstreams.
* Lead discovery sessions and design workshops with HR leaders and delivery teams to translate requirements into business processes, enterprise and workforce structures, configuration, and approvals.
* Define service and subservice scope and end-to-end business scenarios, assess downstream impacts across HCM services, and explain trade-offs in business fit, maintainability, user experience, security, and delivery complexity.
* Govern functional designs, configuration standards, exceptions, and solution documentation to promote consistent delivery and clear design ownership.
* Define functional requirements for data migration, integrations, reporting, HCM Extracts, and Fast Formulas, reviewing designs with technical specialists to address cross-service dependencies.
* Establish cross-service testing, reconciliation, and cutover approaches, covering integration, regression, and user acceptance testing to support production readiness.
* Review role access, data access, segregation of duties, and sensitive-data handling; assess Redwood requirements and relevant AI use cases for feasibility, data access, human oversight, and output validation.
* Lead design reviews, resolve complex functional issues, and guide go-live and post-go-live stabilization to support reliable business operations.
* Advise senior client stakeholders on solution decisions, delivery risks, and recommended actions, while mentoring functional leads and consultants and reviewing their deliverables.
* Support presales through discovery, solution scoping, demonstrations, and estimates, clearly documenting assumptions and exclusions to establish realistic delivery expectations.

**Skills - Mandatory**
======================

**Experience**

* Minimum 18 years of overall professional experience, with substantial experience in HCM consulting, enterprise application implementation, and functional solution leadership.
* At least four completed end-to-end HCM implementations, with demonstrated solution design ownership across a minimum of two HCM services.
* Demonstrated ownership of discovery, design workshops, configuration reviews, testing, cutover, and post-go-live issue resolution.

**Oracle Products**

* Deep hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM expertise in a primary service and sufficient depth in a second service to design, challenge, and approve functional solutions. Expertise must cover at least two of the following service areas:
* Global Human Resources: Core HR, enterprise and workforce structures, worker lifecycle, and related employee experience capabilities.
* Talent Management: Talent, Learning, or Recruiting processes and their dependencies.
* Workforce Rewards: Compensation or Benefits and their integration with worker and assignment data.
* Workforce Management: Absence Management, Time and Labor, or Workforce Scheduling.
* Payroll: Payroll processes, relevant legislative requirements, and dependencies with other HCM services.

**Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of HCM business processes, effective dating, data flows, approvals, security, and cross-service dependencies.
* Ability to explain complex design decisions, alternatives considered, trade-offs, and delivery outcomes using specific implementation examples.

**Technical Skills**

* Ability to assess functional requirements for data migration, integrations, reporting, HCM Extracts, and Fast Formulas and review related designs with technical specialists.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Strong stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to communicate solution decisions to senior client stakeholders.

**Leadership**

* Experience leading functional teams, mentoring consultants, and coordinating decisions with technical, integration, data, security, and testing teams.

**Good to Have**
================

* Experience with global or multi-country Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM transformation programs.
* Architecture governance experience across complex enterprise structures and multiple HCM workstreams.
* Experience assessing Redwood adoption and AI-enabled HCM capabilities.
* Experience governing quarterly update assessments and cross-service regression testing.
* Presales experience covering solution assessments, proposals, demonstrations, and estimation.
* Relevant Oracle HCM Cloud certifications.

**Self Assessment Questions**
=============================

Before applying, please consider the following questions:

* Have I completed at least four end-to-end HCM implementations with solution design ownership across at least two HCM services?
* Can I demonstrate deep hands-on expertise in one Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM service and the depth to design, challenge, and approve solutions in a second service?
* Can I demonstrate ownership of discovery, configuration reviews, testing, cutover, and stabilization, including assessment of data migration, integration, reporting, HCM Extracts, Fast Formulas, and security requirements?

cceb672e.title: Oracle HCM Cloud Payroll Architect
cceb672e.description:

Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) helps customers maximize the value of their Oracle technology investments, from implementation and adoption to ongoing improvement. Bringing together Oracle product expertise, industry understanding, and delivery experience, CSS works with customers to address business priorities, strengthen technology adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes.

Within CSS, Oracle Innovation Studios brings together specialists across AI Studio, Cloud Platforms Studio, Industry Studios, Fusion Apps Studios, and Security Studio. Our teams co-innovate with customers to identify valuable use cases, validate ideas through prototypes, and deliver secure, scalable solutions. We collaborate across Studios, Product Development, sales, and delivery, combining reusable assets and practical AI capabilities to improve delivery productivity and turn business priorities into lasting customer value.

Why join CSS?

* Build on your expertise. Deepen your Oracle specialization while expanding your understanding of connected business processes and technologies across the Oracle ecosystem.
* Apply AI to real business needs. Develop practical knowledge of AI and automation through customer solutions and improvements to the way we design, build, and deliver.

The team assesses existing environments, identifies adoption and process gaps, and develops practical improvement roadmaps. Solutions prioritize standard functionality, supported by integration and extensions where needed. Depending on the role, work may include Visual Builder Studio, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle APEX. Join Fusion Apps Studios to deepen your functional or technical expertise while broadening your contribution to customer advisory, connected processes, and business transformation.

As an Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Architect, you will translate business and legislative requirements into Oracle Fusion Cloud Global Payroll solutions. You will independently deliver requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, data migration, cutover, and stabilization, helping clients achieve accurate payroll processing and production readiness. Working with HR, Payroll, Finance, and technical stakeholders, you will apply mandatory Core HR knowledge to worker and assignment dependencies and coordinate related HCM integrations. The role requires 15+ years of overall professional experience relevant to HCM consulting, including Oracle Cloud payroll implementation experience; at least four full end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations involving Payroll; and implementation experience across at least two country legislations. You will work with geographically distributed clients and delivery teams. Hiring location, employment model, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.

Support cutover, initial payroll cycles, and stabilization; assess quarterly updates and legislative changes and support regression testing to maintain reliable payroll processing.

Strong understanding of gross-to-net processing, retroactivity, proration, balances, payments, costing, and reconciliation. Experience leading payroll parallel testing, resolving discrepancies, and supporting payroll acceptance and production readiness. Strong understanding Country specific taxation and deductions.

c9f6bf2f.title: Lead Data Architect
c9f6bf2f.description:
Overview:

**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
==================

We are a global integration and delivery team. We implement, integrate and support border management and passenger data solutions for government customers around the world. We deploy and configure applications, integrate them with government and airline systems, ship regular releases, and support them in production. Our solutions run in secure on-premises, customer-hosted and cloud environments, and our teams are spread across several regions and time zones.

**PURPOSE**
-----------

The Lead Technical Architect owns the technical design of the team's solutions, from early estimation through to production. You'll define solution and integration architectures for high-availability, message-driven systems built on Java microservices and Kubernetes. You'll set the technical direction for environments, CI/CD and platform standards, and act as the senior technical authority for engineering teams, customers and partners.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
========================

**Solution and integration architecture**
-----------------------------------------

* Design end-to-end solution architectures for new implementations, enhancements and modernisation programmes. This includes high-level and low-level designs, interface specifications and architecture decision records.
* Design integration patterns across synchronous REST/SOAP APIs, enterprise messaging (IBM MQ) and event streaming (Kafka). Keep external interface contracts stable while internal components are modernised.
* Lead legacy-to-modern re-platforming: break down monolithic applications into microservices, move embedded business logic into configurable rules, and plan data migration.
* Make technology decisions, for example choosing between relational and NoSQL data stores, based on functional need, non-functional requirements and licence cost.

**Platform, environments and DevOps**
-------------------------------------

* Define the target platform architecture on Kubernetes, including namespaces, ingress, storage, secrets management and environment isolation.
* Design environment strategy and promotion paths (development, CI, functional test, certification, staging, production) with immutable release artefacts and automated quality gates.
* Set CI/CD and code-quality standards with DevOps teams, including build pipelines, artefact registries, and static and open-source security scanning.

**Non-functional and security design**
--------------------------------------

* Design for high availability, scalability and disaster recovery, including active/DR topologies, cross-site replication, backup and agreed RTO/RPO targets.
* Define security architecture: identity and access management, service-to-service authorisation, encryption, network segmentation and compliance with government security requirements.
* Define observability standards (logging, monitoring, alerting, audit) and make sure solutions are ready to hand over to operations.

**Delivery leadership**
-----------------------

* Turn business and customer requirements into technical scope, work breakdowns and effort estimates for proposals and roadmaps.
* Run design reviews and code-quality reviews, and make sure delivery follows the agreed architecture.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex production incidents, and lead root-cause analysis and long-term fixes.
* Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies and technical debt.

**Stakeholder engagement and mentoring**
----------------------------------------

* Present and defend architecture to customers, government stakeholders, partners and internal leadership.
* Guide and mentor engineers, and build architecture capability across distributed teams.
* Keep architecture documentation, reference designs and standards up to date.

Qualifications:

**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**
=========================

**Essential**
-------------

* 12+ years in software engineering, with at least 4–5 years as a solution, technical or integration architect on complex enterprise systems.
* **Application architecture: Java** microservices, domain-driven design, REST/SOAP API design, and rules-engine-driven applications.
* **Messaging and integration: IBM MQ**, **Apache Kafka**, and integration middleware such as **Apache Camel / Karaf**; XML/JSON message design.
* **Containers and orchestration: Kubernetes** (including **Rancher** on **RHEL**), Docker, Helm, and **NGINX** / ingress and load balancing.
* **Data: Oracle** (19c) and **MongoDB**; data modelling, replication and large-scale data migration and reconciliation.
* **Search and observability: Elastic (Elasticsearch / ELK)** for logging, search and audit; application monitoring tools such as **Dynatrace** or Grafana.
* **Identity and security: ForgeRock** or equivalent IAM, OAuth2/OpenID Connect, PKI/TLS, and API gateway security.
* **DevOps and CI/CD: Jenkins**, **Azure DevOps**, Git, **Harbor** / **Nexus** / Azure Container Registry, **SonarQube**, **Mend** and **Black Duck**.
* Proven experience designing high-availability, disaster-recovery and secure on-premises solutions.
* Strong written and spoken communication, including writing architecture documents and presenting to senior and customer stakeholders.

**Desirable**
-------------

* **Storage and backup: MinIO**, **Longhorn** and Kubernetes-native backup such as **Veeam Kasten**.
* Public cloud experience (Azure, AWS) and hybrid deployment models.
* Experience with mobile back-end services and API-based partner integrations.
* Knowledge of the aviation, travel or border management domain, such as passenger data standards (API/PNR, PNRGOV), interactive APIs and electronic travel authorisation.
* Experience working with government customers and security accreditation processes.
* Architecture certification such as TOGAF, or cloud or Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD, Azure/AWS Architect).

**KEY ATTRIBUTES**
==================

* Pragmatic decision-maker who balances technical quality with cost, risk and delivery timelines.
* Clear communicator who can explain complex designs to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Hands-on enough to prototype, review code and troubleshoot production issues.
* Works well with distributed teams and can lead without direct authority.
* Flexible about working across time zones when customer workshops, releases or production incidents need it.

**EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------------

Degree in a technical discipline (e.g. Computer Science Engineering Mathematics etc.) or sufficient work experience to demonstrate proficiency at this level.

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

**Flex-Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

**Employee Wellbeing:** We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

**Professional Development:** At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** and **Airport Council International** -available to all employees-to specialized solutions like **Pluralsight** for technology upskilling, **Harvard Business Publishing** for people leadership, **Stanford** for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.

**Competitive Benefits:** Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.*

**Company Description**
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today, our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We are optimists for change, and we help clients initiate, navigate, and benefit from transformation.
  
  
With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our consultants serve clients worldwide from offices in many countries. Our AI and Data teams combine data science, generative AI, and engineering to take solutions from proof of concept to large-scale deployment.
  
  
Our Mumbai office launched in 2024. We are building the team with people who want to shape something from the ground up, combining the agility of a start-up with the backing and reach of a global brand. The AI Factory in Mumbai builds and delivers production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients across North America, Europe and the Middle East.
  
  
**Job Description**
Sia is building AI-powered products and a GenAI practice, and we are a privileged partner of OpenAI and Anthropic. We need a hands-on architect who will own the end-to-end architecture of our AI products, from system design to production scale.
  
  
You will be the hands-on leader and technical authority for our internal teams and the person client tech teams hold accountable for the architecture.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the end-to-end architecture of our AI products: system design, service boundaries, data flow, APIs and non-functional requirements
* Design microservice-based systems that scale, deploy on Kubernetes, and run reliably in production
* Architect LLM solutions: RAG pipelines, agents, tool use (including MCP), memory and context management, and prompt management
* Define evaluation approaches for prompts, models and agents, including regression testing
* Build observability and traceability for AI: tracing of prompts, tool calls and agent steps, plus monitoring of latency, quality and cost
* Control AI cost and performance through model selection, token budgets, caching and routing
* Design for security and compliance: data privacy, PII handling, access control, prompt-injection defences and Responsible AI
* Write production code, build reference implementations and review critical code
* Set the team's agentic coding practices: AI-assisted workflows, review standards and quality gates
* Be accountable to client tech teams for architecture reviews and answers on scalability and security
* Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across internal teams

**Qualifications**
**Must have**

* 10+ years in software engineering, with recent years as an architect of production systems
* Strong Python and the ability to work across the stack
* End-to-end design of distributed, microservice-based systems at scale
* Hands-on cloud experience (AWS, GCP or Azure), including managed LLM platforms such as Bedrock, Azure OpenAI or Vertex AI
* Hands-on Docker and Kubernetes
* LLM application experience (OpenAI and Anthropic APIs): RAG, vector databases and agents
* Experience with observability, traceability LLM evaluation and guardrails for AI systems
* Secure design for AI systems (privacy, PII, compliance)
* Daily use of agentic coding tools (such as Claude Code) and experience setting team practices around them
* Clear communication with the CTO, client engineers and business stakeholders

**Good to have**

* Event-driven architecture and domain-driven design
* Model and vendor strategy: build vs buy, multi-model routing, avoiding lock-in
* Reliability engineering for AI systems: SLOs, failover, rate limits and fallback when a provider is down
* Architecture governance: decision records, reviews and reference architectures
* Translating business needs into non-functional requirements

Additional information
  
  
**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to work on production AI for global enterprise clients, as part of a growing AI engineering capability.
* The chance to learn through real client implementations and to build reusable agent assets for the AI Factory.
* Access to Sia's leadership and training programmes as you grow.
* A collaborative, multidisciplinary team working across varied projects and industries.

64940972.title: Director, Technical Consulting (Salesforce Principal Architect)
64940972.description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
Salesforce Professional Services - Global Delivery Centre (GDC) focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and execution of change programs. We are the trusted delivery partner for Salesforce Professional Services that ensures end to end multi-cloud delivery capabilities across all Salesforce technologies and scales with agility for successful customer outcomes! We at GDC strive to foster growth & innovation and enable for Salesforce Professional Services with focus on performance, productivity & impact.
  
  
Salesforce is currently seeking a Director, Technical Consulting (in the Architects’ Practice) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world. The Director, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in enabling, deploying, and building the careers of our technical architects team.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* You’ll be responsible for planning capacity, hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Architects, as well as guide them on their CTA journey and their upskilling path across modern AI platforms.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries Architects’ consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, specifically driving the evolution of an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology within the practice.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI environments, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Industries Clouds, ensuring teams leverage developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery and enforce platform security.
* Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to establish evaluation frameworks that measure AI performance and business value.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders.
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with SFI and Salesforce.
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 18+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Expertise in one or multiples of → Salesforce Industries Cloud, Sales/Service/Experience Cloud, and Vlocity OmniStudio, as well as familiarity with Agentforce.
* Expertise in one or multiple domains of → Financial Services, Health & Life Sciences, Manufacturing and Automotive, Retail and Consumer Goods, etc.
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Platform Security (Must have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security
* Sharing and Visibility (Must have)
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others).
* Proficiency in English.

**Even Better If...**

* CTA
* Salesforce Certifications (Admin, Developer, Sales, and Service Clouds, System and Application Architect).
* OmniStudio Developer/Consultant
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, including hands-on delivery patterns for generative AI and agentic frameworks.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems.
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue.
* Strong interpersonal skills - nurture effective working relationships with others.
* Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation frameworks, and outcomes.

caf6c3d2.title: Salesforce Technical Architect(Education cloud )
caf6c3d2.description:
**Description**
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**You're Our Person If...**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

**Education Cloud (Mandatory)**

* We are looking for a Technical Architect to join the GDC India Delivery team and deliver a complex Education Cloud program. You will be hands-on in designing and building scalable solutions on the Salesforce platform, working across the full delivery lifecycle from requirement refinement and design to testing, deployment and CI/CD.
* Must have
* Core platform declarative features: Flow, BRE, DPE, Platform Events, Context Service OmniStudio: FlexCards, OmniScripts, Integration Procedures, Data Mappers Clean, scalable LWC and Apex development Platform fundamentals: configuration, governance limits and performance best practices Experience Cloud capabilities
* Value add Hands-on Education Cloud configuration; certification or relevant Trailhead badges preferred Higher-education domain knowledge (admissions, student onboarding) Legacy SIS and data modelling (for example PeopleSoft EduRec) Integration patterns (REST/SOAP, event-driven architecture) DevOps and CI/CD AI tooling such as Agentforce and Claude Code

ec5c411c.title: Senior Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer – Full Stack
ec5c411c.description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer – Full Stack builds and runs the Internal Hosting Portal that allows application teams across GSK to provision and manage Cloud resources in a self-service manner. The Hosting Portal is a custom-built web application using a modern TypeScript tech stack based on TypeScript. The full stack engineer sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through autoamted software deployment rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.
  
  
This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with HTML5, CSS3 (including preprocessors) and TypeScript (ES6+).
* Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with React and NextJS
* Hands-on experience with GraphQL and relevant tooling such as Yoga, Prisma, and Apollo Client
* undefined
* Good understanding of bundlers and compilers such as Webpack, TS-Node, Rspack and Babel.
* undefined
* Previous experience in developing a React-based UI Component library based on Mantine, Material UI, or Chakra UI.
* undefined
* Familiar with popular patterns and libraries such as React Hooks, state management, and Redux.
* undefined
* Previously developed schema-based forms either custom or based on a library such as react-hook-form or Formik, including data validator libraries such as Yup, Zod or JOI.
* undefined
* Expertise with CSS grid systems, media queries, flex and other layout techniques and responsive user interface components.
* undefined
* Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth v2 or SAML and JSON Web Token and libraries such as MSAL.
* Strong experience with test automation (unit & integration) tools such as Jest and Cypress.

**Desirable:**

* Familiar with building React web applications based on a Micro Frontend using Module Federation or Single SPA.
* undefined
* Developed REST APIs based on NodeJS (ExpressJS).
* undefined
* Experience of building and deploying web applications through CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
* undefined
* Knowledge of deploying, managing and monitoring web applications in a Cloud environment such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* undefined
* Previously worked in a central IT team within a regulated environment such as the Pharmaceutical or Finance industry.

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Deployment, Cloud Financial Operations, Component Libraries, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Full Stack Development, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Quality Engineering, Secure Authentication, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Test Automation, Virtualization
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
  
  
It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

506baccf.title: HCM Cloud Functional Consultant (Talent, ORC, Learn)
506baccf.description:
**Hiring for HCM Cloud Functional Management - Talent Management, ORC, Learn**

  

As an Oracle Fusion HCM Functional Consultant, you will translate business requirements into integrated solutions in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. You will independently deliver requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization, helping clients connect recruitment, development, and employee experience processes. Working with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders, you will apply strong Core HR knowledge to validate worker, assignment, organizational, and security dependencies. The role requires at least eight years of relevant HCM experience and participation in at least two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables. You will collaborate with technical teams on formulas, migration, integrations, reporting, and extensions; maintain clear solution documentation; and guide stakeholders through design decisions and delivery issues. You will also support quarterly update and Redwood impact assessments, mentor consultants, and serve as a functional team lead when required.

You will work with geographically distributed clients and delivery teams. Hiring location, employment model, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead requirements and design workshops with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders to define practical functional solutions and explain design options and trade-offs.
* Design and configure Oracle Recruiting processes, where included in the selected modules, covering recruiting structures, requisitions, career sites, candidate applications and communications, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Configure Oracle Learning catalogs, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and completion tracking, where included in the selected modules, to support learner and administrator processes.
* Configure Goal Management, Performance Management, Career Development, Succession Planning, Talent Review, and Profile Management, where Oracle Talent Management is included in the selected modules, to meet agreed talent requirements.
* Configure Oracle ME capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk, where Oracle ME is included in the selected modules, according to the agreed scope, validating Core HR and security dependencies.
* Define functional requirements for Fast Formulas, data migration, integrations, reports, and extensions, working with technical teams to validate delivery.
* Prepare functional designs, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, user guides, and knowledge-transfer materials to support consistent implementation and adoption.
* Conduct functional testing, support system integration and user acceptance testing, resolve defects, and obtain stakeholder sign-off to establish solution readiness.
* Support data validation, cutover, go-live, and stabilization; assess quarterly update and Redwood impacts and support regression testing to maintain configured processes.
* Communicate progress, dependencies, issues, and design decisions to clients and project leadership; plan activities, mentor consultants, and lead the functional team when required.

Skills - Mandatory

**Experience**

* At least 8 years of relevant HCM domain and functional consulting experience.
* Participation in a minimum of two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables.
* Proven client-facing experience across requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, and go-live.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on implementation and configuration expertise in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. The module-specific capabilities below apply to the selected modules.
* Oracle Recruiting: Recruiting structures, requisitions, candidate experience, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Oracle Learning: Learning content structures, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and learner and administrator processes.
* Oracle Talent Management: Goals, performance, career development, succession planning, talent reviews, and profile management.
* Oracle ME: Employee experience capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk.
* Strong foundational knowledge of Oracle Fusion Core HR and the hire-to-retire lifecycle.

**Functional Skills**

* Understanding of business processes, data flows, effective dating, approvals, and dependencies across the selected modules.
* Ability to independently resolve complex functional issues and explain solution options and trade-offs.
* Understanding of HCM security, including roles, data access, and appropriate handling of employee and candidate information.

* Strong hands-on implementation and configuration expertise in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. The module-specific capabilities below apply to the selected modules.
* Oracle Recruiting: Recruiting structures, requisitions, candidate experience, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Oracle Learning: Learning content structures, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and learner and administrator processes.
* Oracle Talent Management: Goals, performance, career development, succession planning, talent reviews, and profile management.
* Oracle ME: Employee experience capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk.
* Strong foundational knowledge of Oracle Fusion Core HR and the hire-to-retire lifecycle.

**Functional Skills**

* Understanding of business processes, data flows, effective dating, approvals, and dependencies across the selected modules.
* Ability to independently resolve complex functional issues and explain solution options and trade-offs.
* Understanding of HCM security, including roles, data access, and appropriate handling of employee and candidate information.

76a79e99.title: HCM Cloud Payroll Functional Consultant (Principal/Sr Principal)
76a79e99.description:
**Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant**

  

*Deliver accurate, integrated payroll solutions across country legislations with Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM.*

  
  

**Role Overview**

  

As an Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant, you will translate business and legislative requirements into Oracle Fusion Cloud Global Payroll solutions. You will independently deliver requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, data migration, cutover, and stabilization, helping clients achieve accurate payroll processing and production readiness. Working with HR, Payroll, Finance, and technical stakeholders, you will apply mandatory Core HR knowledge to worker and assignment dependencies and coordinate related HCM integrations. The role requires 8+ years of overall professional experience relevant to HCM consulting, including Oracle Cloud payroll implementation experience; at least two full end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations involving Payroll; and implementation experience across at least two country legislations. You will bring strong hands-on Global Payroll expertise and moderate hands-on proficiency in Payroll Fast Formulas and data migration.

You will work with geographically distributed clients and delivery teams. Hiring location, employment model, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead requirements and design workshops with HR, Payroll, Finance, and technical stakeholders, translating business and legislative needs into functional designs and Oracle Payroll configurations.
* Configure Legislative Data Groups, Payroll Statutory Units, Tax Reporting Units, payroll definitions, calendars, consolidation groups, and payment methods to establish payroll structures.
* Configure elements, eligibility, balances, calculation cards, rates, earnings, deductions, employer contributions, retroactivity, proration, and termination settlements to support accurate payroll calculations.
* Design and validate payroll flows, gross-to-net calculations, statutory reports, payments, payslips, costing, and reconciliation to meet business and legislative requirements.
* Apply Core HR knowledge to worker and assignment data, resolve dependencies with Absence Management, Time and Labor, Benefits, and Compensation, and define functional requirements for banking, statutory, third-party payroll, time, benefits, and Finance integrations.
* Create, modify, and troubleshoot Payroll Fast Formulas; support migration mapping, preparation, loading, validation, and reconciliation using HDL/HSDL where applicable, including opening and year-to-date balances.
* Prepare functional designs, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, operating procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials to support delivery and payroll operations.
* Conduct functional testing, lead payroll parallel runs, resolve discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and obtain stakeholder sign-off to establish payroll readiness.
* Support cutover, initial payroll cycles, and stabilization; assess quarterly updates and legislative changes and support regression testing to maintain reliable payroll processing.
* Communicate deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and decisions to clients and project leadership; mentor consultants and lead the Payroll workstream when required.

  

**Skills - Mandatory**

**Experience**

* 8+ years of overall professional experience relevant to HCM consulting, including Oracle Cloud payroll implementation experience.
* At least two full, completed end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations involving Payroll, with demonstrated hands-on functional ownership.
* Implementation experience across at least two country legislations from the areas below. For Middle East experience, identify the specific countries implemented.

**Country-specific functional expertise**

* United States: Federal, state, and local taxation; deductions; garnishments; multi-state payroll; and quarterly and year-end reporting.
* United Kingdom: PAYE, National Insurance, statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, student loans, RTI, and P45/P60 processing.
* Middle East: Country-specific payroll localization, social insurance or pensions, end-of-service benefits, gratuity, and WPS where applicable.
* India: Income tax/TDS, tax regimes, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, gratuity, arrears, and full-and-final settlements.
* Canada: Federal and provincial taxation, CPP/QPP, EI, QPIP where applicable, taxable benefits, ROE, and year-end reporting.
* Strong understanding of gross-to-net processing, retroactivity, proration, balances, payments, costing, and reconciliation.
* Experience leading payroll parallel testing, resolving discrepancies, and supporting payroll acceptance and production readiness.
* Understanding of HCM security and appropriate access to sensitive payroll information.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion Cloud Global Payroll, with the majority of relevant experience in Oracle HCM Cloud.
* Mandatory functional knowledge of Core HR and its dependencies with Payroll.

**Technical Skills**

* Moderate hands-on proficiency in Payroll Fast Formulas and data migration.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Ability to independently facilitate workshops, explain solution options, and resolve complex functional issues.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Good to Have

* Experience with global or multi-country Payroll implementations.
* Experience with midyear transitions, opening balance migration, and the first statutory year-end following go-live.
* Experience with Payroll-to-General Ledger integration and accounting reconciliation.
* Relevant Oracle Payroll Cloud certifications.
* Experience mentoring consultants or leading functional delivery teams.
* Presales experience covering demonstrations, proposals, solution assessments, or estimation.
* Experience using AI and automation tools to support implementation delivery, with appropriate data access and output validation.
